launches.title: Hatchet - Background task orchestration and visibility platform
launches.tagline: We help engineers run fast and reliable background tasks
launches.body:
**tl;dr** - At a certain scale, all applications need a task queue - think Celery for Python, BullMQ for Node.js, and Sidekiq for Rails. [Hatchet](https://hatchet.run) is an [open-source](https://github.com/hatchet-dev/hatchet), managed task queue focused on scale, reliability, and improved developer experience. 

<https://youtu.be/3myPYVyaqwM>

**The problem**

Building a reliable application is difficult — network connections can fail or be interrupted, the application could run out of memory, or a bad commit on production can take down your entire service. To reduce the pressure on APIs, task queues are typically used to offload different parts of the application logic to other services in the system.

However, these queues introduce more points of failure — they require new infrastructure, a new set of integrations to monitor and debug your tasks, and are difficult to use in development. As applications begin to scale, application developers are forced to implement solutions to avoid queue overflow and overcrowding and to think about how to optimize their queues.

With LLM APIs — which are high latency and highly variable in response quality — these problems are even worse. It’s now typical to ingest, sync, vectorize, and index the entirety of multiple data sources on account creation, and as LLM systems get more agentic, developers need to chain together unreliable LLM calls to fulfill requests. These requests are often slow and without the right architecture delivering a responsive and reliable user experience is challenging.

**The solution**

Hatchet is an **end-to-end platform** for task orchestration. It includes a web UI for monitoring tasks, an API for interacting with tasks and workflows, and SDKs for Python, Typescript, and Golang.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79258&key=user_uploads/363082/1617c928-fc04-4482-9b13-98c342e14694)

Hatchet has all the features you’d expect — like **retries, timeouts**, and **cron schedules** — along with features that developers are usually asked to build, like handling different **fairness and concurrency patterns**, **durable execution**, and **result streaming**.

**The team**

We’re both ex-CTOs and founders of multiple YC-funded companies — [Alexander](https://linkedin.com/in/alexander-belanger-aa3974135) was co-founder and CTO at [Porter](https://porter.run) (S20) while [Gabe](https://linkedin.com/in/gruttner) was co-founder and CTO at [Clearmix](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/clearmix) (also S20). Before that, Alexander got his Master’s in Physics from UPenn while Gabe got his Master’s in AI from Cornell.

Alexander started working on this after years of wrangling task queues and distributed systems at both Porter and [Oneleet](https://oneleet.com), where he experienced the issues of building complex task orchestration and workflows. Gabe came at this from another perspective, having spent the last few years working with ML and more recently LLM stacks, where he saw the architectural problems that many of these applications have.

We immediately bonded over our excitement about what infrastructure will look like as AI becomes core to nearly every business.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79258&key=user_uploads/363082/e77d894d-1e99-4128-9bff-65f905d97571)

**How do I get started?**

Hatchet is fully open source with an [invite-only cloud offering](https://hatchet.run/request-access). Feel free to request access or check out the [self-hosting Hatchet](https://docs.hatchet.run/self-hosting) docs.

If you’re dealing with observability problems in your queue, are running batch processing of documents for LLM workflows, or are experiencing queue fairness problems in multi-tenant apps, we’d love to chat.

And if you have any questions — or you’re just interested in distributed systems, task queues, and scheduling — we have a [public Discord](https://discord.gg/ZMeUafwH89). See you there!

launches.title: Stacksync: Real-time and two-way sync between CRMs and Databases
launches.tagline: READ and WRITE your CRM data with SQL queries!
launches.body:
Hey everyone! We’re [**Ruben**](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/1327024) and [**Alexis**](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/1685532) from [**Stacksync**](https://www.stacksync.cloud/), here to help you forget about complex CRM APIs. 👋

\*\*TL;DR \*\* [**Stacksync**](https://www.stacksync.cloud/) powers real-time and two-way sync between CRMs and databases. With two-way sync, we turn your database into a **READ AND WRITE** interface to your CRM data. From your database, _make SQL queries to update data at any scale_ and your CRM will reflect these changes instantly. And vice-versa, when you update data in your CRM, your database is immediately updated.

Try it yourself and [**get started here!**](https://www.stacksync.cloud/)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77196&key=user_uploads/1327024/63cc74de-7bec-4caa-8d25-a1a6f6d902d8)

**💥 Problem**

Developers hate using CRM APIs. Their documentation is hard to navigate, with multiple edge cases and data inconsistencies have severe business consequences. This makes CRM integration complex, time consuming and costly. Worse, business teams working daily in CRMs are left with outdated or no data at all, while the data insights they need are just available in the database: it simply requires too much investment in development and maintenance.

**✅ Solution**

With two-way sync, we turn your database into a read+write interface to your CRM. So instead of reading and writing data from an API, just do it with SQL queries in the database that you already know and love. Whenever data is updated in your database, it instantly syncs to your CRM and vice-versa.

Stacksync is different because it is the first tool that delivers consistent data you can trust in real-time. Stacksync just works. The setup is done in less than 5 minutes, without a single line of code.

[Watch demo here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XrigWqlSQnQ](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XrigWqlSQnQ)

**🪄 How it works**

No-code makes it easy. Start by [**creating your account**](https://www.stacksync.cloud/) for free, then

1. Connect your Apps

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77196&key=user_uploads/1327024/ce17348d-2078-4dea-9170-0a1320b6665c)

2. Choose which tables your want to sync

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77196&key=user_uploads/1327024/4532ea18-a1da-44cc-8855-9bd694d36f3c)

3. Map your fields

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77196&key=user_uploads/1327024/f1778ed4-16ad-46cd-865a-a9a5939efee3)


That’s it! 🎉

**💰 Pricing**

Simple CRM integrations start at 200$/month, and you can upgrade on a pay-as-you-go for large data volumes.

YC Companies get a [**Deal (80% discount for a year, worth 120k free credits)**](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/deals/2173)!

**💜 Our Ask**

Try it yourself and [**get started here**](https://www.stacksync.cloud/)

* Schedule a call if you’re interested: [cal.com/rubenburdin](https://cal.com/rubenburdin/30min)
* Share with anyone that you think could benefit from simpler CRM integration (warm intros are welcome!) 😉
* We would appreciate any candid feedback!
* Need a feature or connector? Let us build it for you here and now!

If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to my personal email [ruben@stacksync.cloud](https://ruben@stacksync.cloud)

launches.title: Terrakotta: Add voice as a channel to grow your business 🗣️
launches.tagline: AI web-phone designed for cold outreach
launches.body:
TL;DR: [Terrakotta](https://www.terrakotta.ai/) is a web-phone that uses personalized AI voicemails to double the number of contacts you can engage over the phone. Voicemails left using Terrakotta are personalized to every contact and generate more callbacks than generic scripts.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79253&key=user_uploads/1032568/e407487e-18cb-4c20-b6ba-0c2257e42252)

👋Hey Everyone! We’re Kus, Vincent, and Gabe (from left to right) and we are the founders of Terrakotta. Terrakotta lets users leverage their unique voice (yes, their literal voice) to grow their business. We’re calling it ‘voice nurture’.

**Problem**

Voicemail is a great growth channel to generate interest and callbacks from leads, but historically it hasn’t scaled well. Leaving voicemails during call sessions is: 

* Time-consuming
* Repetitive
* Tiring

 

**Solution: ☎️⚡️Here’s what a call session looks like in Terrakotta⚡️☎️**

With Terrakotta users can clone their voice, load up a contact list, and set a dynamic AI voicemail script that will be personalized for unanswered calls. From there, users can flip on the auto-dial feature and zoom through their call list, reaching up to 100 contacts/hour.

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/BPwVoxEx28ZdtBWjg-vbJvTtJ3SncmfG5Y2vNv-DYP0X7qPheGSAbrc5TMvgnmDEt2N_oyJtj8d5GCCZQyDy5yPi3n_qB6dmfGEwooFBt4v1-97h87uaAX-X0-Ktx6i3VLfrnLYdDic7lzURlNuhyxs)

_(Don’t worry: the contacts are not real people; the phone numbers are our many test lines)_

**About the squad**

* [**Vincent**](https://linkedin.com/in/vincent-wilson-5105141b7) was an incoming Software Engineer at Palantir before dropping out of college to found Terrakotta.
* [**Kus**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kusiima-boswell-84a1a5151) was a Senior Analyst at McKinsey where he wrote custom data solutions and advised principal investors / GTM execs on strategy. 
* [**Gabe**](https://linkedin.com/in/gabriel-wilson-2b480914b) was a software engineer for Lyft Business and Human Interest (S15).

 

We (strangely) have lots of friends in commercial real estate, and the number one thing they complain about is making outbound phone calls. We’re using our experience with software development and GTM in different contexts to take on this problem in commercial real estate and prove the ability of voice nurture as a growth channel.

**Our asks**

* **If you’re making lots of cold calls and want to do it more efficiently** - try it out!: <https://www.terrakotta.ai/>
* **Get in touch with us** **if you’re looking for new channels** like voicemail to grow your business
* **Give us feedback on what you think of the voice-cloning feature - how accurate do you think it is?**

[Email us](mailto:vincent@terrakotta.ai) if you want to check it out.

Or schedule a demo here 

Thanks for reading!

launches.title: Spark AI: Stakeholder Intelligence for Data Center Permitting
launches.tagline: See who decides your permit, and how they'll vote, before you break ground
launches.body:
Hi everyone, we're [Julia](https://www.linkedin.com/in/wu-julia/) and [Anuj](https://www.linkedin.com/in/anujsaigal/), co-founders of [Spark AI](https://www.sparkhq.ai/).

### **TL;DR**

See who decides your permit, and how they'll vote, before you break ground

Every data center in America has to get through a local zoning board before it gets built. We mapped and tracked every jurisdiction, project, and land use regulation in the country, and we just launched Stakeholder Intelligence, a tool that tells you who's deciding your permit, their voting history, and what's likely to happen next. **If you're developing (or powering) data centers, or know someone who is, we want to talk.**

### ❌ The Problem

Data centers land next to real communities: people who didn't ask for a giant, humming building showing up in their backyard. A lot of them fight it.

That fight runs entirely through local politics: county boards, township councils, zoning authorities. Real people with real voting histories, some of whom love solar and hate data centers, some the reverse, and it shifts constantly.

* Data centers are having the roughest time of any large-scale asset class right now. 42% of gigawatt-scale data center projects announced in 2025 have already run into a local moratorium, suspension, legal challenge, or permit denial. That's not an edge case anymore, it's closer to a 50/50 bet.
* And it's accelerating. Within six months of announcement, \~24% hit that same wall in 2025, nearly triple 2024's rate (8%) and more than triple 2023's (7%).

Federal and state policy get all the coverage. But the actual bottleneck on AI compute buildout sits in a Tuesday night meeting in a county most people can't find on a map, and almost nobody tracks it systematically. Developers either fly someone out to sit through hours of public comment, or they pay consultants a lot of money to tell them what already happened last month.

### ✅ How Spark Works: Stakeholder Intelligence

Stakeholder intelligence surfaces every board member, commissioner, officer’s past decisions, meetings and votes from our databases and web search agents running across the country.

<https://youtu.be/-YclcbrBUh8>

**We watch the game tape for you.** For every authority in the US, you get the meeting video, the transcript, the decision, and our summary of what actually mattered. Topics covered, who said what, what got decided. What used to take someone three hours of watching public comment now takes about thirty seconds of reading.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=113436&key=user_uploads/307611/076af213-dd78-4d58-acf8-c249244260cb)

**NIMBY tracking.** We score every county in the country on data center permitting posture: moratoriums, zoning rules, sentiment grounded in local news coverage, and utility interconnection posture. That rolls into a tier and a score, so you know before you sign a lease whether you're walking into a fight.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=113436&key=user_uploads/307611/21ab4ec3-c751-4de6-845a-2cef9e732d7c)

**Alerts.** Ordinances change, moratoriums get proposed, projects move. We tell you when it happens instead of you finding out from a headline.

### Backstory

Julia grew up in and around factories, in the supply chain corridor between Asia and Latin America, before building data and search infrastructure for Apple's Siri team. Anuj spent a decade financing and building energy infrastructure, at the Department of Energy, SunEdison, and EVgo, before founding his last company, Dataherald (YC W21).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=113436&key=user_uploads/307611/870f82a4-1496-4bc2-b433-a69d13c8ea24)

### Who We Work With

Alphabet (Intersect), NextEra, DE Shaw Renewables, Nodiac, and a set of world class developers and Fortune 500s carrying over 200GW of pipeline between them.

### How You Can Help

If you or anyone in your network is developing data centers, large or small, we want the intro. We're especially trying to connect with people close to Terawulf, Vantage, Equinix, CyrusOne, and Digital Realty.

Reach us at [founders@sparkhq.ai](mailto:founders@sparkhq.ai). Or happy to jump on a call: [**calendar link**](https://calendly.com/d/cyty-zwg-3bb).

launches.title: Spark: Permitting Intelligence for AI Infrastructure
launches.tagline: Spark helps energy infrastructure developers cut through permitting red tape
launches.body:
### TL;DR

With [Spark AI](https://www.sparkhq.ai/), developers can instantly identify permitting requirements and fatal flaws in seconds, not weeks.

We have parsed more than 1 million zoning, permitting, town hall meetings, and project documents. Our systems ingest PDFs, maps, land use codes, moratoria, interconnection queues, and local websites across thousands of jurisdictions.

### Permitting is the silent killer of energy infrastructure projects

An estimated $98 billion in projects were [blocked or delayed](https://www.datacenterwatch.org) in Q2 2025. A one-month delay on a 60 MW data center can [erase $10M in value](https://www.foresight.works/case-study/foresight-driving-projects-blind). Speed to power determines who wins in data center, storage, and generation.

Critical information lives inside thousands of scattered, inconsistent zoning codes, permits, and local records. Teams miss high-potential sites, waste months on weak ones, and get outpaced by competitors.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96116&key=user_uploads/129719/ac5a347e-6cae-406e-8867-a98f5d8cd5ba)

### Enter Spark: De-risking Speed to Power

Spark pulls everything into one place and makes permitting intelligence instant.

Spark scans millions of PDFs, maps, land use codes, and local websites to surface permitting rules and community sentiment. What used to take weeks now takes seconds. The same engine evaluates individual parcels or entire data rooms.

https://youtu.be/6wvFwUNPrks

**Rapid Permit Matrix 📄**

We run the permitting gauntlet for hyperscalers, energy developers, and BESS operators at a fraction of the cost and time.

Spark generates a complete permit matrix that captures the legal, procedural, and social landscape of any site. Developers move faster on strong sites and eliminate weak ones early.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96116&key=user_uploads/129719/867df1aa-ea4b-4b25-96a1-003942873b64)

**Social Media Sentiment 👥**

Local opposition begins online long before public hearings. Grassroots groups and Facebook communities shape the approval landscape months in advance.

Spark tracks social media activity across every U.S. county for solar, storage, and data center projects. Users identify relevant groups, engagement patterns, and sentiment before the first meeting hits the calendar.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96116&key=user_uploads/129719/75434906-6ad4-48ab-83f0-4740c6350b2b)

Don’t just take it from us: We’re trusted by dozens of industry-leading developers representing over 90 gigawatts of project pipeline and $30 billion in financing: Cypress Creek Renewables, Standard Solar, Arevon, UGE ([case study](https://sparknotes.beehiiv.com/p/from-bottleneck-to-breakthrough)), DESRI, Dynamic Energy ([case study](https://sparknotes.beehiiv.com/p/dynamic-energy)), and many others.

### Core Team

Our founding team, [Julia Wu](https://www.linkedin.com/in/wu-julia/), [Anuj Saigal](https://www.linkedin.com/in/anujsaigal/?utm_source=sparknotes.beehiiv.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=ai-for-a-mission-recruiting-post), [Luca Marturana](https://www.linkedin.com/in/lucamarturana/?utm_source=sparknotes.beehiiv.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=ai-for-a-mission-recruiting-post), [Wendell Beane](https://www.linkedin.com/in/wendell-beane-21861712b/), [Shivam Agarwal](https://www.linkedin.com/in/shivam-agarwal-77604ab8/), combines years of leadership in AI and energy.

We come from Apple, Microsoft, SunEdison, the Department of Energy, and multiple YC startups.

### Our Ask

We’re partnering with developers and operators building the future of compute and energy. If that’s you, we’d love to chat! [**Book a demo here**](https://calendly.com/d/4qp-yyt-qxw/spark-ai-demo)**, or reach out to [founders@sparkhq.ai](mailto:founders@sparkhq.ai)**

We are hiring across [operations/growth](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/spark/jobs/UKGQ0Fd-spark-ai-growth-and-operations-associate-manager) and [engineering](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/spark/jobs/kDeJlPK-software-engineer-full-stack-founding-team)! If this mission sounds exciting to you or someone you know, reach out to [hiring@sparkhq.ai](mailto:hiring@sparkhq.ai)

launches.title: ⚡️ Spark - AI-powered workflows for large-scale clean energy development
launches.tagline: We help large-scale clean energy developers break ground faster
launches.body:
**😎 TL;DR**

[Spark](https://www.sparkhq.ai/) is an AI-powered planning and workflow tool for large-scale clean energy developers that lets them break ground faster. Tae and Julia were previously engineering and product leaders at Tesla, Apple, and Brex.

We are trusted by award-winning solar and battery developers with nearly 1 GW of projects across the US. If you are a utility or community-scale developer, [book a call with us](https://calendly.com/d/4qp-yyt-qxw/spark-demo) to learn more.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78596&key=user_uploads/129719/b48282f6-7002-4eba-92e9-dc5307a6c58e)

**🔌 The Problem**

We are in the midst of a generational energy transition, with solar deployment expanding at an annualized rate of roughly [$500B](https://twitter.com/patrickc/status/1698496805162353029) globally, and the Inflation Reduction Act unleashing another [$400B](https://www.mckinsey.com/industries/public-sector/our-insights/the-inflation-reduction-act-heres-whats-in-it) in federal funding. To meet the soaring demand for clean energy, the US must [build](https://www.motherjones.com/environment/2023/04/electrify-everything-scope-data/) an equivalent amount of clean generation by 2035 to the total electricity supplied by all sources today.

Despite this rapid deployment, utility-scale clean energy developers often spend months assessing and preparing their projects for financing and construction due to varying policies, interconnection, and permitting requirements across jurisdictions. This pre-construction phase is an error-prone and manual effort of researching and aggregating data across thousands of PDFs, websites, and maps.

Many developers find themselves poring over 1000-page documents, engaging expensive consultants, or focusing on a limited number of jurisdictions.

Through hundreds of conversations with developers, we consistently hear that navigating this "complex patchwork of jurisdictions, where every state is a snowflake," is a major obstacle.

**✨ Enter Spark**

With Spark, developers can identify requirements, risks, and incentives by leveraging our curated dataset. They can now screen prospective projects in seconds, not weeks.

For the first time, Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a dramatically simplified method to extract grid interconnection and permitting requirements, zoning ordinances, economics (rates, tax credits, RECs), and a range of unstructured information relevant to renewables development.

By refining the data specifically for this industry, Spark introduces a new way for developers to navigate through otherwise disparate and cumbersome information.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78596&key=user_uploads/295458/976413d4-584e-44fd-8c6e-315509d4c9de)

These insights are then precisely mapped to individual counties and parcels of land, accelerating the development process significantly.

However, Spark’s capabilities extend beyond location diligence and requirement aggregation. Our goal is to re-imagine the development workflow, enabling developers to drastically reduce the time dedicated to mundane tasks such as research, documentation, and portfolio management.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78596&key=user_uploads/129719/550c9a08-294e-4944-9369-649919faca48)

One of our customers, an industry veteran with nearly 20 years of experience, said “I see this tool as my Jarvis.”

Our mission is to empower developers to prioritize human interactions and make strategic decisions about where to invest millions of dollars to electrify the nation’s grid — not the manual, back office work.

[🪄](mailto:founders@sparkhq.ai) **The (Dream) Team**

[Tae](https://www.linkedin.com/in/taehnkim/) built software while sitting inside the Model 3 factory at Tesla, wrote payment systems that processed millions in EV sales as a founding engineer at Lucid Motors’ commerce team, and helped Gen Z find love at Tinder.

[Julia](https://www.linkedin.com/in/wu-julia/) was an engineering manager on the team that automated fraud alerts and dispute filing at Brex. She also built search and cloud infrastructure at Apple and Microsoft and bankrolled her passion for crypto through hackathon prizes on nights and weekends.

Hailing from São Paulo, Brazil, where we lived ten minutes apart after our parents immigrated from Korea and China, we embarked on our American dream at 18 for undergraduate degrees in STEM at Georgia Tech and Brown University. Our paths crossed many years later in New York City, through a shared passion for software engineering, infrastructure for society, and startups.

**⚡️ Energized yet?**

Are you (or do you know) a developer of utility or community-scale solar/storage projects? [Book a demo](https://calendly.com/d/4qp-yyt-qxw/spark-demo) or reach out to [founders@sparkhq.ai!](mailto:founders@sparkhq.ai)

launches.title: Dataherald - NL-to-SQL API for developers
launches.tagline: Embed NL-to-SQL into your product
launches.body:
**TL;DR**

Dataherald enables you to embed Natural Language to SQL (“NL-to-SQL”) into your product. The NL-to-SQL API, built with an LLM (such as GPT), allows users to conduct no-code data analytics, pull reports, and conduct complex data queries using just natural language.

Hi, we’re [Amir](https://www.linkedin.com/in/amir-zohrenejad-72a517184/) and [Anuj](https://www.linkedin.com/in/anujsaigal/) from [Dataherald](https://www.dataherald.com/contact). There have been countless game-changing applications of AI, but one area that has remained uncharted is NL-to-SQL. But fear not - we’re changing that. We’ve built a cutting-edge NL-to-SQL engine, meticulously crafted to be the fastest and most accurate in the market, delivering an unmatched developer experience!

**The Problem**

Developers struggle to build NL-to-SQL into products because LLMs do not work out-of-the-box. LLMs do not:

1. Utilize metadata and business definitions since they are not already stored in the relational database
2. Conduct **complex** SQL queries, such as self joins, multiple sub-queries, or rarer operations like windowing, partitioning, lags, temporal calculations, etc.
3. Create NL-to-SQL training dataset(s) for fine-tuned models
4. Assess the accuracy of AI-generated SQL

**The Solution**

Dataherald’s API solves these challenges by allowing developers to:

* Add business context from various sources (data dictionaries, DBT, Confluence docs, Google docs, etc.)

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/kwye-PT4ors7WmWLdm5AjZN5oprn0XXX2v4i_PkCIYwRvilZ-fixK_9wJGHJo9PU1rjv99kBgEVCB1YX58DYO3HCeNoQlHqLcdURUilLhsYcdiDTVEVcd8DZCrt_1EeHYd-zkjWUukA6I8Ka8epVBCc)

* Identify relevant data tables
* Fine-tune NL-to-SQL LLMs **(including GPT-4!)** specific to their data
* Assess confidence levels in AI-generated SQL

All this happens with a few simple API calls.

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/6LVhL2Hbyga7oQ7mGDNORds_IMhmA5oBbrjNjKl4Y3L3rECk4WozWzJQY8jS16X6j9ZGgW-5p1fVqt6flbiZfR138EpYhUmcH9btyJL1ky_y7EIlQ5lEQUYVVVzfzDkjlfDU88y_0mJwDRbMgXWug9M)

Dataherald’s NL-to-SQL API unlocks data access wherever needed:

1. Enabling Complex Data Queries in SaaS Apps: For example a large payroll software company uses Dataherald to embed NL-to-SQL into their front end so that users can ask questions like “How much did I spend on full stack engineers in our European offices in Q2 2023 and how is that trending?”
2. Democratizing Data Insights: Companies integrate our API into Slack, enabling self-serve data requests, and freeing up valuable time for data analysts.
3. Automate Customer Support with Chatbots: Customer support teams dealing with data-heavy queries leverage Dataherald in chatbots, automating inquiries regarding user data.

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/rsI_mjIShLSNZBuwGtOKk8k8Fv0f8rUEjItn0w17y-_rps3jWcWNgvQ6C9Ly9EFxszG7jE3c5DLS_T9lcEiHwYD0Z1nvXNgHB3-qFRAOJM6XL6B0w19JQt_esYJm7qqp6Tg2U1Jh9QvHlWGdohmzUZ4)

**The ASK**

* **Start using today** - send me an email [anuj@dataherald.com](https://mailto:anuj@dataherald.com) to get your API key and start using it today!
* **Share** - tell your colleagues and friends about [Dataherald](https://dataherald.com/)
* **YC Companies** - skip the wait list and claim the [YC deal](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/deals/2135)

With an ever-increasing volume of data, businesses have invested heavily in BI tools with the aim of providing answers to data questions. These tools often fail to handle complex data queries, leading to a backlog of **ad hoc questions** for the data team, inevitably creating a bottleneck.

launches.body:
Hi YC! We're [Illiana](https://www.linkedin.com/in/illiana-reed/), [Miguel](https://www.linkedin.com/in/miguel-salinas-b2781426/), and [Isabella](https://www.linkedin.com/in/isabellareed/), the team behind camelAI.

# What We're Building

camelAI is the last BI tool you'll ever need. What AI has done for coding, camelAI is doing for analytics. We connect an LLM directly to your database, turning natural language questions into in depth reports complete with beautiful visualizations in seconds. No modeling, no drag-and-drop limitations, no tickets to the data team.

<https://youtu.be/bBqdaNN-NpM>

# The Problem: Text-to-SQL Has Failed

Let's be honest: Text-to-SQL has been around for years. It's been done to death and it still leaves users frustrated. Instead of giving clear answers, Text-to-SQL makes users fight for insights:

* Setup takes forever
* Queries only work well for narrow, predictable questions
* Results come as raw data tables, not analysis
* Business users struggle to get actionable insights

Business users don't want raw tables of data—they need clear insights. But text-to-SQL forces them to piece together answers manually, leaving them frustrated and no closer to a decision.

The real problem: Getting valuable insights out of your own data is still too hard and too time consuming.

For executives, founders, and product managers, this means:

* Waiting days for simple data requests
* Making decisions without complete information
* Spending hours building and maintaining dashboards
* Wasting precious engineering time for a "quick data pull"

For technical teams, it means:

* Constant context-switching to answer basic data questions
* Building one-off dashboards that are rarely used
* Explaining the same metrics repeatedly

## Our Solution: camelAI

Ask camelAI anything - from basic KPIs to complex business metrics your team hasn't even thought to track:

**Deep Research Agent:** Watch as our Agent writes SQL queries in real time, explores your data, and generates interactive visualizations that deliver immediate insights. Complete transparency at every step.

**Learns Your Company:** camelAI learns your company's language through use. It remembers past queries and improves through your feedback, creating consistent company-specific analysis.

**Instant Visualizations:** camelAI doesn't just dump query results; it automatically creates interactive Plotly visualizations with written analysis of what the data actually means.

**One-Click Dashboards:** Any visualization can be saved to a dashboard that refreshes automatically. Create comprehensive dashboards in minutes, not hours.

**Enterprise-Ready:** We support on-prem and VPC deployments across multiple databases.

# The New Reality

Without camelAI:

1. Adding tickets to sprints for basic data questions
2. Waiting days for simple insights
3. Engineers constantly pulled away from building products

With camelAI:

1. Business teams get answers immediately
2. Engineers focus on building products
3. Founders make better decisions faster

## Who Needs This Yesterday

* **Founders** who can't afford to wait for data
* **Product Teams** tracking metrics without a dedicated analyst
* **CTOs** tired of being the bottleneck for data requests
* **Junior Analysts** who want to focus on insights, not queries

# Setup Takes 60 Seconds

1. Connect your data source — pick from 10+ connections or upload a CSV
2. Ask your first question
3. Start making better decisions

# 🐪 How We Got Here

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=76776&key=user_uploads/1925221/b319f130-c38f-4080-8e5c-8edf8d77e91d)

We've been shipping products together for three years. We're not data analysts, and that was the problem.

Our organized data was right there, but we couldn't get to it without SQL expertise or wrestling with clunky BI tools that never quite answered our actual questions. So we built the tool we needed.

Our insight was simple: stop writing SQL queries by hand. Let AI do what it's good at. Let humans ask natural questions and get answers they can use right away.

## Try camelAI Today

Our free tier gives you 10 messages per week: <https://camelai.com/>

Questions? We read every email: [illiana@camelai.com](mailto:illiana@camelai.com)

Looking for: Teams tired of SQL bottlenecks who want to transform how they use data.

launches.tagline: Ocular AI lets teams within organizations search, visualize, and perform critical cross tool actions all on one unified platform.
launches.body:
We’re [Michael](https://www.linkedin.com/in/michaelmoyo/) and [Louis](https://www.linkedin.com/in/louismurerwa/) and are excited to officially launch [Ocular AI](https://www.useocular.com/)!

Book demos [here.](https://calendly.com/use-ocular/30min?month=2024-03#utm_source=launchyc&utm_medium=Launch+YC+Blog+Post&utm_campaign=launch&utm_id=launchyc&utm_content=launch+yc)

**💡 Tl;Dr:**

[**Ocular AI** ](https://www.linkedin.com/company/use-ocular)makes it easy for employees in mid-market and enterprise companies to find information and perform cross-tool actions using Generative AI-powered Search. We do this by providing a beautiful Google-like interface and a co-pilot that connects to all your company apps and tools. 

[ ](https://youtu.be/gAHGlKwBQJg)

**❌ Problem**

Having worked at Google and Microsoft, we experienced first-hand how difficult it is to access and find information and perform actions across multiple SaaS tools both in the workplace and in engineering. Through our experience and conversations with people at Appian, Boeing, General Electric, Uber, Pinecone, Brex, Coda, Unity, Microsoft, and Google, we learned that as companies grow it gets very challenging to:

1. **Find what you need at work:** Company knowledge lives in multiple, isolated SaaS applications, and employees spend over a quarter of their workday looking for information (think of documentation, past slack threads, etc), finding the people needed to complete tasks, and getting the required permissions.
2. **Manage complex engineering tools:** As engineering teams scale and adopt microservices, they onboard multiple tools for documentation, development, release, monitoring, and alerting. Critical data, metrics, logs, and dashboards are all in isolated platforms such as CircleCI, DataDog, and New Relic and this makes it very difficult to have a unified view of company data, correlation data across these tools, and complete multitool workflow coordination - especially during incidents.

 

Siloed tooling and data introduce an operational tax to the lives of employees like engineers, slowing down productivity, development cycles, and incident management. Workers spend an average of a quarter of their day searching for information. 

All of this time can be used to write more code, do more deals, and talk to customers. With the rise of AI and Copilots, the value of the time spent on doing actual work has never been so high.

**🚀🚀🚀 Our Solution**

🔎 **Enterprise Search for everyone in your company:** Integrate all of your company’s applications, tooling, and data sources to power organizational and team-level search. Organization members only see the information they have access to based on their roles.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79032&key=user_uploads/928098/2acb388c-05d6-4ccc-bbb7-60a0a979fbf0)

\
🤖 **Ocular Copilot- your work assistant that knows everything about your company:** Power cross-tool workflows and actions using our generative AI-powered Ocular Copilot. Create workspaces, upload files (structured or unstructured), create collections, and build usage-specific assistants for your day-to-day tasks. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79032&key=user_uploads/928098/71f00356-86e2-46b0-b8f9-8f2521f83b09)

**App MarketPlace:** Integrate the tools (Notion, Jira, Google Drive, Slack) you already love and use for your day-to-day tasks.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79032&key=user_uploads/928098/b72de7e6-e224-4695-9eac-f934add88a6f)

**Admin Portal:** 

Ocular AI provides search-driven insights such as trending searches, number of searches, etc., which allows execs and managers to understand their organizations better. With Ocular, you can now see which applications are used the most and which ones are underutilized, allowing organizations to make reliable SaaS spend decisions. In addition, add members, teams, and applications to your Ocular instance.

[ ](https://youtu.be/9Y9ex6e_vqE)

## **📈 Maximizing Generative AI ROI for Enterprise**

Enterprises are eager to adopt Generative AI in the workplace to enhance operational efficiencies. We’re partnering with organizations to implement secure, compliant, and company-specific Generative AI.

**🔐 Enterprise security**

Coming from Microsoft and Google, we understand the importance of data privacy and security. For that reason, you can self-host Ocular AI on-premise or on bring your own cloud (BYOC), so all your data stays within your control- we don’t have access to it. Ocular AI is also getting SOC2 compliant and enforcing end-to-end data encryption AES 256. We’ll also be adding more security layers to ensure your data is 100% safe.

**💯 The Team**

[Dartmouth College](https://home.dartmouth.edu/) graduates with software engineering experience building large-scale and compliant applications at Google and Microsoft.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79032&key=user_uploads/928098/63025954-cc5d-4297-90fc-57ea63c5491f)

**🫡 Our Ask**

Please introduce us to managers, CEOs, CIOs, and CTOs. We can help unify their tools and data together to make their teams more efficient. 

Schedule a demo at [www.useocular.com](https://www.useocular.com#utm_source=launchyc&utm_medium=Launch+YC+Blog+Post&utm_campaign=launch&utm_id=launchyc&utm_content=launch+yc) or [here.](https://calendly.com/use-ocular/30min?month=2024-03#utm_source=launchyc&utm_medium=Launch+YC+Blog+Post&utm_campaign=launch&utm_id=launchyc&utm_content=launch+yc)

**_tl;dr_** Onedoc makes it easy for developers to generate beautiful PDFs. It is a comprehensive solution with:

1. An [open-source library](https://github.com/OnedocLabs/react-print) to design your documents
2. A simple [API](https://docs.onedoclabs.com/introduction) to generate your documents
3. A [cloud platform](https://app.onedoclabs.com/login) to host and track your documents

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78258&key=user_uploads/959469/55ac7687-e4a4-4456-97a2-ff6348953e3b)

> Using Onedoc to quickly generate dynamic PDFs

👋 Hi! We are [Auguste](https://www.linkedin.com/in/augustelefevre/), [Pierre,](https://linkedin.com/in/pierre-dorge-3372bb16a) and [Titouan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/titouan-launay/?locale=en_US) and we’re building [Onedoc](https://www.onedoclabs.com/).

## Why do documents feel so outdated?

Billions of PDFs are generated daily: invoices, contracts, receipts, tickets,… yet there are no toolkits to allow companies to easily build them. Developers need to get their hands dirty to produce basic documents - let alone beautiful ones. This makes PDFs hard to dynamize and maintain, leading to poor brand experience and flawed analytics.

## What does Onedoc bring to the table?

Onedoc bridges the gap between developers and documents. We make modern web technologies work for PDF generation: React, Tailwind, … In turn, developers can make highly dynamic documents and iterate quickly. **What used to take hours now takes seconds with our API.**

To make it even faster, we maintain an [open-source library](https://github.com/onedoclabs/react-print) of beautiful components and we offer a hosting and tracking service to better understand your documents.

## What brought us here

We previously worked with giant firms, where documents were central to most workflows. They would get passed around, get into client’s hands, and everyone would complain about their layout and lack of proper information. While at a large mining company, clients would want to see shipping information and product details on their invoices. However, the development team wouldn’t be able to update these documents because the task was too complex and expensive.

## Interested in generating beautiful documents today?

* **Try it now,** and give us feedback!

launches.body:
Hey everyone! We’re [**Pascal**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/pascal-wieler/) and [**Ken**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ken-hendricks-96181611a/), here to introduce you to [**Basepilot**](https://www.basepilot.com/).

# **TL;DR:**

Basepilot creates AI assistants to automate repetitive and manual work across a browser. We help companies save 30% of their time weekly and cut costs, freeing up resources for more high-value tasks. For example, finance, recruitment, or sales teams can automate mundane back-office tasks within a few clicks and a quick demonstration.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79264&key=user_uploads/842820/08fef875-2fb5-427c-a017-7cf356bd6ed7)

# **Where Basepilot can help you:**

* **Sales** - To help automate sales outreach, prospecting, and follow-ups.
* **Recruitment** - To help with sourcing candidates and clients, and analyzing and triaging profiles.
* **Finance** - To help fill in applications/forms, transfer data, do accounting ops, and update customer details.
* & any other manual task across your browser!

# **Problem - 30% of a business’s total time and resources is wasted on mundane repetitive work**

Currently, businesses employ teams of knowledge workers (in sales, ops, recruitment, finance, and more) that face a lot of manual and repetitive processes that slow them down. Although critical to get done, these tasks take hours away from doing more high-value work leading to frustration and lower output among teams.

**For a business, this results in:**

* 30% of their team’s time wasted on mindless tasks
* Wasted resources spent on hiring more people to handle the workload
* Increased error rates through manual boring work

For example, a recruitment firm spends 8+ hours/week per recruiter on repetitive admin work to source candidates, analyze applications and enter data, instead of talking to candidates!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79264&key=user_uploads/842820/e1bb23d2-968a-4748-be21-d45be443f4f1)

**Existing solutions suck!**

* Off-the-shelf tools often don’t work as workflows are very specific to a company.
* Automating processes with tools like UI Path is extremely expensive, requires specialist automation engineers and takes several weeks or months to set up.

# **Solution - Automate repetitive tasks in minutes**

Basepilot makes it super easy for a business to build and train their own AI employees, enabling anyone in the company to automate their mundane and repetitive work, freeing up time for more high-value tasks.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TxvHeF--NU4>

We designed Basepilot with these core principles in mind:

* **Works where you work:** Basepilot works across the tools you already use right in your browser as a Chrome extension. No need to adopt new tools or change your workflows.
* **Teach it like a human:** There’s no need to get technical or hire an expensive automation team, simply train your new assistant to complete work, just like you’d teach a human: by showing and telling.
* **Faster ROI (at lower cost):** Automate workflows in minutes, not weeks or months. Unlike traditional automation tools, Basepilot can get set up and operational in a fraction of the time & cost.
* **Keep control:** Basepilot operates in your tabs, allowing you to check in and see what’s happening in real-time while you focus on more high-value work, e.g. engaging in customer conversations while Basepilot sources new leads in the background.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79264&key=user_uploads/842820/ce3bce79-8335-4901-9c9d-b6cd949a410b)

launches.body:
Hi everyone! We’re [Philip](https://linkedin.com/in/philipkoenig), [Kyle](https://linkedin.com/in/kyle-manuel-franz-7a4351a8), and [Daniel](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dcervoni/) from [CommodityAI](https://commodityai.io/). We are building a platform for commodity traders to manage their shipments.

**tl;dr** CommodityAI makes it easy for commodity trading companies to manage their shipments. One of the largest sugar traders uses our product to classify over a million documents, extract relevant fields from them, and organize them by shipment. They also use us to execute shipment-related workflows, like sending shipment status updates and generating vessel nominations.

# **The Problem**

Shipping commodities requires a company to manage \~200 processes and over 50 documents. Now imagine you're managing thousands of shipments a month, and tens of thousands in a year. As a result, a trading company’s workforce spends \~70% of their day on admin and 40% of operating costs are allocated to labor. Almost all of our customer calls have had one thing in common: the trader or operations person can recall a time in the past 6 months when a document or process error resulted in the firm losing hundreds of thousands of dollars.

These processes also differ between customers. In other words, no 2 customers run their commodity trading operations the exact same way. This makes it difficult to build a one-size-fits-all solution without being intimately familiar with the space and the nuances of these shipments.

# **The Solution**

We’ve built AI, automation, and collaborative tools built specifically for commodities trading. Our customers use CommodityAI to manage thousands of shipments and process millions of shipment-related documents. This includes classifying them, extracting relevant fields, and organizing them. They also use our platform to automate a series of time-consuming, related tasks that they do in their day-to-day, such as tracking vessels, generating vessel nominations, and sending real-time updates to their counterparty.

**Document Processing Workflow: Classify, Extract data, create shipment**

launches.body:
Hi! We’re [Serena Ge](https://linkedin.com/in/serena-ge-4583731b4) and [Charley Lee](https://linkedin.com/in/charley-lee) from [Datacurve](https://datacurve.ai/)!

Datacurve provides expert quality code data at scale from highly skilled software engineers.

* **Generative AI dev-tool startups** use custom data for models to optimize for tasks such as code editing, design to code, PR generation, etc.
* **Foundation model** **labs** need expert data to improve general model coding capabilities like code debugging, code completion, code explanation, and others.

### **The Problem – Why getting high-quality code data is _so hard_**

From our experience training models, we believe the biggest bottleneck of progressing vertical LLM capabilities is the lack of curated, high-quality training data.

Acquiring this high-quality data is difficult because:

1. **Consistent, high-quality code data cannot be synthetically generated or scraped**. Tasks are often too challenging or specific for even the most capable models, and even a few incorrect samples can noticeably worsen the final training results.
2. **Hiring human annotators is tricky**. Manual data labeling en masse tends towards low-skill gig work; it’s difficult to hire and retain highly competent engineers as annotators.

### **The Solution**

We solve the data problem with our gamified annotation platform that attracts the best engineers to come and solve fun coding problems. We have already brought on top competitive programmers, as well as highly competent engineers who have worked at companies like Amazon and AMD.

In general, we get great engineers who **1) already have good careers**, and **2) already enjoy doing programming challenges outside of work**. Our gamified platform pays them for solving problems, which they already do for fun.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79129&key=user_uploads/620797/f311b3ee-119f-4564-9ebb-f3e9342d2781)

Data for **AI dev-tool startups** to train use-case specific models:

* UI design to React components generation
* Framework-specific optimized code generation
* Repository-wide automatic PRs from GitHub issues
* Intelligent coding copilot integrated IDEs. Data for code completion and debugging

For **foundation model labs**, the kinds of data our platform creates are:

* Refactoring code for readability
* Improving code for performance
* Code generation for difficult problems or new features
* Debugging runtime errors
* Code walkthrough and explanation

### **Our Team’s story **[**🧗‍♀️**](https://emojipedia.org/woman-climbing)** → 👨‍💻 → 👴 →**[**📊**](https://emojipedia.org/bar-chart)

In high school, I built a climbing training app with World Cup climbers, used by 3700 athletes from over 17 countries. Using the app I made myself, I qualified for Nationals twice!

This building experience was so amazing that it made me decide to study CS at UWaterloo, where I kept bumping into [Charley Lee](https://linkedin.com/in/charley-lee) in AI reading groups and advanced CS classes. So we started building together:

While Charley interned at Google, we made a planning tool called UncleGPT that reached 930 users who created 1.3k projects and sent 5.5k messages on our platform.

I interned at Cohere, where I trained models to improve reasoning capabilities through solving algorithms and gameplay.

We’re 19 now and building Datacurve.

![](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1015470040755208252/1214702964816617544/IMG_1056.png?ex=65fa134a&is=65e79e4a&hm=b953fe679d9e73169fd4de1755f0354dc17365f7faf8178c05771fc866bebcbd&)

### **Our Ask**

* If you need **custom data** for your application (e.g., code editing, design to code, etc.), we should talk!
* If you can introduce us to more foundation model labs, that would be amazing. Feel free to email me at [serena@datacurve.ai](mailto:serena@datacurve.ai)!

Hello everyone! We’re [Harsh](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yadav-harsh/), [Sean](https://www.linkedin.com/in/seanfmitchell/), [Tom](https://www.linkedin.com/in/thomasleonardsmith/) and [Seva](https://www.linkedin.com/in/seva-levitski-4107053/). Ryse _is the only marketplace where investors who want to buy leases can trade with real estate operators who want to sell leases._

**The Problem**\
Financial institutions like banks, asset managers and insurance companies want to invest directly into the $1.5T in real estate leases originated in the US each year, but they can’t.  Why?

* There's no marketplace for buyers and sellers to meet
* There's no access to or standardization of the data required to underwrite opportunities
* There's no existing infrastructure to support trading, reporting, or payment processing

* Buyers have access to underwriting data sourced directly from custom API integrations with Sellers
* We standardize that data into a format that makes it easy to understand and compare to other investments (loans, bonds, t-bills, etc.)

launches.body:
# **tl;dr**

Hi everyone! We’re [Tyler Lehman](https://www.linkedin.com/in/tyler-lehman/) and [Arthur Chi](https://www.linkedin.com/in/arthur-chi-000/) from OpenFoundry. **We’re building the fastest developer experience for building on open source AI.** Imagine Hugging Face if it were built from the ground up for startups instead of ML researchers.

**Our first product (**[**live on GitHub**](https://github.com/openfoundry-ai/model_manager)**) is a command-line tool to deploy open source models onto your own cloud with a single line of code.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79580&key=user_uploads/1579075/6f0eccb2-7717-484c-8b4e-070258698d0c)

[Here’s a demo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=49ay9Gqbc1U) where we ship Microsoft’s Phi-2 model to our cloud. A couple of lines of code to deploy, and in just minutes the server is ready for inference.

# **🔮 Open source AI is the future**

AI is the new layer in the tech stack. It’s as big a shift as cloud and mobile were two decades ago. **We believe open source AI will dominate this market**. Open source is catching up to the competition, and there’s a compelling business case for it: it’s faster & cheaper for many use cases, it can be self-hosted, and it reduces platform risk.

# **❌ But there’s a big problem: the developer experience is _rough_**

As great as open source models have become, the developer experience around them is bad. You have to cobble many components together and must trudge through poor documentation, flaky APIs, hacked-together solutions, and clunky cloud configs. **All of this slows developers down.**

In contrast, closed source companies like OpenAI provide an easy developer platform that just works out of the box with almost zero effort.

**We’ve talked to many startups who are interested in moving more of their workloads onto open source models, but they feel stuck** with their expensive closed source solutions because it’s so painful to switch.

# **✅ We’re solving this by making the experience effortless**

**We built developer tools and communities at our previous jobs!** Prior to YC, Tyler built developer platforms for Instagram and WhatsApp that are used by more than a million developers. Arthur built large-scale APIs at Slack for products used by more than 350K customers.

launches.body:
**TL;DR:**  In traditional industries like financial services, knowledge feels stuck.  Existing knowledge bases weren’t designed for LLMs, and the time it takes for marketing and support teams to access information negatively impacts retention, loyalty, and sentiment.  Senso is building an AI-powered knowledge base to expand customer relationships, starting in the Credit Union space.

### **THE TEAM**

Hey YC! 

We’re Saroop and Tom, the founders of [Senso.](https://senso.ai/) Over the past decade, we’ve been developing AI solutions for banks and credit unions, which provide marketing and support teams with insights to boost customer retention rates. 

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/DAfnwslYaXLHlOwYDuTl2NRqS8xF2yykeRCwLt2h5lOnasJNX6KT_sGiK5eArtdcO_vVGruqBTLT_ygSd76mPmbrICMMdBX16FGO7OHl0-lZbWe5dHrYKGmmFnkKoP6tmk9BQAZPHfKZiGCB80AB5cs)

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/F8grB5SIoPZ_vbvBAWd2S0I4SHpNIwGbYHu9PRBBLqUZaQjnVwCOkoVCWZhYAsSmm8zQlXHN7VLkRIGZsCmTSYql37Sd3hcet5UdSDKz8TpeZ8Y7mDFCpWLec8Mi0wo7XwsZJpszME2gWgKDrw-xHf8)

Consider the following scenarios, which we see happen over and over again: 

* You contact your financial institution only to be put on hold for up to 10 minutes and then transferred to another department.  
* You get offers which are not at all relevant to your life circumstances.

Sound familiar? This type of experience has become the norm in industries like financial services leading to frustrated customers and missed opportunities. 

### **PROBLEM**

We’ve started in the US Credit Union industry. Why Credit Unions? Because expanding member relationships is their highest priority. Currently, inefficient means in accessing information, policies and procedures, and past behavior bring unexpected overhead.  A few examples:

1. **Service Delays:** 40% of members are put on hold by support teams, sometimes for up to 5-7 minutes, due to difficulties in accessing policies, procedures, and member information.
2. **Marketing Relevance:** Marketing teams face 2-4 week delays in obtaining behavioral data, resulting in missed opportunities to provide personalized service.

These challenges, common across nearly 5000 Credit Unions, stem from an inefficient system for aggregating data and surfacing member behavior, intent, interactions, and policies & procedures in a timely fashion.

### **SOLUTION**

Senso is building an AI-powered Knowledge Base designed for traditional enterprises, starting with Credit Unions. Our product provides a flexible way to centralize enterprise knowledge, such as documents and conversational data, that LLMs utilize to improve information flow across support and marketing teams.

Our GTM strategy is to partner with industry leaders to distribute our product. In the Credit Union space, we’ve partnered with [CU 2.0](https://cu-2.com/) to launch an industry-specific version of Senso called _CuCopilot_, built using our APIs.

Here’s an example of how our growing customer base is using our product to provide more timely and personalized service to members.

1. Ingest and summarize thousands of conversations so that support and marketing teams can understand what members are asking. Examples of metrics surfaced are sentiment and call purpose.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77419&key=user_uploads/174638/10e5893a-1b2d-45ea-86c1-fedca7b51580)

2. In this example, the Credit Union decides to track members speaking about loan and account openings, and sets a frequency to auto-generate weekly FAQ’s based on interactions.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77419&key=user_uploads/174638/4df28765-c44b-4c70-a05e-8265a7652fcc)

3. Once the FAQ is generated, support agents can better answer questions related to loan and account openings by searching for auto-generated responses.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77419&key=user_uploads/174638/a187222e-e718-43b7-8044-1d343f16f440)


One of our customers, TruStone Financial, has seen a significant uptick in the speed in which they are able to answer questions, and their documentation has improved response quality significantly.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77419&key=user_uploads/174638/9577b7e4-2d4a-4bb5-9982-41fce71918cc)

### **ASKS FROM FOUNDERS**

1. **Know anyone at a Credit Union?**  If our product may be of interest to anyone running a P&L, an introduction would be appreciated.
2. **Developers:**  We’ve onboarded API partners like [TribalScale](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/tribalscale-partners-senso-ai-unleash-150000474.html?guccounter=1&guce_referrer=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZ29vZ2xlLmNvbS8&guce_referrer_sig=AQAAAJ5FFiJ4Pej-4tSgYnh45PteFM4xrVRuwXZZK3mvqK-lUuciuSI9jY88Qq7pom6NihzRn_otmzscFaXUov7dVagdrP2C-ZVpmIHbxdyR9N4P7PlewKr1KQdt7hZlCgiBeemMC-EHObWOeEYPwiYj4OdcjifctXfZVtvtxXacNFw4) and [Fundmore](https://ncfacanada.org/fundmore-x-senso-ai-launch-solution-to-transform-lending/) to launch AI-powered knowledge bases in their products and industries. If you’re a developer interested in doing the same, we’ll set you up with an API Key.
3. **YC Alum:**  While our solution has primarily been targeted at Credit Unions, we are getting demand from other industries, and if our solution is of interest to you, please reach out to explore.
4. **Fellow Founders:** We look forward to getting to know you!  Please reach out if there’s a potential partnership opportunity.

Thank you,

launches.body:
**TL;DR**: SiLogy is building a platform for chip developers to run tests, track test statistics, and collaborate on debugging.

—

Hey, we’re [Paul](https://linkedin.com/in/paul-kim-7b766262) and [Kay](https://linkedin.com/in/kay-li-84924128b), the cofounders of [SiLogy](https://silogy.io). We’re building chip design and verification tools to speed up the semiconductor development cycle.

## **The Problem**

Interest in designing new chips is growing, thanks to demand from AI and the predicted decline of Moore’s Law. Since the number of possible states grows exponentially with chip complexity, the need for testing in simulation is exploding, with chip developers already spending 70% of their time on testing. (See this video on the [verification gap](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rtaaOdGuMCc)).

Tooling hasn’t kept up. The state-of-the-art in collaborative debugging is to walk to a coworker’s desk and point to an error in a log file or waveform file. Each chip company rolls out its own tooling and infra to deal with this—this was Kay’s entire job at his last gig. But they want to work on chips, not devtools! The solutions they come up with are often inadequate and frustrating. That’s why we started SiLogy.

## **The solution**

SiLogy is a web app to manage the entire digital verification workflow. (“Digital verification” means testing the logic of the design and includes everything before the physical design of the chip. It’s the most time-consuming stage in verification.)

We combine three capabilities:

**Test running, results, and statistics**: Our CI tool runs tests in the cloud, allowing engineering teams unlimited flexibility in scaling their test volume. We also track each project’s progress in test coverage and test pass rate.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79226&key=user_uploads/151331/d9a4d2a6-9662-4ee6-8eef-e735b10885b6)

**Killer application-specific features**: We’re building features tailored for verification use cases. We incorporate a test orchestration framework, waveform viewer, coverage report, and other features specifically for verification teams, providing customers an advantage over competitors using a generic CI solution such as Jenkins.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79226&key=user_uploads/151331/d2beb46c-884b-4fec-b731-698c1c0a2312)

**Collaboration**: soon you’ll be able to send a link to and leave a comment on a specific location within a log or waveform file, just like in Google Docs.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79226&key=user_uploads/151331/db8f1954-dafb-4a9e-b739-1b883c4963ac)

## **Asks**

If you have experience with Verilog, even just from college, give our product a try at <https://dash.silogy.io/signup>. Tell your loved ones who work on chip or FPGA design and verification to give us a try as well.

If you have thoughts on the state of verification, get in touch at [paul@silogy.io](mailto:paul@silogy.io). If you or someone you know wants a demo, schedule a meeting with us [here](https://calendly.com/d/5gd-rf6-66h/silogy-product-demo).

Thanks for your support!

launches.title: Spur - testing infrastructure for your mobile apps
launches.tagline: test and validate your mobile apps in plain english.
launches.body:
hey everyone 👋 we're Sneha and Anushka, co-founders of [Spur](https://www.spurtest.com/).

### **TL;DR** Spur is building the validation infrastructure for software teams. We started with web testing, and today we're launching native app testing across iOS and Android.

Spur is building the validation infrastructure for software teams. We started with web testing, and today we're launching native app testing across iOS and Android.

Spur's agents test your apps the way real users do. You define the behavior you want to test in natural language, and Spur figures out how to execute and validate it across iOS and Android, native interactions, and web views.

Teams at HelloFresh, Nextdoor, DocuSign, Bilt, Alo Yoga, and Abercrombie are already using Spur for testing across their digital experience – on websites and on their apps.

**Our Ask:** If you’re building and maintaining a mobile app, we'd love to help you test it.\
Book a demo:[ https://spurtest.com/book-a-demo](https://spurtest.com/book-a-demo)

## **The problem**

Software is getting generated faster than ever: features that used to take days to build are now generated in minutes. But - once the feature exists, someone still has to figure out whether it actually works.

That validation process hasn't sped up at the same rate.

If you’re shipping mobile apps, this gets even harder. The same product flow often turns into separate automation for ios and android. Teams maintain the tests, the device infrastructure they run on, and the CI setup around them.

And as your product changes, your automation has to change with it.

## **The solution**

1. **Natural Language allows you to define the “intent” of a test:**

   Most test automation describes exactly _how_ to use an application.

   _Find this element. Tap it. Wait for another element. Enter text. Assert a value._

   That makes the test tightly coupled to the implementation. Spur tests describe what the user should be able _to do_ instead.

   _Add an item to cart, apply a promo code, and complete checkout with Apple Pay._

   The test captures the intent of the flow. Spur figures out how to execute it against the application in front of it. This means the same test can keep working across platforms or ui changes, because the thing you’re testing - the user behavior - hasn’t changed.
2. **Spur runs the infrastructure too**

   You upload the builds and choose what you want to validate. Spur handles the environment those tests execute in and runs them on our infrastructure. That means mobile testing becomes much closer to:

   _build → upload → validate_

   instead of becoming its own infrastructure project.

   Tests can run as part of a release, against a pull request, on a schedule, or whenever an engineer wants to validate a change.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=116412&key=user_uploads/700570/52f7df91-1940-4f7c-a2df-4299adbee3e3)

3. **Built for engineers and agents**

   As more software is written by coding agents, we think validation also needs to become something agents can use directly.

   MCP is a first-class interface to Spur. A coding agent can make a change, ask Spur to validate the relevant user flows, inspect the result, fix what failed, and run the validation again.

   So the loop starts to look like:

   _generate → validate → fix → validate → ship_

   Humans can define the intent, using anything as context (tickets, figma files, PRDs, your codebase). Agents can continuously check whether the software still satisfies it.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=116412&key=user_uploads/700570/1438d0de-f515-48cf-8f6c-4c478e4a7dba)


## **Why we built this**

We've spent the last few years building testing infrastructure for large software teams.

One thing has become increasingly clear: writing software is becoming dramatically easier, while proving that software works is still slow and expensive.

We think the gap between software generation and our ability to validate it is only going to widen.

The future of testing isn't maintaining more and more scripts. Validation needs to become more intelligent, adaptive, and be able to keep up with the rate at which software is changing.

That's what we're building at Spur.

If you're building or maintaining a mobile app, we'd love to work with you: <https://spurtest.com/book-a-demo>.

Oftentimes, they require customization, and hence, the need for logistics service providers to hire development agencies to build bespoke customizations and internal tools on top of these systems to make them easier to work with. 

An alternative these companies resort to is to build an internal system from scratch to fit their business needs. However, such an undertaking is long, costly, and is oftentimes a distraction from their core business.

Our first product is an AI-powered API suite that allows logistics service providers to build custom automations for mundane tasks related to their TMS. \

We digitize subcontractor invoicing and payment approvals (valuations) and connect them to the respective quality checks of the works, trade handovers, and live progress. \
\
[Konstructly](https://konstructly.com/) not only streamlines manual processes and provides unparalleled visibility, it drives productivity from contractors’ supply chains using the ultimate incentive - cash.

# Team 👷👷👷

Hi everyone, we’re [Dima](https://linkedin.com/in/dmitryvim), [John](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/www.linkedin.com/mwlite/profile/in/john-hesler), and [Stefan](https://linkedin.com/in/stefanvukcevic), and we’re on a mission to prevent overspend in construction. We’re doing this by ‘following the money’ and mapping payments directly to their corresponding works on-site.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77091&key=user_uploads/1005097/6f11951c-d0eb-4ec6-854c-db4c448cf807)

# 

# The Problem ❌

In construction, Production— those doing and managing the build on-site— are disconnected from Commercial, those responsible for the project’s finances and profitability. \
\
This ultimately results in overspending. \
\
For example, quantity surveyors spend 25-50% of their time processing subcontractor invoices, mostly because they don’t have the necessary data on hand. They also spend a lot of time on low-value, manual tasks like data entry. This means that they spend less time on high-value tasks like tendering and procurement, where oversights result in costly mistakes. \
\
Lack of visibility means that a lot of stuff gets swept under the carpet, only to resurface at the end of a project (eg. variations). It also means that subcontractors are less accountable as it’s more difficult to prove things, resulting in reduced productivity, more rework, and longer delays. 

# 

# The Solution ✅

A single app connecting Production and Commercial stakeholders, entities, and workflows, to save time, increase visibility and incentivize productivity.

# 

# How It Works 👨🏻‍💻

Subcontractors’ site teams log their progress for approval/QA by the general contractor’s (GC) site team and for handover acceptance by the next trade. This progress auto-fills their applications, saving their commercial team a lot of time.

The GC’s commercial team then just has to amend/review as necessary in a simple, purpose-built interface, with all the production data visible (progress, QA, handover acceptance). It makes valuing and approving the subcontractor’s work a lot quicker and provides much more control/visibility. This incentivizes subcontractors to build the right first time (productivity) as GCs can more easily identify inadequacies and withhold payments until works/tasks are performed properly, in their entirety.\
\
Recorded Handovers are extremely powerful - general contractors are finally able to capture responsible parties and quantify delays, allowing them to enforce liquidated damages or, at the very least, have more leverage in final account negotiation. This encourages prompt and correct behavior from both parties, once again relying on cash to drive productivity.

# 

# How We Came Across the Problem 💡

Stefan previously built and operated a construction labor marketplace. \
\
He handled invoicing and payments between the subcontractor and contractor, needing to manually unify all the different document formats (photos of handwritten statements, WhatsApp lists, emails, word docs, spreadsheets, etc) and manage the endless back and forth between multiple stakeholders - who all had different opinions on what work had been done and how much should be paid! \
\
Not only was the submission and approval process extremely inefficient, but there was no visibility over the corresponding works or their quality checks, massively increasing risk and friction between the parties. Something had to change!

# 

# Our Ask 🙏

Connect us with relevant constructions peeps! eg. Those at general contractors/house builders turning over $20m/year. \
\
Drop Stefan an email at: [stefan@konstructly.com](mailto:stefan@konstructly.com)

launches.title: Integuru ⚡️ Generate fast, reliable APIs for any platform
launches.tagline: We help agents control any external system, with speed and reliability.
launches.body:
📝 **TL;DR:** [Integuru](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/29498) **generates fast, reliable, and high-throughput APIs for any platform.** API calls complete in \~**3 seconds** with **99.9%+ success**. No RPA or browsers. No data caching needed. Customers are already using fully generated integrations in production at millions of requests per month.

Starting today, Integuru is **publicly accessible** and **free to try**! You can **use it** [here](https://app.integuru.com/).

### **🎬 Integuru in Action**

<https://youtu.be/v00yl_46H34>

### 🎯 **The Problem**

AI agents need to access external platforms, but most platforms don’t offer official, accessible, or comprehensive APIs. **That makes integration the single biggest bottleneck.**

For building integrations, most companies today use RPA, typically implemented via browser automation. RPA is easy to set up, but many AI companies have now **outgrown their RPA implementations**. They’re running into issues with **latency**, **reliability**, and **throughput**. A single API call can take minutes, and integrations are vulnerable to breaking due to frontend changes.

With RPA, there’s a relatively low ceiling on the number of concurrent browser instances on the same platform. This limits the number of requests. As customer counts grow, companies require higher throughput, but RPA, by nature, cannot support that demand.

At the same time, regardless of the approach you take to integrate, **edge cases are among** **the biggest causes of integration breakage**. Edge cases are different branching logic, states, and paths that appear in real-world usage across accounts and scenarios. Integrations that seem fine during testing can completely break in production.

Edge cases can be caused by things like:

* conditionally appearing fields and pages
* hidden business logic depending on inputs
* varying server behaviors

Traditionally, testing edge cases must be done manually. Developers must manually trigger as many variations as possible, including changing inputs and stress-testing server limits. This process is often tedious and cannot cover everything, which threatens integration reliability.

Today, we’re announcing a **publicly accessible,** **self-serve product** that solves all these issues and generates robust APIs in minutes.

### 📈 **Integuru’s Solution**

Integuru is an AI platform that **automatically reverse-engineers a website’s backend**. It generates integrations that directly ping website servers, with API docs for each.

Integuru **covers edge cases** that arise during production workloads. It also **auto-heals authentication flows**. Meanwhile, we have a **24/7 on-call maintenance team** available, with **hands-on support** whenever human intervention is needed.

In real production environments for early-access partners (many of which are YC companies!), requests complete in **\~3 seconds** with **99.9%+ success**, including deployments **above 1M requests/month/platform**. Requests are **executed live** and achieve low latency without data-caching.

The workflow is simple with minimal manual involvement:

1. On Integuru, input the website and account you want to integrate with.
2. Describe your desired feature in natural language. (No need to manually perform or record any actions.)
3. Integuru proposes an API schema and, upon your approval, generates the endpoint in \~10 minutes, along with API docs.

Endpoints are **immediately testable** and **production-ready**. For authentication, we support 2FA and will coordinate with you.

We already support the majority of platforms today. If Integuru can’t yet handle your use case automatically, we’ll evaluate and provide hands-on support at no extra cost.

### **🙋‍♂️ What industries have been using Integuru?**

Early-access partners are already using generated APIs in production across use cases, processing millions of requests per month with minimal human involvement.

* Healthcare: connecting to EHRs, EMRs, RCMs, CTMSes, insurance portals, etc.
  * We sign BAAs at no cost. You can sign a BAA directly in the product.
* Logistics: integrating with TMSes, WMSes, ERPs, carrier portals, etc.
* Proptech: automating property management systems, utilities, permitting software, etc.
* Legal: controlling practice/case management systems, government portals, etc.
* Enterprise AI transformation: accessing ERPs, CRMs, CX platforms, internal tools, etc.
* … and more

## 📚 **Backstory**

Our first [open-source](https://github.com/Integuru-AI/Integuru) agent (4k+ stars) proved demand for robust integrations, but it couldn’t handle the complexity of modern platforms. So we did things that didn’t scale. We manually built and maintained integrations for customers, eventually supporting millions of API calls every month. That gave us a front-row seat to the messy reality of integrations. We tried turning those learnings into a self-serve product, but that version still wasn’t enough, so we kept dogfooding it while building customer integrations. Eventually, we rebuilt the self-serve product from the ground up, using insights we gathered around edge-case coverage, auto-healing, better UX, production reliability, and high-throughput execution. This is the product you see today, and companies are already using it to generate integrations that run reliably in production.

## 🚀 **Try for free today!**

Integuru is **publicly accessible** starting today and **free to try**!

You can **get started on your own** [here](https://app.integuru.com/), or **schedule an onboarding call [here](https://calendly.com/alan-taiki/integuru-guided-setup)** if you want us to set up everything for free or have specific questions.

launches.tagline: Recover 99% of import taxes on goods you export or destroy
launches.body:
**tl;dr:** Forge helps companies recover tariffs and duties paid on imported goods that are later exported or scrapped by automating a process called duty drawback. Most companies don’t file for drawbacks because it can be complicated & cumbersome. We solve this by taking on all the work for our customers from organizing data to filing, and automating it behind the scenes. Reach out to us at: [www.forgehq.com](http://www.forgehq.com).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89310&key=user_uploads/89898/703a07d3-3dad-49eb-9cd3-1c80cd2719a9)

Hello everyone! We're Emir and Haris, two brothers and the co-founders of Forge! We’re here to help companies save money on their tariffs & duties.

Haris (left) is the CTO of Forge. Before Forge, he worked at Facebook and Vanguard as a backend engineer. Emir (right) is the CEO of Forge. Previously he was a lead engineer with experience designing, building, and testing rocket engines at Blue Origin and Stoke Space. At Stoke, Emir was part of a small team that became the fastest to ever go from seed funding to engine hot fire.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89310&key=user_uploads/1181593/44c70c94-7705-4dd2-8c02-215f92c83d2e)

🧩 **The problem:**

Last year, the US collected over $85 billion in import duties, and that number will increase dramatically with the newly established tariffs. However, when a business imports goods, they are allowed to claim a refund on the taxes they paid if they later export or scrap goods - this process is called duty drawbacks.

$6 billion dollars of recoverable duties go unclaimed every year, and that was before Trump’s new tariffs. Most companies don’t file for drawbacks because the process is extremely cumbersome & complicated. The biggest companies have compliance teams & specialized customs brokers supporting them on multi-million dollar claims, but if you’re a small or medium-sized business, you have no options. Supply chain teams don’t have the time to manage all the work needed to run a drawback program, and brokers avoid supporting claims under $500k.

💡 **Our solution:**

Our team provides duty drawback as a white glove service while leveraging AI and custom internal tools to automate the work. This allows us to serve more businesses, while also requiring little to no effort from our customers. We file all paperwork with customs, extract all necessary data, and do the work to maximize their refund. The best part: it’s free upfront— we only get paid when our customers get paid.

Supply chain & logistics are hard. Tariffs & duties make it even harder. We are here to make it easy for businesses to claim the revenue they deserve.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89310&key=user_uploads/1181593/8a06bd8f-bb66-428f-a439-d9727f160284)

\
