launches.title: Osmosis: Unlocking Real-Time Learning for AI Agents
launches.tagline: Osmosis gives AI agents the ability to learn like DeepSeek R1, all in real-time
launches.body:
What if AI agents could immediately learn from their mistakes?

## TL;DR

While AI agent capabilities continue to improve, the agentic workflows remain brittle since agents aren’t able to learn from tasks in real-time. Osmosis is a framework that helps your AI agents learn in real-time (similar to DeepSeek R1’s post-training loop) in order to make them better, faster, and more responsive.

On the first run, we scored 21.5% accuracy, which is 60% better than base 4o performance (16X more expensive!). **This means that even on a first run, we're 25X+ more cost effective than base 4o - and that would be significantly better on a second run.** We also averaged 7.5 steps per task while OpenAI Operator averaged 67 steps per task (faster and cheaper!).

If you’re building AI agents and want to make them better, faster, and more responsive, we’d love to chat! Email [kasey@gulp.ai](mailto:kasey@gulp.ai) or book time [here](https://calendly.com/kasey-gulp/).

## The Problem

AI agents still struggle with novel and complex (multi-step) tasks. Even OpenAI Operator (current state-of-the-art) just scores 58% accuracy on the WebArena benchmark. The worst part is that agents make the same mistakes again and again!

And even when agents can solve a task, there’s generally a lack of optimization in their process. This ends up negatively affecting performance while also driving up inefficient inference costs for users.

## The Solution

Osmosis builds and maintains a ‘library’ of an agent’s previous interactions. It’s a super simple two line addition in a developer’s agent infrastructure that:

* Ingests and understand a user’s prompt
* Queries a vector database to search for similar past scenarios
* Recommends a relevant plan of action for the task
* Quantifies an agent’s performance when it finishes, and embeds the assessment

Just like that, we have a flow that enables agents to learn in real-time with each successive task!

Here’s a head-to-head (Operator versus Claude 3.5 Sonnet + Osmosis):

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uhFuT8VD9tk>

**Osmosis was 3X faster and 6X more efficient in the number of steps taken!**

## Our Ask

If you (or anyone you know) are building AI agents and struggling with accuracy, speed, or cost, we’d love to chat and see how we can help! Please reach out at [kasey@gulp.ai](mailto:kasey@gulp.ai), or book some time directly [here](https://calendly.com/kasey-gulp/).

## The Team

We’ve (Kasey and Andy) known each other for over a decade!

launches.title: Cuckoo: Real-time AI translator for global sales, marketing, and support
launches.tagline: Cuckoo helps companies like Snowflake and PagerDuty talk to their global customers, even in the most technical discussions.
launches.body:
### **TLDR**

[**Cuckoo**](https://www.cuckoo.so) is a real-time AI translator for global sales, marketing, and support. Companies like Snowflake and PagerDuty use Cuckoo in Zoom and in-person meetings for even the most technical discussions. 

Here an example of us having a product, sales, and partner meeting with our W25 batchmates and one of our partners in Japan: [**https://youtu.be/7fq7wr_S8p0**](https://youtu.be/7fq7wr_S8p0)

— 

Hey everyone! We are [Yong Hee](https://www.linkedin.com/in/harryyongheelee/) and [Gunwoo](https://www.linkedin.com/in/gunwooterry/) and we are building Cuckoo to help global teams talk to their customers worldwide. [Give it a try](https://www.cuckoo.so) in your next global meeting 🌏

### **Why?**

**Language barriers are a big challenge even for global companies.** We experienced this firsthand in Korea, where we hosted community meetups, inviting product leaders around the world.

On the one hand, many nuances and details can get lost between languages, especially during technical conversations. On the other hand, speakers often felt isolated, unable to follow Korean discussions, and missed valuable opportunities to network and promote their products.

### **Problem**

Take Matt, a Solutions Engineer at PagerDuty APJ, who engages weekly with customers in Korea and Japan. These conversations are complicated not just by language barriers but also by technical details—think complex troubleshooting scenarios.

### **Solution**

**Cuckoo provides real-time translation tailored for you and your customers.** It instantly learns technical details from your documents—pitch decks, meeting notes, API docs—and delivers context-aware translation in 20+ languages.

### **How it works**

Invite Cuckoo to your online meeting. For in-person conversations, you can capture audio directly from your laptop.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87400&key=user_uploads/427995/829469eb-8895-44f0-b686-b2c45bb2f716)

Upload relevant documents (pitch decks, API docs, user manuals, etc.) to help Cuckoo understand the general context and key terms.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87400&key=user_uploads/427995/64f98ba9-db35-43ca-b791-45ca41cd442f)

As the conversation unfolds, your and your customer can view live translations in your preferred languages.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87400&key=user_uploads/427995/cd8cd259-5e60-4bb2-bfd1-808ea19577bc)

### **How our customers use Cuckoo**

We—_our first customer_—use Cuckoo everyday to demo and collect user feedback. Here’s how other teams use Cuckoo. 

* Snowflake — Hosting global customers at their Customer Experience Centers


* PagerDuty — Troubleshooting with local cloud partners in Korea and Japan
* ClickHouse — Team sync between the APAC and HQ office
* dbt Labs — Webinars for APAC customers and partners
* Weights & Biases — Hosting Seoul and Tokyo meetups with HQ executives

Cuckoo is also used by enterprises beyond the tech industry, including healthcare (SNOMED), manufacturing (SeAH Steel), and retail (GS).

### **Asks**

Are you dealing with cross-regional operations? Do you work with international customers regularly, or are you planning to expand into new markets?

* **Try out Cuckoo** at [www.cuckoo.so](http://www.cuckoo.so) — your first conversation is on us!
* **Let’s chat!** — We can hop on a quick call—we’ll speak in Korean and Japanese so you can see how Cuckoo works with different languages.
* [**Schedule a meeting**](https://cal.com/cuckoohq/30min) — We’d love to learn more about your language challenges and how we can help. 
* **Email us** at [founders@cuckoo.so](https://mailto:founders@cuckoo.so) — Tell us how your first meeting went, and send any feedback or thoughts!

### **A bit about us**

[Gunwoo](https://www.linkedin.com/in/gunwooterry/) and [Yong Hee](https://www.linkedin.com/in/harryyongheelee/) first met in 2015 through a student club at KAIST, where we organized an annual international conference for undergraduate students. Since then, we have been talking about starting a company together.

launches.body:
**Olive connects to your database and 3rd-party services and builds internal tools for you in minutes.** Just prompt it with what you need.

[Introducing Olive:](https://youtu.be/UVM4ty9nUDI)

# **Problem**

Internal tools are incredibly valuable for companies and startups of every size—they give you valuable insights on what’s going on inside your product and speed up complex workflows. Unfortunately, building them is still a pain.

Companies either:

1. Take time to build these from scratch
2. Use existing providers and sometimes spend hours building a dashboard (it should take minutes).

Often times, they **know** these tools are needed, but it feels wrong to move engineering time away from what matters most: the actual product. Thus, the solution is to either put it in the backlog, or dedicate time building and forever maintaining them.

# **🫒 Our Solution**

With Olive, building these internal tools will take minutes.

You can connect your data sources during onboarding, and select which one Olive should read and generate around for each tool. **Olive will examine your database schema, write appropriate queries, and generate + deploy a full-stack internal tool.**

We’ve been hard at work to ensure the results are consistently high-quality, so that we can use this product ourselves. We’re excited to accept users off our waitlist in the coming weeks, as we support more database integrations and features.

# **Our Ask**

We’d love to have you on our waitlist — [fromolive.com.](https://fromolive.com/)

If you’re curious about our product, want to explore use cases, or want to chat about anything internal tool related, feel free to email us at [**team@fromolive.com**](mailto:team@fromolive.com).

We ([**Bardia**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bardiasafari) and [**Shrey**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/shreyguptaoc/)) have known each other for almost 6 years (since high school) and realized how much we loved creating products that users love while building Fundsy—a fiscal sponsorship and financial services platform for community projects.

Gale is a tech platform that automates the entire H-1B application and compliance process for US employers, with independent licensed attorneys ensuring accuracy at all steps.

### **The Problem**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88070&key=user_uploads/1751117/82978c7b-fae9-48b4-8b08-a909d1852a7c)

_An email from a founder in W25 to their immigration law firm (name redacted to protect the guilty)_

We’ve talked to enough employers to know dealing with immigration sucks. Here’s why:

* Slow response times from lawyers (1-3 business days at least)
* No help on complex compliance requirements after visa approval
* Knowledge transfer and communication done via email or janky web forms
* Confusing questionnaires or document checklists

### **The Solution**

We help US employers spend as little time as possible worrying about H-1Bs and how to be compliant. Here’s how:

* Fast online data intake process with AI-powered document intake that auto-fills your application
* Easy to follow tooltips and comprehensive FAQ 
* Automated H-1B compliance for you and your team even after H-1B approval
* An **experienced immigration lawyer** handles and reviews each individual case with the same level of scrutiny as a law firm
* Fast turnaround time for legal questions
* We use english, no legal jargon

### **Moving forward**

H-1Bs are just the beginning. We’ve already started working on expanding our offering to help both consumers and businesses with other types of visas such as O-1s, Fs, Ks and TNs. The US immigration service market isn’t built for the 21st century, and we believe by using a mix of AI and professionals in the loop we can change that.

### **Our Ask**

**Know someone who is hiring or has hired H-1B workers?** Whether it’s a startup, SMB, enterprise, university, or nonprofit, we’d love an introduction! You can email us at [**rahul@getgale.app**](mailto:rahul@getgale.app).

We’d also appreciate it if you could share this post, or our demo video and follow us on [**LinkedIn**](https://www.linkedin.com/company/galeapp) to stay updated on our journey!

Rahul (CEO), Rishabh (CTO), and Haokun (CPO) have been building together since middle school and later studied at the University of Waterloo. After working at companies like NVIDIA and Tesla, they experienced the inefficiencies of the immigration process firsthand and decided to automate it.

launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

**Asteroid** is the fastest way to build self-healing browser agents, no technical experience required. \
\
Our new **AI agent builder**, **Astro**, allows you to build **complex, multistep browser agents** by building an agent graph, writing prompts, adding tools, human in the loop and guardrails.

This makes Asteroid agents suitable for **mission-critical workflows**, and more than **25 businesses** already use them in healthcare, insurance, and beyond.\
\
**Astro** **is fully available, build your agent [here](https://platform.asteroid.ai/)!**

https://youtu.be/ugY_qLTfmG8

### **What is the problem?**

Startups need to integrate with external portals (carriers, suppliers, healthcare) but can’t wait months for APIs.

Many great browser-agent frameworks have emerged in the past year, but **non-technical teams still can’t build production-grade agents.**

Operations leaders, PMs, and founders are the ones who **understand the workflows and edge cases** and _should_ be the builders. Relying on developers to constantly fix prompts for every new edge case isn’t sustainable.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96061&key=user_uploads/1651915/d73eee4d-bcc6-461f-953e-6fdd56374905)

### **Solution: Astro - AI Builder for Complex Browser Agents**

Today we’re launching **Astro**, our AI builder that lets anyone create **complex, self-healing browser agents in under 2 minutes**. Tell Astro what you want, for example _“Build an agent to pull patient data from this EHR”_, and it generates the full agent.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96061&key=user_uploads/1651915/53714daf-535a-450a-8a76-82eb70d43007)

**Astro improves the agent using previous runs.** Behind the scenes, it writes code when needed, including Playwright scripts for deterministic steps, giving everyone code-level reliability.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96061&key=user_uploads/1651915/62627740-6f1e-47ce-a197-917e01ceade7)

Every part of the agent, including graphs, prompts, and model settings, is fully visible so you can make precise, surgical edits whenever needed.

### **How does it work**

1. **Build:** Non-technical teams create agents directly in the platform. Astro generates the prompts, agent graphs, and tools needed to handle even the most complex browser workflows.
2. **Deploy:** Developers drop in a single code snippet to call the agent through Asteroid’s API/SDKs.
3. **Supervise:** Monitor live sessions, review recordings, track performance, and trigger human-in-the-loop via Slack when needed.
4. **Improve:** Non-technical teams update prompts and ship new agent versions instantly as workflows change.

### **Ship your first agent today**

**Astro** **is fully available, try it for free [here](https://platform.asteroid.ai/) or book a [demo](https://cal.com/asteroidai/15min) with a founder!**

launches.title: Asteroid: Browser Agents with Human Oversight
launches.tagline: Browser workflow automation for regulated industries
launches.body:
**Asteroid makes browser automation seamless for regulated industries.** Not only developers but also non-technical teams can **build and run our browser agents with Asteroid**, turning 45-minute manual tasks into 2-minute automated processes.

Our browser agents can navigate legacy portals, fill out forms, and extract data—all without brittle scripts, high costs, or maintenance headaches.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88012&key=user_uploads/1651915/50a0915f-b720-4fff-923b-0b84e6017098)

### **The Problem**

Traditional automation tools like RPA are too expensive for non-enterprise customers, **costing $10,000 per automation**. Meanwhile, scaleups especially in high-risk industries like insurance or healthcare lack the resources to maintain Selenium or Playwright scripts, as these frequently break due to UI changes and the automations need to be extremely reliable.

### **The Solution**

Browser agents bridge this gap—offering the flexibility of scripting with the reliability of RPA. With 2025’s computer use models, **web automation is now 100x cheaper and more robust, unlocking thousands of new use cases.**

### **How It Works**

**Asteroid transforms any browser task into an agentic workflow.** Simply show Asteroid what to do—via a screen recording, SOP, or written instructions—and get an agentic workflow. You can then call it through our web UI or API.

Behind the scenes, Asteroid spins up a secure, headless browser, handles authentication, executes workflows, and seamlessly integrates human review when needed—all without burdening your developers. We ensure the agent improves over time.\
🔗 [Watch Asteroid in action](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=26uksP36xB4)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88012&key=user_uploads/1651915/fa0c7345-c244-4270-8c56-c905072f93ea)

### **Highlighted Features**

🔹 **API-First Automation** – Trigger a browser agent in a web UI or with a single API call—no need for complex scripts or RPA setups.\
🔹 **Human-in-the-Loop** – Automate only where it’s safe, with built-in escalation for manual review when needed.\
🔹 **Intelligent Guardrails** – Set rules like “Never click this button” or “Ask before submitting” to prevent errors.\
🔹 **Continuous Learning** – Asteroid evaluates every execution, adapting to website changes and improving over time using evaluations and backtesting.

### **How We Got Here**

We’re both AI engineers who had to solve the same problem independently. Joe built AI systems that stopped $100M+ in fraud annually. David developed fraud investigation agents for fintechs.

After years of building mission-critical automation, we learned that automation only works with intelligent guardrails, human oversight, and continuous learning.

We first built Asteroid as a developer tool for safe AI deployment—offering guardrails, human-in-the-loop workflows, and continuous evaluations. But we quickly realized:

\*\*Browser agents need these safeguards even more.\*\*\
✅ **Guardrails** – "Don’t click on this."\
✅ **Human oversight** – "Ping me before you submit."\
✅ **Continuous learning** – "The website changed—adapt."

Instead of just developer tools, we’ve shifted to building browser agents with safety and reliability baked in!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88012&key=user_uploads/1651915/e9051949-8032-4fc5-951d-1fb8361ba3e1)

### **Real-World Use Cases**

We’re working with customers to automate high-value workflows like:

🔹 **Insurance Portal Automation** – Retrieve broker quotes across insurer portals—without manual input.\
🔹 **Supply Chain Scheduling** – Log into carrier platforms, retrieve GPS data, and schedule deliveries—seamlessly.\
🔹 **Expense Management** – Pull PDF bills from utility portals for expense tracking—without APIs.

### **Who is Asteroid for?**

🔹**Businesses with Heavy Manual Browser Workflows** – Automate large-scale data entry, form submissions, and repetitive portal interactions.\
🔹**Regulated Businesses using Legacy Systems** – Streamline automation for industries like insurance, healthcare and supply chain.\
🔹**AI Agent Startups** – Enable AI agents to reliably interact with legacy portals and automate browser tasks.

### **Get Started**

**Have a repetitive workflow you'd love to automate?** Let’s explore how Asteroid can help!\
🔹 [Schedule a demo](https://calendly.com/founders-asteroid-hhaf/30min?month=2025-02) to discuss your use case!\
🔹[Try our default agents](https://platform.asteroid.ai/) and see browser automation in action!

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
Software engineers are being automated in real-time, but for engineers that operate in the physical world those AI agents still don’t exist.\

launches.title: Stillwind Builder — Zero to BOM in minutes instead of days
launches.tagline: AI agent that turns your PCB design intent into a complete, verified bill of materials.
launches.body:
❌ **The problem**

Every PCB design is a constraint problem: you need components that are electrically and functionally compatible with each other. Solving it by hand means hours — often days — of tracking down parts, reading datasheets, adding a component, discovering a conflict, and backtracking. Pick an MCU and the cascade begins: it needs a specific crystal, external flash on the QSPI bus, a regulator that can source its peak current. Every choice ripples through the whole design.

✅ **The solution**

Stillwind Builder formalizes your design constraints as an explicit system of equations and solves for matching components.

* **Verified specs.** Before we show you a part, a second model independently re-reads its datasheet and verifies the specs match — so the numbers you design against are what the datasheet actually says, not extraction artifacts.
* **Dependency-aware.** When you lock in a component, the agent reads its datasheet for the supporting parts it requires — voltage regulators, crystals, external flash — and updates the constraint system. The ripple effects of each choice are handled instead of discovered later.
* **You stay in control.** You set the direction and make the calls that matter; the agent handles the combinatorial grind.

At the end, you download your BOM and start wiring.

🚀 **Try it**

The public beta is live and free during launch week: [**https://stillwind.ai**](https://stillwind.ai)

Building hardware and want to tell us what's broken? We'd genuinely love that — grab time with us: <https://calendar.app.google/Bd7KQEAYLgt6SmHZ6>

Telehealth clinics spend hundreds of thousands on ads but convert only a fraction of the patients who visit their site.

Telehealth customer acquisition is extremely expensive.

Clinics often pay hundreds, sometimes thousands, of dollars per lead, yet most visitors never convert.

After spending heavily to acquire demand, clinics rely on two imperfect tools:

* marketing automations with low engagement
* human reps who can’t scale coverage or response time

The result is lost revenue for clinics and confusing shopping experiences for patients making complex medical decisions.

High-consideration healthcare purchases shouldn’t be self-serve websites, they should be guided experiences.

Patients don’t abandon because they aren’t interested, they abandon because they have questions, uncertainty, or timing issues.

In the offline world, these purchases would involve a knowledgeable guide.\
Online, that layer has been missing.

We believe a new default is emerging: instead of navigating complex decisions alone, every buyer will have an intelligent concierge helping them evaluate, decide, and act.

**Solution**

Cenote gives every lead a personalized, persistent sales experience.

Our agents:

* reach out instantly via call and text
* answer questions and qualify needs
* follow up over days or weeks as patients decide
* support use cases like abandoned carts, failed payments, and win-backs

Every lead gets the experience of a dedicated care guide.

**The Impact**

Clinics using Cenote see:

* significantly higher conversion on existing traffic - for one clinic our agent converted at 2x the rate of a human rep
* better patient experiences

Instead of losing demand, they capture it.

**Why now**

AI can now hold natural, helpful conversations at scale.

For the first time, it’s possible to give every patient a guided buying experience, something previously only available to the highest-touch businesses.

We’d love your help!

launches.body:
### **tl;dr**

We work with specialist clinics to identify their biggest administrative blockers and deploy custom **AI** to resolve them. Right now, we’re automating **referral intake**, reducing the time it takes for clinics to process new patients and accelerate revenue collection.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u403AnLMSNE>

### **Problem**

Specialist clinics struggle with **slow, manual referral processing**, leading to revenue delays, administrative overload, and patient drop offs. The biggest bottlenecks we've uncovered:

* **Referral processing is manual and slow.** Clinics receive **thousands of referrals per month**, requiring extensive manual effort to extract and enter data.
* **Medical necessity verification is tedious.** Clinics must determine if a referral meets insurance criteria, often requiring **days of back-and-forth with primary care providers** for missing information.
* **Insurance approvals are a major roadblock.** Clinics waste **days negotiating with insurers** to confirm reimbursement eligibility before scheduling treatment.

These inefficiencies cause **40-60% of referrals to drop off and** costs the U.S. healthcare system **over $150 billion annually**. The administrative burden is also immense, with an average of **4.3 administrative staff per doctor** in the American healthcare system.

### **Solution**

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXduwoVo9LiyuYd4ldqDHoJxHu2uaKzKbOzQnI4MZ0vlWDvKTY-nE2iokzaFTCR7-7PeqhwdI9FIqtRbpP1FkZ3ivWq6TdtuyftWnKoMCyzw-smhtrM7tZacSCTnDkJ45wF92PRK7w?key=9LANEIwzbMw6NQWGiMH6ii1e)

Cenote eliminates the **referral-to-treatment bottleneck**, allowing clinics to focus on patient care while accelerating revenue collection.

* **Automated data extraction:** We categorize and extract key referral details the moment they hit the clinic’s inbox.
* **Seamless medical necessity verification:** If critical referral data is missing, our system **auto-requests** the necessary information via the preferred form of digital communication.
* **AI-powered insurance authorization:** Our **AI callers** handle insurance approvals, freeing clinic staff to focus on higher-value tasks.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeGgHkFuty55KGO5k--WHuaGP852o6tN4i7BepjytmDTjp48gCAx7ZC2boYhxw4NV9-evAIo09IUWh61gICroHpapc2X2jAmN3plFp4tpHM7ib9RKHwuqyyvd4FXxx2qQe-r7D7Uw?key=9LANEIwzbMw6NQWGiMH6ii1e)

launches.body:
# **TL;DR**

AI models are great at English, but struggle with almost every other language. So, we are building the world’s largest and highest quality multilingual data library to help AI labs build better non-English models.

# **The Story**

When Jason was working on AI research abroad, he found that it was incredibly difficult to find training data in non-English languages. Because of this, his peers were all working on English models rather than ones in their native language.

# **The Problem**

After speaking with researchers and entrepreneurs around the world, it became clear to us that AI usability was dramatically behind in non-English languages - even for major languages like Hindi and Arabic. This is because of the severe shortage of high quality training data in non-English languages. That leaves the 75% of the world that does not speak English out of the AI revolution.

Data has been a major bottleneck for researchers and AI labs building multilingual AI models, and the demand for better and larger datasets is only increasing.

Current workarounds such as synthetic data and machine translation simply don’t achieve the desired results, and open-source efforts fail to produce datasets in the quantity and quality required.

# **How are we solving this**

We work directly with native speakers to build and create completely novel and high quality datasets. We do this by setting up end-to-end operations in the country where native speakers of a language reside, and by using our proprietary software platform to streamline data collection, generation, annotation, and quality assurance.

# **Demo Video**

[**https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zZiilPrhDJs**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zZiilPrhDJs)

# **The Team**

name: Lucidic AI
long_description: Lucidic is trying to find a new paradigm to teach models. The last decade made models intelligent, but intelligence is not the same as experience. Humans do not get better by memorizing thousands of examples; we build learning systems around ourselves: skills, memories, critique, practice, tools, and guidance. And every person learns differently because every task is different. Lucidic brings that idea to AI agents by training a custom learning system for each agent, so it learns what to remember, what skills to build, when to ask for help, and how to improve from experience. The model provides the intelligence, Lucidic gives it a way to learn.

launches.title: Trata – Anonymous buyside research desk for hedge funds
launches.tagline: Trata uses AI agents to help hedge funds find their next 10-bagger
launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

Trata gives hedge funds un-biased, unfiltered stock analysis from anonymous Analysts at well-known funds. Our AI agents interview Analysts at multi-billion dollar funds, capture their thinking about the stocks they know and publish it anonymously.

### **Problem:**

1. It takes buyside Analysts at least 3 hours to figure out a company’s key narratives/points of debate - what outcomes are going to drive the share price up OR down? Examples: an ongoing lawsuit, a competitor going bankrupt, an Activist campaign, a new CEO, etc. This involves reading earnings call transcripts, initiation reports, talking to Investor Relations, reaching out to other Analysts, and piecing everything together yourself.
2. Because of the time it takes to do step 1, would-be winners/inflection points fall through the cracks all the time.
3. Current solutions (idea dinners, forums like Value Investors Club, Twitter DMs, independent research boutiques and even paid Substacks) are fragmented and biased.
4. The highest quality leads come from talking directly to fellow Analysts, but there’s never been a way to do this at scale, authentically. Until now.

### **Solution:**

We use LLMs to interview dozens of people a day, get their quick and honest takes on signals/points of debate they’re actually paying attention to, and turn that into a one-of-a-kind research product. Each conversation is with an anonymous hedge fund Analyst who is deeply familiar with the company – think an expert network where the hedge funds are the experts. Contributors share their knowledge to gain access to an exponentially bigger pool of expertise.

We don’t provide investment advice; we just get you up to speed – fast. We work directly with the compliance teams of multi-billion dollar hedge funds and have a team of human lawyers to ensure SEC compliance.

We are building the product I wish I had as an Analyst. Our first user interviews liked the idea so much (without any code built) that they are now our angels.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gE_Ovy1BiTM>

### **Here’s how to think about our value proposition:**

If a fund manages $300 million, one successful idea (3% position, +50% return) generates $4.5 million in profit and $900K in fees ($720/180K split between the Portfolio Manager and Analyst). This is a 750X, 120X, and 30X ROI on a $6K subscription for the Fund, Portfolio Manager and Analyst.

All it takes is one decent idea for Trata to be a home run.

### **Our Ask:**

If you are a hedge fund Analyst or know any hedge fund Analysts / public investors, please reach out! They don't have to be at a big fund like Citadel for us to be interested. We pay very well. They will most likely thank you for the intro. We guarantee anonymity. Contact us at [founders@trytrata.com](mailto:founders@trytrata.com).

### **Our Team’s Story:**

Eric and Will met at Cornell as undergrads. Eric and Alex met in high school English and grew up in the same hometown.

[Eric](https://www.linkedin.com/in/emc329/): 4.5 years as a Senior Analyst at a Long/Short Hedge Fund covering tech companies globally. Applied Economics (summa cum laude) at Cornell. Posts on Value Investors Club for fun, Sohn Idea Contest Finalist in 2021, has traveled to 20+ countries in the past few years.

[Will](https://www.linkedin.com/in/william-m-gao/): UChicago PhD Student (ML/AI). Research Scientist Intern at Meta’s Reality Labs, Nvidia’s Deep Imagination Lab, and Adobe Research. Full-time ML Engineer at Meta. CS/Stats/Math triple major in three years and a Master’s in CS his fourth year at Cornell. Globally ranked in certain online video games.

[Alex](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alexanderqchen/): Senior Software Engineer at Titan (YC S18, Series C backed by a16z), Engineer 7 at Medallion (Series C backed by Sequoia), Software Engineer at Oscar Health a year before its IPO. CS degree from UCLA. Took a gap year to pursue bootstrapped entrepreneurship in Taiwan. By far the best chef in the apartment.

launches.body:
**TLDR**:

Solidroad builds AI agents for sales and support teams, starting with training and QA. Solidroad agents train human reps in a simulated environment, and evaluate their performance in live customer channels.

By starting with training and QA, our agents learn how humans learn, and their performance can be compared directly with human reps. This enables us to prove the value of the rest of the agents on our roadmap.

Since launching last summer, we’ve **reduced onboarding times by 50%** at several of the world’s largest outsourced contact centres/BPOs like PartnerHero and Tech Mahindra, and **improved go-live CSAT at **[**Crypto.com**](http://Crypto.com)** by 3%** (now above 90% CSAT).

If you run a large support or sales team and care about conversation quality - we would love to speak with you!

[Demo Video:](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ONeUPOsK6ss&ab_channel=PatrickFinlay)

**The Problem:**

Sales and support teams struggle to consistently deliver high-quality customer interactions. Onboarding new hires takes too long, trainers and QA analysts spend excessive time manually reviewing only a small sample of conversation volume (3-5% at best), and skill gaps often go unaddressed until it’s too late.

Without full conversation coverage, real-time insights and tailored training, companies face reduced win rates, poor customer satisfaction (CSAT) scores, and inefficiencies that cost time and revenue.

**The Solution:**

Solidroad provides AI agents for conversation training and quality scoring. Sales and support teams use Solidroad to **practice conversations with AI agents** through phone, email, chat, and video calls. Each interaction gets scored and is provided with tailored coaching and feedback.

The same **scorecards** can be applied to **real customer conversations**, spotting where teams need to improve. Solidroad agents replace manual role-playing and call/chat reviews by analyzing every single conversation—both practice and real ones. By integrating with tools like Intercom, Zendesk, and Gong, Solidroad ensures teams are continually improving in both training environments and live customer interactions.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86367&key=user_uploads/1146096/f728213e-9756-4bff-82be-d5a326213988)

We help teams:

* Reduce onboarding time for new hires with conversation training in a risk-free environment.
* Save trainer & QA time with automated, scalable coaching & feedback loops.
* Improve team performance, leading to higher win rates and CSAT scores.

launches.title: ReJot - Enterprise Synchronization Engine
launches.tagline: Sync engine to share data across engineering teams in enterprises
launches.body:
Hey everyone, we're Wilco & Jan, co-founders of ReJot! We're building a sync engine that helps big companies share data across engineering teams. We increase developer velocity and, most of all, ensure companies are not forced onto Kafka when they don't actually need event streaming.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ulxmwrp_N5Q>

# The Problem

Growing companies are forced to adopt micro-services as their desire to give engineering teams autonomy increases. The number one reported problem in this architecture paradigm is **data silos**. Silos create high coordination overhead when integrating data from other engineering teams, slowing down development and delaying product launches.

The industry has defaulted to event streaming platforms like Kafka to enable teams to share data asynchronously. As a result, enterprise software architectures are pushed into an event-driven model. However, events come with inherent complexity—they encode **something happening** rather than **something being** (i.e., state).

**We believe that events are used for no good reason other than the infrastructure forcing developers onto them.**

# Solution

ReJot is a **sync engine** that enables sharing data between back-end services without the need for APIs or event streaming. We break data silos without forcing a paradigm shift from state to events.

We do this in the following way:

* **Familiar Querying:** by syncing database-to-database, ReJot allows engineers to query data from other teams **directly from their own database**. Developers use what they know best: SQL queries.
* **Sharing Data:** We realize that internal database schemas are sacred, and they should never be public directly. ReJot provides strong **data-sharing primitives**, allowing data owners to control _what_ and _how_ data is shared. Simplicity is key—setting up data publications in ReJot is trivial.
* **Integration Flexibility:** Downstream teams don't necessarily need data in the same shape as the original source. SQL queries are used once more to transform the data to fit the integrating team's needs.
* **Data Catalog**: Integrating data is impossible without first understanding what data is available. Our system overview maps an enterprise's software architecture through its databases, allowing the user to explore and search schemas to uncover opportunities for deep integration between products.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88081&key=user_uploads/2356635/d80813fb-077e-4916-98f0-bae320ddd57c)

_\[This overview shows how accounts owned by the accounting team are made public and integrated into the banking database by means of the "Accounts Consumer" integration.\]_

# Launching Today

Today, we’re excited to launch the **open-source** Limited Access Preview of ReJot!

Our control plane doubles as a database catalog, providing a unified view of all data stores within your organization. Connect Postgres databases to document your system architecture.

In the coming weeks we'll be rolling out ReJot's synchronization functionality to select users. As we scale our infrastructure, more users will be onboarded.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88081&key=user_uploads/2356635/c2ee7761-283c-4064-af0e-44984f23320a)

# The Team

We met nearly 10 years ago in Amsterdam where we studied Computer Science together, and have been friends ever since.

* Wilco (CEO) worked as a software engineer on Adyen's banking infrastructure. During a period of high growth he worked on the internal ledgering system and a framework to sync bank account data throughout the company, which inspired ReJot. He also has a background in software maintainability research.
* Jan (CTO) was a data platform engineer for Adyen's big data platform. There, he managed infrastructure for 600+ ETL pipelines created by 50+ teams that produced hundreds of terabytes of data every week. Jan is a published AI researcher.

Through a shared passion of modern software technology and reducing complexity in enterprise systems we connected the dots to create ReJot's sync engine.

# The Ask

* _🔗_ Share this post! Do you know of any organizations struggling with their distributed architecture? Reach out to us at [founders@rejot.dev](mailto:founders@rejot.dev) —we’d love to help!
* ⭐️ Star us on [GitHub](https://github.com/rejot-dev/rejot), follow us on [X](https://x.com/rejotsync) & [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/rejot)
* 📧 Sign up for our [newsletter](https://rejot.dev/email-updates/)
* 🌐 Connect your databases & learn more: <https://rejot.dev>

launches.tagline: Our AI Agents connect with Salesforce, NetSuite and SAP to automate order processing, invoicing and payments, cutting QTC from weeks to minutes.
launches.body:
[Watch our AI Agents in action:](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pWOc8s5bjyY)

**TL;DR:** Agentin AI builds AI Agents that automate the entire Quote-to-Cash (QTC) workflow by connecting with enterprise systems like Salesforce, NetSuite, and SAP. We eliminate incomplete orders, mismatched data and delayed payments, cutting down QTC from weeks to minutes and boosting cash flow. [Here's a quick podcast overview.](https://open.spotify.com/episode/2hKTVSOJS7aFpSJR16v1dt)

**What is Quote-to-Cash (QTC)?** Quote to Cash is the full business process from receiving customer orders through fulfillment, invoicing, payment collection, and reconciliation.

**Why this matters:** Slow or inefficient QTC processes directly delay cash flow, add operational overhead, and limit business growth.

**The Problem:** Companies dealing with high order volumes typically struggle with:

* **Incomplete Orders:** Missing details cause delays.
* **Mismatched Data:** Manual errors create reconciliation headaches.
* **Delayed Payments:** Inefficient processes slow down cash collections.

These issues often extend QTC from days to weeks, impacting revenue and productivity.

**Our Solution:** Agentin AI’s Agents connect with existing enterprise CRM and ERP systems to:

* **Automate Data Entry:** Remove manual input, reducing errors.
* **Ensure Data Consistency:** Detect and fix data mismatches automatically.
* **Accelerate Payments:** Speed up invoicing and reconciliation, cutting QTC time from weeks to minutes.

**Backstory:** I am Sankeerth Rao Karingula, founder of Agentin AI (YC W25) and an ex-Google Research Scientist. At Agentin AI, we develop reinforcement learning algorithms so our AI Agents can learn and adapt from failures. After seeing how manual QTC processes slow businesses down, I built Agentin AI to solve these inefficiencies.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88196&key=user_uploads/423828/a3e2119a-1948-4ce1-8abc-09ce48991a91)

**Our Ask:**

* Could you introduce us to finance or ops leaders at companies with $100M+ in revenue and handling 1,000+ orders per month?

Thank you! We’re dedicated to automating away manual Quote-to-Cash inefficiencies so teams can focus on higher-value tasks.

launches.title: Confident AI: The Evals Platform for AI Quality & Observability
launches.tagline: An evaluation platform for engineers, QAs, and PMs to pinpoint which iteration of their AI to put in production.
launches.body:
**TL;DR – Confident AI is a cloud-based evaluation platform to help teams build reliable AI products. Its evals are powered by DeepEval - an open-source LLM evaluation framework, which has over 12k stars, 3million monthly downloads, runs 2million evals per day, and is most commonly found in CI/CD pipelines of enterprises such as BCG, Astrazeneca, AXA, Microsoft.** 

**Confident AI allows engineering teams to iterate on their LLM app x10 faster by bringing best-in-class evals to traditional AI observability.**

[Try Confident AI today (setup in 5 min)](https://docs.confident-ai.com/confident-ai/confident-ai-introduction)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87657&key=user_uploads/1314014/fc01311e-e55b-4632-8256-75115c04f3f5)

### **The Problem**

Despite LLM evaluation being a problem with many solutions on the market, it remains unsolved. General LLMOps observability platforms that offer evals lack robust metrics and are more suited for debugging through tracing UIs, while evaluation-focused frameworks don’t offer enough control for users to customize and make metrics reliable for specific use cases.

As a result, developers often build custom evaluation metrics and pipelines from scratch—writing hundreds or even thousands of lines of code to test their LLM apps. The worst part? Once they’ve fine-tuned their metrics and are ready to deploy them across the organization, they hit a roadblock: there’s no easy way to collaborate. Because these custom metrics exist in scattered code rather than an integrated ecosystem, incorporating them to enable team-wide adoption becomes frustrating and inefficient.

### **The Solution**

We built DeepEval for engineers to create **use-case-specific, deterministic** LLM evaluation metrics, and when you're ready, Confident AI brings these evaluation results to the cloud for collaboration. This allows teams to collaborate on LLM app iteration — with no extra setup required.

1. Curate your evaluation dataset on Confident AI.
2. Run evaluations locally with DeepEval's metrics, pulling datasets from Confident AI.
3. View and share testing reports to compare prompts and models and refine your LLM application.

Confident AI continuously evaluates monitored LLM outputs for production, automatically enriching your dataset with real-world, adversarial test cases. This keeps your evaluation data high-quality and reflective of your use case.

<https://youtu.be/yLIhVn3B8Wg>

### **How are we different?**

What we've learned is in order to get legitimate evaluation results required for benchmark-driven iteration, you need extremely high-quality metrics and datasets. That's why we've built specifically for the ideal LLM evaluation workflow:

* **DeepEval** handles robust, deterministic metrics required for rigorous, use-case-tailored validation.
* **Confident AI** provides both technical and non-technical teams the ability to collaborate on pre and post-deployment evals and observability.

> If your evaluation results are 100% reflective of your LLM application's performance, what's stopping you from shipping the best version of your LLM app?

### **Customer ROI metrics**

We've been working with companies of all sizes, and some of the ROI metrics include:

* Decreasing LLM cost by **more than 70%** through evaluation to safely switch away from GPT-4o to cheaper models.
* Decreasing time to deployment for a team of 7 from **1-2 weeks to 2-3 hours**.
* Helping a team of 30 customer support agents **save 200+ hours a week** by having a centralized place to analyze LLM performance live.

There's more to come as we start publishing some case studies on our website, so stay tuned!

### **Our Ask**

Thanks for sticking with us to the end! We’re on a mission to help companies get the most ROI out of their LLM use cases, and we believe this is only achievable through rigorous LLM evaluation at scale. If our mission resonates with you, Confident AI is always here and available to try immediately (coding required, but free to try): <https://www.confident-ai.com/docs>

If you want to explore our enterprise offering, you can always [talk to us here.](https://calendly.com/d/cqbp-t88-y4j/confident-ai-intro-call)

### **About Us**

Confident AI is founded by **Jeffrey Ip**, a SWE formally at Google scaling YouTube's creators studio infrastructure, and Microsoft building document recommenders for Office 365, and **Kritin Vongthongsri**, an AI researcher and CHI-published author, who previously built NLP pipelines for fintech startups and researched self-driving cars/HCI during his time at Princeton, where he studied ORFE and CS.

launches.tagline: Optimize models to run on edge devices (e.g. Jetsons) with 3-20x faster inference and 80% less memory requirements
launches.body:
Hey YC! We’re Viraat and Pranav – cofounders of Exla.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88090&key=user_uploads/2212412/6f2a4f23-207a-4ba8-84dd-1be1039c46f7)

# **TL;DR**

The Exla SDK optimizes models for edge devices (e.g. NVIDIA Jetsons), **cutting memory usage by up to 80%, with 3-20x faster inference**. We’re focusing on optimizing and deploying **LLMs, VLMs, VLAs, and other CV models** on the edge.\
[Here’s Viraat showcasing our SDK](https://www.loom.com/share/d8fbb4faef87493c9806610fff6ff86c?sid=10b54831-159b-4157-95b7-8b9f7a5c8d8e)

# **‼️ The Problem**

**Frontier models are unlocking new applications on constrained edge devices** – Vision-Language Models in manufacturing defect detection, Vision-Language-Action Models to control robots via natural language, and LLMs to power in-car assistants are a few examples.

**But these** **models are now shy of a _trillion_ parameters**, and with the emergence of inference-time scaling, **they are more computationally demanding than ever**. This limits their adoption to edge devices with beefy GPUs and sufficiently large VRAM, and even then, a Jetson Orin Nano Super is completely saturated attempting to run a 13B model, leaving little room for other tasks.

# **🏎️ The Solution: The Exla SDK**

**We’re building mixed-precision low-bit quantization software** to dramatically cut the compute footprint of these models, leading to **80% less memory usage, 3-20x faster inference**, and reduced energy consumption.

**Today we’re starting with the Exla SDK** which applies our optimizations to a catalog of transformer-based and CV models, with growing support for your custom models. We’re primarily targeting deployment on NVIDIA Jetsons, followed by CPU-based platforms like Raspberry Pis and other embedded platforms.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88090&key=user_uploads/2212412/68c46641-ffb9-4dc9-a0a0-8facdba4e132)

Our roadmap includes building custom silicon that takes advantage of the quirks of low bit compute – which we expect to bring in another order of magnitude in compute savings. _We’re bringing frontier models everywhere._

# **🥷 The Team**

We met each other on the first day of college under questionable circumstances and have built several projects together since. Exla is the latest in that series!

[Viraat](https://www.linkedin.com/in/viraatdas/) graduated in 2.5 years and joined Amazon as machine learning engineer, where he worked on building personalized search and infrastructure to optimize models. In a previous life, he used to marathon around the world. Now he marathons at home, coding.

[Pranav](https://www.linkedin.com/in/pranavnair311/) previously worked at Apple as an OS engineer, hacking the iOS/macOS kernel to improve the sleep/wake experience for over a billion devices. In his non-existent free time, he tends to his 5 year old baby – an operating system he’s built from scratch.

# **🙏 Our Ask!**

Please reach out to [**founders@exla.ai**](mailto:founders@exla.ai) if you’re facing issues optimizing your models on Jetsons, other edge devices, or on-prem deployments! We’re happy to onboard you to our private beta.

We’re particularly looking to solve model optimization at companies working on robotics, manufacturing & industrial automation, and camera-based systems – your help would make a world of difference <3

launches.title: Nitrode - Advancing AI for Game Development
launches.tagline: Advancing game development through frontier AI research.
launches.body:
Hey YC,

We’re Ben, Brian, and Sejoon from **Nitrode.**

Nitrode is a research company focused on improving game development with AI. 

**The Problem - How do we advance game development with AI?**

We started by building an AI game engine. It got to [**#3 on Product Hunt**,](https://www.producthunt.com/products/nitrode-ai-game-engine) and we gained several useful insights:  despite recent progress in agentic coding, game development remains uniquely difficult for AI models because it requires **(1) strong spatial reasoning**, **(2) reliable tool use/tool-calling**, **(3) strong agentic coding capabilities** and the **(4) ability to operate in real-time environments for complex games**.

**The Solution** 

To advance game development, we believe AI models firstly need to be judged against robust evaluation frameworks that reflect the **actual complexity of the field.** Over the coming months, Nitrode will open-source a suite of benchmarks designed to measure where AI models truly stand in game development. Our first benchmark, [**GameEngineBench**,](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03525) evaluates agentic coding performance on C++ game engine tasks in real runtime environments.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=104921&key=user_uploads/1654263/a084ce2c-86d5-431b-97a1-d2ccf07b3f04)

Our results are clear: model class and reasoning effort are strong predictors of performance, while model rankings align more closely with spatial reasoning benchmarks than with traditional agentic coding benchmarks. **This suggests that game development is fundamentally different from pure coding.** Success requires not only writing correct code, but also understanding space, tools, runtime behavior, and the interaction between systems.

We also observe significant complementarity across frontier models, indicating that different models exhibit distinct strengths within the game development task space. Mythos/Fable-class models point toward a potential step change in AI game development capability, where improved spatial understanding and stronger tool use combine to produce emergent behaviors that older model generations struggle to match.

Our benchmark has revealed clear model-specific performance gaps across game development tasks, with outcomes that diverge meaningfully from standard agentic coding benchmarks.

We are also building [Mint](http://mint.nitrode.com), a platform that onboards game development experts to work on custom datasets. Think engine programmers, technical artists, and developers with years of enterprise/indie game development experience. We already have hundreds of contributors across game development and creative software. Whenever you need a certain type of data, we construct and lead a team to produce:

* Post-training /SFT data captured from real workflows: how developers actually build, debug, test, and iterate inside engines and creative tools.
* RL environments and executable tasks where models learn through execution and feedback.
* Custom benchmarks and post-training for gaming enterprises: we pinpoint where models fail on real game development tasks, then post-train a custom model to close those gaps.

**Team** 

Ben and Brian studied Information Science and Computer Science at Cornell, while Sejoon studied Computer Science and Product Design at Stanford. The trio has been building things together for the last six years, from a sports team analytics tool to Nitrode, and are, unsurprisingly, massive gaming nerds. Sejoon is top 400 in the world at moving GeoGuessr and a certified Civ sweat, Brian is ranked in Tetris, and Ben used to be ranked in Minecraft speedrunning.

**Our Ask:**

1. If you need custom datasets or evals, let us know! Email us [research@nitrode.com](mailto:research@nitrode.com)
2. Are there any creative or gaming companies you could introduce us to?

**Thank you!**

launches.tagline: AI operations analyst for enterprise call center workflows
launches.body:
TLDR: Cutting just 1 second off each customer call can save enterprise call centers millions of dollars. Calltree helps enterprises' VP of Operations understand how to make their call center more efficient. Our AI agent analyzes millions of minutes of call center recordings to find inefficiencies in workflows and quantifies the cost of each action. For example, when a rep is handling a credit card dispute, Calltree can identify that reps spend 30 seconds per call on manual data gathering and data entry, propose a solution, and measure the opex savings. Calltree surfaces these insights in an analytics tool and generates reports, making it easy for operation leaders to build business cases to prioritize improvements, realizing millions in opex savings.

Ask: If cutting every second matters to your call center, please email us [kun@calltree.ai](mailto:kun@calltree.ai) and [rob@calltree.ai](mailto:rob@calltree.ai) or [book a demo here.](https://calendly.com/kun-calltree/30min) 

[Checkout our launch video!](https://youtu.be/v-9hFgH_gCI)

**The Problem**

Large enterprises track every second of a phone call because **reducing average call time** can save millions of dollars each year. However, enterprises don't have a scalable way to find these inefficiencies. Manual time studies (in person shadowing call center reps, etc.) are tedious, unscalable, and expensive. 

**What Are Screen Recordings?**

Many contact centers don’t just record the audio of customer calls; they also capture **everything the rep does on their screen** for training, compliance, and quality assurance. **Less than 1% of these screen recordings** are ever reviewed by a manager or analyst and **miss 99% of calls**. This leads to blind spots and missed opportunities for massive cost savings.

**Our Solution**

* **AI agent that finds workflow inefficiencies** (e.g., toggling between multiple systems to complete a single task).
* **Quantify the time and cost** of each action (e.g., “Switching between these five legacy apps costs 20 seconds per call → $5M/year”).
* **Operation leaders use these insights** to build quick business cases to fix inefficiencies. After changes are implemented, Calltree measures the impact pre- and post-fix to **prove cost reductions**.

**Our team**

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdf17k-TMCzITHR-cAuUjxmf1XRQMpsQRvVeVslxQKILE2Jv6xHq2NSXtJWSM1WyEDXZBON4FJ1U7A77AKzZt7VvkUe7HGq8ozwJT3lf8O4nUgM8CwHtfhZ60iIsEanYT077wTjFA?key=5B91WL3MPEXhLdY8htNQCHC6)

* **Kun** led product at AWS’ contact center solution, working with hundreds of large enterprises such as Capital One, Intuit, and Adobe.
* **Rob** specializes in multimodal search for video and audio, previously helped companies like Walmart and Etsy fine tune embedding models.
* After seeing how **little** of these screen recordings ever got analyzed—despite their huge potential value—we decided to automate that process end-to-end.

**Our Ask**

* Follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/calltree-ai), and [book a demo](https://calendly.com/kun-calltree/30min) with our team.
* Share this post! -  Do you know anyone in your network who is a VP of Operations, VP of call center operations, VP of Contact Center? Please share this post (or our demo video below!)
* Learn more at [calltree.ai](https://calltree.ai)

launches.body:
Hi! We are Lucas and Paul, cofounders of Tire Swing: the AI compliance platform for Affordable Housing.

<https://youtu.be/x4qyhXXz38I>

## **The Problem**

Every Affordable Housing move-in and recertification requires applicant income verification and a strict eligibility review. In addition to the high labor costs and regulatory burden, delays in reviewing applications and thoroughly screening applicants can cause weeks of lost rental revenue.

Lost revenue on a single move-in can accumulate to thousands of dollars, and penalties for non-compliance can cost millions in credit recaptures and fines.

## **The Solution**

Tire Swing uses AI to bring compliance expertise to the point of leasing. It turns weeks of reviews and approvals into a minutes-long process. The platform:

* **Reviews evidence as it is collected.** Tire Swing processes documentation in minutes, allowing problems to be addressed before the applicant leaves the office.
* **Performs the eligibility analysis.** It calculates household income, applies all applicable property, state, and program eligibility rules, and links every finding to its supporting evidence.
* **Automates certification compliance.** Tire Swing flags missing, inconsistent, or incorrect information with steps to resolve the problem from a library of thousands of deterministic and AI driven compliance checks.

**Tire Swing means faster move-ins and recertifications, reduced consulting budget, and more consistent, audit-ready files.** 

## **Looking ahead**

We believe Affordable Housing is the first application of a much larger needs-based eligibility opportunity. Federal, state, and local governments distribute more than $1.5 trillion annually through needs-based programs including Medicaid, SNAP, TANF, utility assistance, and tax credits.

These programs share a common underlying workflow: collect documents, convert them into structured facts, apply eligibility rules, and resolve missing or contradictory information.  The administration costs for these services are approximately $20B annually.

## **The Team**

Tire Swing is founded by Paul and Lucas, college friends and Princeton computer science graduates. Prior to founding Tire Swing, Lucas worked as a software engineer at Instacart and Capital One, and Paul worked as a cybersecurity consultant at Stroz Friedberg.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=108324&key=user_uploads/990814/102ac484-df2c-4314-a766-c778a91c6b50)


## **The Ask**

We would appreciate introductions to Affordable Housing property managers, developers, public housing authorities, and state housing agencies.

Please feel free to reach out at [**paul@gettireswing.com**](mailto:paul@gettireswing.com).

launches.body:
**Hey everyone! We’re Sukhjit and Sriman, co-founders of Sennu AI (W25).**

## The Problem

Tech consulting firms offer a suite of deeply technical services (SAP S/4HANA migrations, AWS Redshift implementation) with large contract sizes ($100,000-$1,000,000+). Sales representatives at these firms struggle due to a lack of technical knowledge leading to ineffective outbound, inaccurate estimates on pricing, and lost deals. AI has only made this problem worse as SDRs face an increasing number of new unfamiliar services to sell (Agentforce, Microsoft Copilot Studio) and rapid changes in recent years have rendered historical pricing unreliable for many technical services.

## The Solution

**Sennu AI** is our answer to this problem: we provide an **AI SDR** purpose-built for tech consulting companies. Instead of juggling multiple tools and outdated workflows, Sennu AI autonomously:

* **Creates targeted outbound campaigns** based on your specific offerings
* **Sources leads** from across the web, qualifying them through extensive research
* **Crafts personalized emails** with a deep understanding of each prospect’s business needs
* **Syncs seamlessly** with your existing CRM or workflow

All with just one click. By leveraging context on all your previous projects combined with comprehensive business & technical expertise, we’re ensuring that our AI agent sends the most compelling outbound possible to every lead at scale.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0zTwhxxW3Y>

## Backstory

Growing up in a tech consulting family, I (Sriman) experienced firsthand the challenges of running a project-based business, especially a technical one. The lack of recurring revenue meant that sales was an ongoing challenge to keep the lights on year after year. I saw in the previous technology shift how sales reps were left struggling from the radical shift from on-prem to cloud leading to unsuccessful outbound, mistakes in sales calls, and frustrated teams. We aim to prevent the same thing happening again during this shift to AI by solving sales and host of other problems that impact project based businesses.

## Our Team

Sukhjit and Sriman have worked together for over a decade having been debate partners in high school, starting our own tutoring business out of our college dorm, to even interning together at Brex. With strong technical backgrounds—Sukhjit at Brex and Sriman at Confluent—they’re now channeling their expertise into solving a problem that directly affects their own parents, a mission they’re both deeply passionate about.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87149&key=user_uploads/1939169/60643d7e-51cc-4ed4-a495-afd71b8c2851)

## Our Vision

launches.title: Peppr AI: The world's first AI-powered knowledge capture platform
launches.tagline: Enabling teams of any scale to move at startup speed
launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

Lost knowledge is lost productivity.

Peppr AI turns scattered company data into a living, self-improving knowledge hub to fuel faster decisions across your organization. Through this, Peppr ensures that **no matter** **how much your team scales in size, it can still operate with the same speed as the leanest startups.** 

**The Problem**

As companies scale, their teams inevitably grow—and so does their information. Projects multiply, contacts proliferate, and goals stack up. Critical details sink into buried Slack threads, outdated Confluence docs, and a myriad of PM tools. This not only leads to incessant handoff meetings and endless email threads, but **90% of critical knowledge remains undocumented (in large U.S. businesses) due to inefficient knowledge-sharing.**

### **Our Solution**

Peppr AI is built to solve these deep-seated knowledge bottlenecks.

**Unlike tools that rely on employees manually documenting what they do (which we all know they don’t ;)**, Peppr autonomously captures critical insights hidden in engineering workflows—surfacing the knowledge that typically goes undocumented.

[Peppr AI Demo](https://youtu.be/toz3hokheXs)

By **autonomously ingesting data** from key platforms, Peppr:

1. **Auto-Generates Internal Documentation**
   * Creates synthesized summaries of daily activity from Slack, Notion, Jira, etc., keeping everyone up to speed.
2. **Offers Intelligent, Real-Time Insights**
   * Pinpoints blockers in projects and recommends intelligent workflows or POCs (Points of Contact) to resolve them.
3. **Develops “Virtual Employee Minds”**
   * Retains institutional knowledge, so when employees leave or are away, their expertise doesn’t have to be waited on and doesn’t walk out the door with them.
4. **Supercharges Existing AI Tools**
   * Empowers AI tools like Cursor and Glean with the most advanced, continuously updating knowledge base, enabling them to operate with deeper context and greater accuracy.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87684&key=user_uploads/1481983/ea6c5c9c-368e-451e-978b-fd817e630b03)

Our ‘virtual employee’ dashboard doesn’t just track productivity—it unlocks hidden insights, revealing impact and expertise across the org in real-time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87684&key=user_uploads/1481983/11f1a5c2-30bf-4cb9-8404-bf369d4b9ebe)

A command center for execution—Peppr’s team-wide dashboard pinpoints roadblocks, suggests the fastest resolutions, and ensures work never stalls.

### **Why It Matters**

In the perfect information system, no one wastes time hunting for answers, waiting for replies, or sitting through redundant meetings. **Unfortunately, for most organizations today, it's the opposite.** 

Engineers get blocked searching for past solutions instead of shipping faster. Managers struggle with visibility. Teams waste hours trying to align.

**Peppr changes this.**

Unlike other AI-powered tools, which only surface information that employees have manually written down, **Peppr AI captures and records the knowledge that never makes it into documentation** – so work moves forward instead of in circles.

And because every productivity tool, AI agent, and search system is only as powerful as the data it relies on, Peppr doesn’t just unify knowledge—it supercharges all your existing systems. **Like an internal Scale AI**, it continuously organizes, refines, and contextualizes your data, ensuring every one of your organization’s systems operates at peak efficiency. **No bottlenecks. No blind spots. Just pure execution at startup speed—no matter how big you grow.**

### **Our Ask**

* **Connect us to Series B+ Startups and Enterprise Teams (30+ Employees)** that are struggling with growing silos, inefficiencies, and lost productivity.

launches.body:
**TLDR:** TripleZip automates complex accounting tasks for Commercial Real Estate firms, cutting admin costs and lowering legal risk.

**Demo:** <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=epLN4pXpcTU>

**❌ The Problem: Expensive and error-prone accounting**

* CRE firms pay $$$ for lawyers to manually extract data from their leases
* Then they pay $$$ for accountants to reconcile tenant accounts
* The whole process takes 3+ months & often has costly errors.

We learned about the problem from our parents, who own commercial real estate in San Antonio, TX. After trying existing CRE accounting software, we found that the entire process relied on error-prone manual entry and expensive consulting services.

**✅ Our Solution: Replace manual entry with AI**

* TripleZip extracts data from leases with AI (more accurately than humans)
* TripleZip feeds that data into an accounting engine which reconciles accounts instantly
* Done in <1 day, 10X cheaper than hiring a consultant or service firm

We’ve started by automating the most complex part of CRE accounting: Triple-net (NNN) reconciliation. This process accounts for up to 1/3 of the accounting effort for a large CRE firm and often results in expensive human errors and audits.

By reducing the overhead costs of accounting and avoiding costly audits related to NNN reconciliations, we aim to improve our customer’s margins by as much as 25% percent.

Artificial Societies builds a foundational model of human societies so enterprises and sovereigns can explore how people may respond before making consequential decisions. We combine behavioural science with simulations grounded in real-world behaviour to understand individual perspectives and how opinions develop across connected groups.

Teams use our simulations to test communications, prepare for crises, explore new markets, and assess investor and public-policy reactions. launches.body:
Hello World, we’re [James](https://www.linkedin.com/in/james-k-he/) and [Patrick](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sharpe-patrick/) - founders of Artificial Societies 👋

**We simulate 1000s of stakeholders and how they react to information.** We help Fortune 500 enterprises simulate how their most important audiences - policy influencers, investors, buyer committees, etc. - react to their most important marketing and comms decisions. Find out more at [**societies.io**](http://societies.io).

# **Our Story**

We’re both behavioral scientists, but took different paths - James used machines to predict humans, while Patrick ran experiments in large organizations.

In 2023, James started tinkering with a crazy idea: what would a society of 33,000 AI bots look like? He wrote this into the first-ever large-scale [academic study](https://societies.io/pdfs/bjop-2025-ai-chatbots-collective-behaviour.pdf) on AI societies, and started turning it into a product.

One day in a London coffee shop in 2024, James used a simulation to recreate an experiment Patrick had spent two months on… in just ten minutes. That same week, Patrick quit his consulting job to co-found Artificial Societies with James.

We started by simulating a network of 1,000 VCs, and used it to raise a pre-seed and get into YC. Next, we built Reach, a tool that let anyone create an AI simulation of their own LinkedIn audience, to test posts before hitting publish. 

Now, we are focusing on enterprise customers and consulting partners who are demanding us to build a more exceptional technology:

# **Introducing Radiant**

We help marketing and strategic comms teams build bespoke AI simulations of high-value audiences, for insights on questions no one else can answer.

Radiant has already delivered over 18 million responses to global F100 enterprises, that helped shape over 100 million dollars’ worth of decisions ranging from [investor relations](https://societies.io/investor-communications-simulation), [high-value advertising](https://societies.io/advertising-testing-with-ai), [crisis communications](https://societies.io/crisis-communications-simulation), [reputation management](https://societies.io/reputation-management-simulation), and [corporate strategy positioning](https://societies.io/corporate-strategy-simulation).

**Here’s [Radiant in action](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/james-k-he_anthropic-gambled-millions-on-their-superbowl-activity-7426611068254322688-fyEq?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAACk3-R4BvvNrRdti8qSJ9yH6XurA_LAGBoc).**

To power Radiant, we’ve built over 2.5 million AI personas that are all grounded in real human behaviour – not just what people say, but also what they do, and who they are influenced by. 

But our enterprise partners choose us not just because we have achieved 1) [95% distribution accuracy](https://societies.io/publications) against human self-replication, and 2) 90% persona internal coherence, both on [empirically and theory-grounded evaluations](https://societies.io/how-accurate-are-ai-personas).

More importantly, they choose us because of our ability to deliver impossible research projects - such as having insights backed by millions of responses within 24 hours, such as being able to test sensitive strategies on high-value audiences with 100% security, without human risk.

# **What’s next?**

Our vision of Artificial Societies is a **Societal World Model** that enables infinite experimentation, so that every organisation can have awareness of outcomes, before making a decision. 

No planes fly without a wind-tunnel; no medicines are approved without clinical trials; and yet, the biggest decision societies face today are taken as bets. 

We see Artificial Societies as a historically inevitable technology, and see it as our lives' mission to bring it to life.

### **Our Ask 🙏**

**We are rolling out Radiant at marketing & comms teams globally.** If you are someone / know someone who lead strategic comms consultancies or enterprise marketing firms, please reach out or introduce us at [founders@societies.io](mailto:founders@societies.io).

Nowadays, go-to-market teams struggle with manual tasks and fragmented data due to the 10+ disconnected sales tools they are operating on. Legacy software evolved this way primarily because incumbents focused on becoming hyper-specialized with point solutions to accommodate for system of record providers such as Salesforce & Hubspot and the inability to interact with data efficiently until AI had tangible commercial application in 2023. The advent of LLMs is enabling a paradigm shift in the industry with a small window, but massive opportunity, to disrupt incumbents with legacy infrastructure.

Our product can be best described as an agentic sales platform – think Salesforce meets OpenAI operator with the ability to complete any workflow imaginable through simple natural language prompts. * Automatically create targeted lead lists

launches.body:
## **TL;DR**

AI models need high-quality training data to effectively automate complex professional tasks - we provide that data. If you are building an AI model or need fine-tuning data for your agent, we’d love to help. 

\------------

## **Why We’re Building AfterQuery**

There is a dearth of high-quality training data.

Current AI models are trained to be smart but are not trained on the work of actual professionals in many fields. 

For example, current models are largely unusable to professionals working in finance (private equity, hedge funds, investment banks, etc). See our [paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2501.18062), where LLMs fail 60% of realistic daily tasks – but with some fine-tuning on high-quality training data, significantly improve.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeJndLBLBOQJVpf7yPJNA2WFddpffkxqdE1rFqmEfxo3FRmcSCVWqHnsOR793XuN1iCUm-ibeWfFj-FV_3FaswWhXetsEhembFLjln5Lwc9LA0tJV6uNq7MPWyjdDq7FTZSRdmekQ?key=_udDbu5NRw5fwLzMYyqM9i52)

_Chart showing LLM performance against FinanceQA_

And the lack of high-quality training data is everywhere:

* Domain-specific AI (legal, consulting, healthcare, etc.)
* Multimodal data (audio, multilingual, etc.)
* Foundational models looking to push the boundary on reasoning and grading

## **Solution**

We are building a platform to onboard experts to work on custom datasets. Think working professionals at top firms and the smartest students in various subjects (PhDs). Then, whenever you have a request for a certain type of data, we will construct and lead a team to produce:

* Post-training / fine-tuning data
* Human-Led Reinforcement Learning (RLHF) data
* Custom benchmarks

You will know the people making your dataset and their qualifications while we coordinate with you to ensure quality standards. We save you time and energy, so you can focus on the model and not the data.

## **Example Datasets We Provide**

_Foundational Model Advancing Coding Capabilities:_

* New data structures and algorithms problems with test cases and step-by-step answer reasoning 
* Computer architecture and system design reasoning
* Performance optimization code with benchmarks and reasoning

_Enterprise SaaS Company Building Internal AI Developer Tool:_

* Codebase-wide code snippets with corresponding refactoring suggestions and explanations 
* System and runtime errors paired with step-by-step debugging solutions 
* Database query optimization solutions and reasoning steps

_Startup Building an AI Agent for Law:_

* Answered legal questions with expert reasoning
* Computer use data for common tasks on legal project management software
* Contract redlines with expert corrections

**If AI is one day to replace jobs entirely, it can’t just be good, it needs to be near perfect. This transformation will require an immense amount of high-quality training data.**

## **Our Ask**

* Are you **working on a foundational model** advancing multimodal applications, nuanced reasoning, or domain-specific expertise?
* Are you **implementing AI in a specialized domain** where current models lack expertise (e.g., medicine, legal, finance, software, government, healthcare)?

We would love to meet you! 

## **Our Team**

Carlos and Spencer first met in high school at a summer program at Google and then interned together at Meta. Danny and Spencer met in high school, where they built a startup. They then both got into Wharton, sold that startup, and became roommates.

[Carlos](https://www.linkedin.com/in/carlossgg/) has built multiple software businesses on his own, exited an ed-tech startup, and has worked as a software engineer at Citadel Securities. He’s won the largest possible academic scholarship in all of Canada, competed in state and national sailing competitions, and has 8x his bankroll in poker.

[Spencer](https://www.linkedin.com/in/spencermateega) wrote an award-winning research paper and interned at a private equity firm in high school, before deciding to intern at Meta (SWE), Google (SWE), Morgan Stanley (IB), and Silver Lake (PE) in the next 3 years. He was the sole summer analyst at Silver Lake globally and has programmed numerous apps in his spare time (and sold some of them). He trains for half marathons and lifts in his free time between completing a master’s in computer science concurrently with his Wharton undergraduate degree.

[Danny](https://www.linkedin.com/in/danny1898/) competed and won international competitions in public speaking during high school while pursuing his interest in AI, winning an international Microsoft AI competition and conducting research at a machine learning neuroscience lab. He then learned how people build real estate, from grocery stores to billion-dollar luxury hotels, eventually working on the largest real estate IPO in history and the largest IPO in 2024. He also really likes movies and attended the world's largest film festival, catching premieres of films like Anora and The Substance.
