launches.body:
# TL;DR

Third Chair is building agents for in-house legal teams. We’ve started in media/entertainment, where our agents can identify IP infringements, collect evidence, and help recover millions of dollars in damages at scale. 

# 🛑 Problem

In-house legal teams are constantly underwater with a million tasks on their desk. Many of these are **repetitive**, **manual**, and **mind-numbing**: 

* Our customer at a music distributor spent hours tracking down brand contacts, then weeks following up with different emails just to reach the right department.
* Our customer at a major record label spent weeks reviewing thousands of social media ads and manually logging results in a spreadsheet.
* Our customer at a music publisher spent a majority of his time on email follow-ups for unpaid invoices, unsigned contracts, and unanswered emails.
* Our customer at a music rights investment firm didn’t have time to draft individual demand letters for thousands of infringements they wanted to pursue.

When you're buried in a million tasks, it can be hard to prioritize what matters most to your business's bottom line. At worst, you can miss opportunities that could turn the legal department from a cost center into a **profit driver**.

# ✅ Solution

That’s why we’re building Third Chair for in-house legal teams, starting in media/entertainment. Our customers delegate end-to-end workflows to Third Chair so they can operate at scale: 

* Our browser agent detects uses of your copyrights, trademarks, or name-image-likeness across the web.
* Our outreach agent finds the right business contact, verifies deliverability, and sends follow-ups.
* Our contracts agent drafts demand letters for human review, incorporating the context gathered in previous steps.

> This is definitely the best product I’ve seen in this category. Every other vendor just sends us CSV data files from outsourced data labelers. - _Top 3 Music Company_

[Third Chair Product Demo](https://youtu.be/Khflxy5GfbI)

💡 We’ve found that in-house legal teams don’t want to learn and buy new software tools, but they’re happy to buy services to solve their problems. That’s why you can work with Third Chair just like you would with a human paralegal. You can send questions or tasks via email to [ask@usethirdchair.com](mailto:ask@usethirdchair.com), or use our web interface for more complex workflows.

**AI will create the first one-person unicorn. Third Chair will be their legal department.**

launches.body:
![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfaf-JCp7xVd7cfcFqnv8fCZLojSwklRbqBbGneCbhutbc4iEcgcNNQ46j73KsOKaN3qH5fhVCVUQQpp696KnBWJfz5DnhcuS5nqKod2-9Fn2p-LJ3Yd9rEM9zIJg11ce5bTmkp-Q?key=HpOTxrRvVOxut3yp-iTaNhMb)

Hey Everyone 👋,

We are [Xiangkai](https://www.linkedin.com/in/xiangkai-zeng/) and [Zihao](https://www.linkedin.com/in/zihaolin123/) - co-founders of [Klavis AI](https://www.klavis.ai/).

**TL;DR**

Klavis AI provides [open source](https://github.com/Klavis-AI/klavis) MCP integration for AI applications. Integrate enterprise-grade MCP servers with your AI application in a minute, and scale to millions of users using our open-source, hosted MCP servers with multi-tenancy auth, and skip MCP client-side development hassle.

**Ask:** Can you introduce us to companies working on AI agents and applications that need different external integrations? Contact us at [xiangkaiz@klavis.ai](mailto:xiangkaiz@klavis.ai).

Launch video: https://youtu.be/HFn5xWC6cAk

**The Problem**

* **Missing Native Authentication & User-based Authentication:** Lack of built-in and user-based authentications in MCP servers creates security risks and adds development complexity, hindering production use.
* **Lack of Enterprise-Grade Servers:** Available MCP servers are frequently underdeveloped personal projects, lacking stability, features, and remote capabilities essential for enterprise environments.
* **Client-Side Connection Barrier**: Accessing MCP servers requires developing the clients, creating technical overhead and hindering adoption, especially for existing function calling infrastructures that lack native MCP support.

**The Solution**

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcq7Lridm_hh7ACd4DFh6Zcsc38dMU3Kp8X9MdK55P_JuQVQ-ZMA6Pc75Qs7C0wc3vDdjlMOVmTCHNVZ-5MUpNbrLibGrFzzcARZme9csIpjPP5yENtddc01TW1newc1A1pGFepKw?key=HpOTxrRvVOxut3yp-iTaNhMb)

Klavis AI solves these problems by:

* **Secure, Enterprise-Grade Hosted Servers:** Launch stable, enterprise-grade MCP servers instantly via API. Our hosted solution includes built-in OAuth & multi-tenancy auth, eliminating security gaps and complexity.
* **Skip Client Development Hassle:** Use our API to connect any remote MCP servers from your existing backend, or let users interact immediately through our pre-built Web, Slack, and Discord clients.
* **Trust Through Open Source:** Our MCP servers and clients are open source, ensuring transparency and fostering community trust.

**Concrete Example**

Imagine you want your AI agent to interact with your company's Jira. Instead of building a custom Jira integration and wrestling with authentication, use Klavis AI. With simple API calls, you instantly get a secure, hosted Jira MCP server ready to go. It handles OAuth and user-level authentications automatically, letting your AI securely query tickets right away – no MCP client coding required.

**Why Us**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90202&key=user_uploads/259581/6621b1de-ea41-46f4-bc9e-97b0676a7c97)

Xiangkai previously worked as a Senior Software Engineer on the Google Gemini at Google Deepmind. His work involves building the function calling infrastructure for Gemini and supporting multiple Gemini agentic feature launches. The challenges in the MCP space resonate strongly with his background, and he's very excited to bring his insights and energy to accelerate innovation here.

Zihao previously worked on Lyft’s Rider team and Nordstrom’s analytical data platform team, with expertise in scaling systems for millions of users and NLP background from University and Master studies.

**🙏 Our Asks**

* **Share & Intro:** Can you share this post and introduce us to companies working on AI agents and applications that need different external integrations?
* **Connect:** Email me at [xiangkaiz@klavis.ai](mailto:xiangkaiz@klavis.ai) if you’d like to learn more or chat.

launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90162&key=user_uploads/1091672/94e086c6-918d-4975-94ca-5aece8bff85a)

Hey, I'm Win, founder of [ParaQuery](http://www.paraquery.com).

We're building a bigger query engine with up to 5x cost efficiency compared to BigQuery by using cost-efficient cloud GPUs.

**Ask:** Do you know someone optimizing their data warehouse? Email [win@paraquery.com](mailto:win@paraquery.com) or sign up [here](https://paraquery.com/waitlist)!

**4x'ing** BigQuery efficiency with ParaQuery: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uu379YnccGU> 

# **The Problem**

Data is the new oil and you're feeding your products with a bunch of it. But to do so, you need to build, maintain, and optimize your data infra. That's either a huge timesink, or you're bleeding cash to ignore it, or someone is breathing down your neck about this month's cloud bill. Why can't we just ship features?

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90162&key=user_uploads/1091672/419acb3d-1195-4842-a80e-df02ac0d332f)

Whether it's those 20-minute+ Presto queries, or your exploding BigQuery bill (which happens to be tracked in real time), your data infra is letting you down.

# **Our Solution**

ParaQuery runs on highly-parallel, throughput-optimized cloud-available hardware, perfect for data processing workloads: **GPUs**!

Our system abstracts out the infra required to serverlessly accelerate your logic. With the extreme efficiency of GPUs, it's half the cost and double the performance of competing solutions like Databricks and BigQuery, without any platform commitments.

For SQL-based data warehouses like BigQuery, you can use ParaQuery with minimal changes to your queries. And since it's fully Spark-compatible, there's no vendor lock-in. It integrates with literally anything which has a Spark connector, on any major cloud. We can even deploy on GPU clouds.

ParaQuery makes data processing as simple as specifying:

1. Inputs
2. Output
3. Logic
4. Run!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90162&key=user_uploads/1091672/a6cded39-2da7-432b-9129-014a593caaae)

# **Why?**

I've been looking into GPUs and parallel programming for over 12 years – starting out with crypto. I left that field pretty fast, but I never stopped thinking about efficient compute and GPU acceleration. Even more so when, years later, I had to wait for my laptop to finish 18-hour physics simulations. And during my professional career, I've also had to wait on my fair share of 20-minute+ analytical queries.

In fact, I hate waiting. ParaQuery is productizing an arbitrage of hardware efficiency, and I'm not waiting any longer to do so.

# **Ask**

1\. If you know anyone who is running any big data processing scenarios (including MLOps), I'd love to learn more about their use case and see if we're a fit! 

2\. If you want to try it out, sign up for our waitlist at [www.paraquery.com](http://www.paraquery.com), or just email me ([win@paraquery.com](mailto:win@paraquery.com))

launches.body:
# TL;DR

Deploy AI models locally, privately, and offline in any app using Cactus. Cactus is a blazing-fast inference engine optimized for smartphones and comes with React Native, Flutter, and Kotlin bindings.

https://youtu.be/xwKrmYkJZD8

# Our framework:

Cactus is a cross-platform & open-source framework for doing inference on smartphones, wearables, and other low power devices. It supports any LLM or VLM available on HuggingFace directly.

The recently released Google AI Edge and Apple Foundation Frameworks are platform-specific and primarily support specific models from the companies.

To this end, Cactus:

* Is available in Flutter and React-Native for cross-platform developers, since most apps are built with these today.
* Supports any GGUF model you can find on Huggingface; Qwen, Gemma, Llama, DeepSeek, Phi, Mistral, SmolLM, SmolVLM, InternVLM, Jan Nano etc.
* Accommodates from FP32 to as low as 2-bit quantized models, for better

  efficiency and less device strain.
* Have MCP tool-calls to make models performant, truly helpful (set reminder, gallery search, reply messages) and more.
* Fallback to big cloud models for complex, constrained or large-context tasks, ensuring robustness and high availability.

So far, our customers have built:

* Personalised and private RAG and prompt-enhancement pipelines for their app users.
* Offline fallback for the big remote AI models.
* Phone tool use agents like gallery & calendar management.
* AI for medical and other privacy-pertinent industries.

launches.tagline: AI agents that fully automate specialist referrals
launches.body:
Primary care providers make over 100 million referrals to specialists every year, leading to tens of millions of hours in manual coordination work. We built AI agents to automate the entire specialist referral process for primary care groups.

[**https://youtu.be/LqlDMjHARl0**](https://youtu.be/LqlDMjHARl0**)

## **Problem**

Managing specialist referrals is one of the most time-consuming workflows in primary care. Staff must manually copy data between systems, complete prior authorizations, call specialists to verify information and request medical records, and coordinate with patients.

Many clinics are forced to hire or outsource their referrals, but they’re still understaffed. As a result, referrals often never get sent, are returned for missing authorizations, or go to out-of-network providers. Nonetheless, poor referral management has significant consequences:

* In value-based care models, specialist routing has a massive impact on medical spending. Out-of-network costs and unnecessary procedures are major cost drivers.
* Groups that depend on federal funding or grants, like FQHCs, can lose funding due to poor referral follow-through.
* Patients who experience delays in care because of referrals are likely to churn and find a new primary care provider.

## **Product**

We partnered with a network of rural health clinics in west Texas to understand the specialist referral process. We started by manually handling referrals, then built AI agents to automate the whole workflow. Our agents are live across the network, where we’ve:

* Sped up referral processing time by 82%
* Found available appointment times that were 55% sooner
* Led to 44% fewer referral kickbacks

## **Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95206&key=user_uploads/1184840/3e4114e5-24ec-4c32-af9c-37c3848f300c)

Tanishq Kancharla has worked in startups throughout his career. He was a product engineer at Shortwave, leading development on their iOS and Desktop apps, used by tens of thousands of people. Prior to this he double majored in physics and computer science at Carnegie Mellon.

Michael Kronovet was technical lead overseeing Palantir's work with the US State Department, quadrupling annual revenue without increasing headcount. Previously, he built causal inference models at a healthcare startup. He graduated in 3 years from Carnegie Mellon with a BS in statistics and machine learning.

**Our Ask**

If you know anyone who works in or adjacent to primary care we’d love to be connected!

* Some examples: people who work in MSOs, ACOs, primary care groups, RHCs, FQHCs or payor/insurance groups.

**TL;DR:** AI-powered truck management software to automate back-office operations for trucking companies.\
[**Check us Out!**](https://drive.google.com/file/d/18BF2PM5YkSSTOXs9yqM_CQ0jv2Gy9xFD/view?usp=sharing)

**The Problem and Solution:**

Trucking has always been a mission critical industry, with nearly 70% of all US goods hauled via trucks, resulting in a need for continuous operations. This results in an industry that hasn’t paused for a tech update in years; in my time in the industry, I saw dozens of offices running on pen and paper or excel spreadsheets, documents being sent in WhatsApp group chats connected to printers, and I myself had 3 phones all on hold menus with different people. And even the largest of companies today navigate a maze of outdated, poorly integrated point-solutions.

So, alongside Anthony and Sam, I decided to build a product that rectifies those problems. With Hemut’s software, you can replace pen and paper scribbles with intuitive oversight of even national level fleets, replace the WhatsApp group chats and manual data entry with AI document parsing, and eliminate the need for 3 phones with AI agents to automate inbound/outbound calls. With Hemut, trucking companies can execute every step of the trucking workflow—from finding and booking a shipment, driver communication, and logging every last dollar—all on one platform, with efficiency never seen before.

**The Story:**

At 16 years old, I got kicked out of my home and faced homelessness, working 100-hour weeks at a motel where I met a truck driver who I eventually helped file paperwork for. Siezing the opportunity, I also helped file paperwork for his friends too, eventually saving enough money to start dispatching trucks and put a roof over my head.

Fast forward 6 years to the end of 2024, I realized that voice AI would eventually be capable enough to automate a lot of the bottlenecks I encountered during my time in the logistics industry.

**Our Ask:**

Always looking to learn about the cutting edge of tech and the people driving the innovation so feel free to say hi. If you also happen to know anyone in the trucking industry (veteran trucker. investor, or dev), we’d love to be introduced!

name: chrt
long_description:
chrt is a logistics platform for time-critical shipping. We enable businesses to deliver their most critical items same-day.

Time-Critical Logistics is a $30B market growing at a 20% CAGR driven by growth in American healthcare and manufacturing.

Businesses that place time-critical orders are enterprises who have urgent items they need to deliver ASAP. These orders are critical in nature and often require white glove service -- think therapeutic treatments for healthcare providers or specialized equipment for manufacturers. 

chrt builds the software for forwarders and professional couriers who pick up and deliver these orders. Couriers use chrt to coordinate and track their shipments, including a driver app and fleet management tools. Forwarders use chrt to dispatch couriers, book flights, and track time-critical orders from start to finish. Shippers use chrt to place these orders with their providers and to monitor everything. 

In addition, we also sell physical tracking devices that can be used to track valuable cargo or assets.

This gives us full control of the shipment and allows us to provide shippers with end-to-end tracking. It also allows us to intervene early if we notice something is going wrong.

We’re software engineers that became friends years ago at McKinsey. Kyle is an expert in Time-Critical Logistics, having led strategy at a leader in the space. Aaron is an expert at designing and implementing AI systems to handle complex coordination. We were shipping code together on nights and weekends for years before chrt; now we’re also shipping freight.

launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90555&key=user_uploads/525065/9bbd9d91-5dba-43e0-9412-2c45bac5782a)

Hey everyone! 👋 We're Brandon, Sam, and Akul - Co-founders of [MindFort.ai](http://MindFort.ai).

We're building fully autonomous AI security agents that find, validate, and patch vulnerabilities in web applications and networks at machine speed and scale.

https://youtu.be/Oe-errlwaow

## 🔥 The Problem

Security is fundamentally broken for most engineering teams today:

* **Scanners are unreliable** - They flood engineers with 30-50% false positives, wasting precious development time
* **Traditional pen testing is too slow** - It happens quarterly at best, costs a fortune, and takes weeks to complete
* **AI-accelerated development creates new risks** - Teams are shipping code faster than ever, but security reviews have become an even bigger bottleneck

The result? Companies are forced to choose between shipping fast or shipping secure. Engineering teams lose **\~20%** of their time dealing with security issues or slowing down to accommodate outdated security practices.

## 🚀 Our Solution

[MindFort.ai](http://MindFort.ai)'s autonomous security agents work 24/7/365 to find, validate, and patch vulnerabilities:

* **Find** complex vulnerabilities like a human tester would
* **Validate** every finding to eliminate false positives
* **Patch** with intelligent fixes that integrate directly with your codebase
* **Scale** to thousands of tests in an instant, giving coverage never possible before

Unlike solutions that slow development, MindFort accelerates it by eliminating security bottlenecks. Our platform is already finding vulnerabilities in production systems that other tools miss, identifying issues in bug bounty programs, and scoring high on human penetration testing benchmarks.

## 💡 Our Story

Brandon worked as a PM at ProjectDiscovery, a security scanner company where he led development of the Nuclei cloud platform from an open source tool to an enterprise ready product. He then joined NetSPI, one of the world’s largest penetration testing firms, to build generative AI tools for human testers. He sat with countless customers across both companies, learning about their struggles in securing attack surfaces at scale.

Akul received his masters in computer science from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, and was drawn to AI and security early on in his academic career. He co-authored multiple papers on using LLMs to perform various cybersecurity attacks, worked on creating novel benchmarks for hacking agents, and participated in red teaming and model safety programs at both OpenAI and Anthropic.

Sam worked as a senior engineer at Salesforce, where he led security for a large business unit, Tableau. During his time there, he worked first hand on keeping a large scale product secure. Between juggling security assessments, validating findings, and managing remediations inside of a large organization, he had seen it all. He began experimenting with ways to use AI to help solve some of the issues he faced at Salesforce and even worked on a demo of a tool to perform agentic code review through a DARPA program. He recently completed a master’s degree in cybersecurity at UC Berkeley.

We all met through our work and research. Early on, we all realized that the future of security was going to belong to AI agents, and that the coming tidal wave of new code generated with AI would need a solution of equal magnitude.

launches.title: Cotool - Composable AI Agents for every Security Team
launches.tagline: Reduce time spent on investigations and detection engineering by 90%
launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋

We're [Eddie](https://www.linkedin.com/in/eddieconk/), [Logan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/logan-carmody/), and [Max](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mmpollard/) – co-founders of [Cotool](https://cotool.ai).

### TL;DR

Cotool uses AI to automate repetitive security workflows so teams can focus on threat hunting instead of manual tasks. Our early users have used the copilot and agents to cut investigation time by 90% and increase detection quality & coverage. Book a demo to learn how you can do the same!\
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GnyZuJGQ5C0

### ❌ The Problem

Security is complex, but the problems facing most teams are not:

1. Alert Fatigue: Hours lost to false positives, while genuine threats slip by unnoticed.
2. Context Switching: Investigations requiring constant toggling across 5-10 disconnected tools just to assemble basic context.
3. Documentation Overhead: Teams spend more time as technical writers than security practitioners, bogged down in endless reporting.

Before founding Cotool, we collaborated with cutting-edge security teams including OpenAI, Coinbase, Figma, and DoorDash, experiencing these universal challenges firsthand.

Advancements in AI now offer an opportunity to truly reimagine this model; by building intuitive, collaborative tools that complement, not replace, security professionals.

### 👷 Our Solution

Cotool provides a suite of Agents and an AI co-pilot designed specifically for security teams, streamlining workflows and reducing frustration through:

* Seamless Investigations 🔍: A true AI co-pilot that works alongside security engineers during alert triage, investigations, and detection engineering; automatically gathering relevant context from across tools so they can focus on reasoning, not tool-hopping.
* No-code Agents 🤖: Turn successful debugging flows into reusable agents, then refine their behavior with natural language prompts and connect them to any tools Cotool has access to, with granular permission controls.
* Automated Documentation 📊: Generating thorough, accurate reports in seconds, freeing up valuable security practitioner time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90398&key=user_uploads/2254937/d59dd9d1-e396-4f77-8dce-283a5e31c4ee)

### 👨‍💻 The Team

We have worked together for years and co-founded Cotool in 2025.

[Max Pollard](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mmpollard/) (CEO) led the forward deployed engineering team at Material, working directly with security teams to understand their workflows and pain points. He built the team up from one to 8 engineers and embedded himself with the world's best security programs. Previously he worked as a SE at Okta. He holds a BA in Business and Computer Science from UC Berkeley.

[Eddie Conk](https://www.linkedin.com/in/eddieconk/) (CPO + Head of AI) spent the last 3 years at Material Security, leading the ML Engineering function. He developed and trained AI models for detecting Phishing emails at scale for some of the largest and most secure companies in the world. Previously he was an ML Engineer at Apple, and holds a BA in Computer Science from UC Berkeley.

[Logan Carmody](https://www.linkedin.com/in/logan-carmody/) (CTO) was an early engineer and the technical lead for the Phishing Protection product at Material Security. He helped develop the proprietary language and compiler which Material’s threat researchers used to detect Phishing messages and Workspace breaches. He previously was a Staff SWE at LinkedIn working in infrastructure, and holds a BS in Computer Science and Philosophy from Duke University.

Together, we've spent years embedded with some of the world's best security teams. We're passionate about helping security teams focus on what they do best – hunting threats, not handling workflows.

**TL;DR: [Propolis](https://propolis.tech) unleashes AI swarms that eliminate QA by automatically testing your product like real users would**. **Our solution, in production, has already become the go to for fast shipping engineering teams.**

**_Ask_**: Do you know any engineering teams bottlenecked by QA or looking to ship faster? Contact us at [marc@propolis.tech](mailto:marc@propolis.tech).

Hi! We’re Marc and Matt, tenured former leads of large and gnarly implementations and deployments at Palantir and Airtable (+ a bunch of startups!). We’re building Propolis.

**❌ The Problem:** Software development cycles have accelerated substantially over the past year. Yet, testing remains stuck in the past, relying on either slow manual QA or brittle automation that breaks with every product change, creating three major pains:

1. Wasted engineering time
2. Delayed releases
3. Bugs reaching real users

These intensify as companies scale, with some dedicating entire teams to QA or accepting that their users will find the bugs for them. But with Propolis, this is finally changing:

https://youtu.be/3AxEHNmTqyc

**🐝 Our Solution:** Propolis deploys autonomous browser agents that think and behave like real users. They build an understanding of your application and communicate with one another. Teams simply provide a URL and credentials, and get access to:

* **Complete test coverage** 🧪: AI agents explore your entire product, discovering and testing every possible user flow.
* **Precise bug reporting** 🐛: Detailed reports delivered directly to Slack, Linear, Github, or wherever with videos, traces, and reproduction steps.

**🙏 Our Ask:** If the above seems like something you or someone you know needs, please get in touch!

We're offering our next batch of customers:

* A walkthrough of our agents traversing your application
* Recently harvested honey for the next 10 companies that sign up! 🍯 (We're recreational beekeepers, hence the name)

Contact us at [marc@propolis.tech](mailto:marc@propolis.tech)

**👬 The Team** Marc and Matt have both personally struggled with the reality of losing precious time QAing instead of shipping, countless hours clicking through flows and writing tests. They’ve bonded over their mutual fondness for deploying solutions that break the mold.

[Marc](https://www.linkedin.com/in/marc-papazian/) was previously Director of Product at an AI startup and a deployment lead at Palantir - where he led work building the operational data backbone for the entire Federal pandemic response. He makes wine halfway across the world in Armenia (ironically, he does NOT like wine).

[Matt](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mattmattmattmatt/) was previously a senior engineer at Airtable, where he worked on infrastructure that helped eliminate the need for manual QA. He’s been frontline for hundreds of product releases and deploys, and knows what it takes to be confident in the code you’re shipping.

name: Cactus
long_description:
HVAC, plumbing, roofing, and electrical companies spend $3K–$25K every month making the phone ring - then lose 10–20% of those leads to slow response times, missed calls, and zero follow-up. The revenue was already there. It just walked out the back door.

Cactus closes that gap on both sides.

Inbound: Every call answered in under 60 seconds, 24/7 qualified and booked directly into Housecall Pro, Jobber, FieldEdge, or ServiceTitan. No voicemails. No missed jobs.

Outbound: Warm leads, dormant customers, and unworked estimates get proactively contacted - driving repeat jobs, cross-sells, upsells, and referrals without adding headcount.

The result: 20–30% more jobs from the ad budget you're already spending.

What that looks like in practice:

→ Roofing company, NC | $299K collected in 10 weeks. $1.41M pipeline created. 199× ROI. $48K of that revenue came in after hours — while the office was closed.

→ Plumbing & HVAC company, UT | $180K confirmed revenue in 4 months. 90× ROI. 58% of captured leads came after hours — jobs that would have gone to voicemail now go straight into the CRM.

→ General contracting company | Grew from 11 jobs/month to 72 in a single month — 555% growth. $2.09M invoiced. $1.82M collected. Zero new hires.

→ Roofing & siding company | $228K pipeline in 75 days. 92% of calls converted to hot leads. $804K in net sales during the Cactus period. 49 spam calls filtered automatically — hours of staff time saved.

→ Commercial signage company | $398K pipeline generated in 10 weeks. 111× ROI on $3,597 invested. Grew from 0% to 30% share of total company pipeline in a single month.

If we don't add revenue, we don't stay. That's the only way this works.

The $150B home services industry is still running on voicemail and spreadsheets. We're building the system that changes that - one answered call at a time.

After working with hundreds of small business owners, they saw a common problem: time spent on administrative tasks was keeping great service providers from growing their businesses.

They created Cactus to change that. Designed as an AI copilot for home service businesses, Cactus expands a company’s capacity without increasing headcount — helping owners scale faster, serve more customers, and operate with the efficiency of a much larger team.

Founded by entrepreneurs, the mission is simple: to help home service businesses succeed and thrive, no matter their size. Cactus brings clarity, automation, and peace of mind to busy teams, removing daily bottlenecks so owners can focus on growth.

launches.title: StarSling Runners - Self-Driving CI
launches.tagline: Fast GitHub Actions runners with AI agents that continuously improve your CI to make it up to 6x faster and 13x cheaper.
launches.body:
Hey everyone!

We're Yonas & Daniel, co-founders of [StarSling](https://www.starsling.dev).

**TL;DR: [StarSling Runners](https://starsling.dev/)** are an AI-native drop-in replacement for ubuntu-latest that continuously make your CI up to **6x faster** and **13x cheaper**. On day one, StarSling Runners are faster and cheaper. From there, AI agents analyze your pipelines and continuously ship optimization PRs.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IxcYY5cuSXA>

**🤔 Why now**

Coding agents made writing code dramatically faster, and they’ve pushed PR volume up, which compounds CI times and cost fast.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=104233&key=user_uploads/7866/2149565f-569b-4f8d-b4b3-9eab341daf0f)

Everyone has the option of getting fast CI runners now. What nobody has is **CI that adapts and improves itself**.

Meanwhile, keeping a CI pipeline fast is a constant manual chore: caches break, tests get flaky, build steps pile up, and someone has to notice and fix it, over and over. We believe DevOps tooling like CI should be as agentic as coding is, and that's the unlock behind self-driving CI: the optimization work that used to be a recurring human task now runs continuously in the background as part of the infrastructure running it.

**🔥 The problem**

Keeping CI fast is nobody's job and everybody's problem:

* **Pipelines rot.** Caches get misconfigured, dependency installs get slow, tests turn flaky, build steps stop being parallel. Performance quietly degrades until someone carves out time to fix it.
* **Fast runners alone don't solve it.** Swapping in faster hardware helps once, then your setup drifts right back as you add more code and tests and they get more complex. Plenty of products give you faster runners. None of them keep your pipeline optimized for you.
* **It's getting worse.** Recent GitHub Actions pricing changes hit teams running lots of jobs, and GitHub's focus has clearly moved elsewhere. When we surveyed companies looking for DevOps AI solutions, a GitHub Actions agent was the single most-requested solution engineers wanted.

**🧯 The solution: self-driving CI**

StarSling Runners are an AI-native, drop-in replacement for ubuntu-latest\
that get faster the longer you use them:

* **Fast infrastructure on day one.** 5th Gen AMD EPYC (\~30% faster than GitHub), actions/cache compatible with zero config, unlimited concurrency.
* **AI agents that optimize your CI for you.** Agents continuously scan your workflows, jobs, run logs, and machine telemetry, then open optimization PRs: fixing caching, speeding up dependency installs, parallelizing build steps, sharding tests, and restructuring workflows. This is the part nobody else does. Real PRs our agents opened and customers merged: [sharding E2E tests across 3 parallel jobs](https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/15888) (Mastra), [optimizing Playwright browser installs](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/8073) and [fixing turbo cache config](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/7950) (Better Auth).
* **Cheaper, with no surprises.** $0.008/min vs GitHub's $0.012/min (33% cheaper), queue time never billed, no seat fees.
* **You stay in control.** Every agent-authored optimization ships as a PR your team reviews and merges.
* **Secure by default.** Every job runs in its own single-use, hardware-isolated microVM that's destroyed after the run, the same isolation model GitHub-hosted runners use. Secrets pass directly from GitHub to your job and are never stored by StarSling.
* **One-line install.** Install the [StarSling GitHub App](https://github.com/apps/starslingdev) and copy our AI install prompt to swap ubuntu-latest\
  for starsling-ubuntu-24.04. You're on faster runners immediately, with 2,000 free minutes your first month. The optimization agents are in early access right now, so request access and we'll turn them on for your repos. **👇**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=104233&key=user_uploads/7866/a91c193f-d5e1-4d00-a93c-1dfd6381666b)

**📈 Traction**

After being in private beta for the past four months, StarSling has now run over **one million CI jobs** for fast-moving teams like Better Auth, Mastra, Partcl, and more, and the self-driving AI agents is what won them over:

* [**Mastra**](https://starsling.dev/customers/mastra) got **6x faster** CI:
  * _"The runners are just handled, so nobody on my team thinks about CI infrastructure anymore, and the agents keep optimizing for the one thing I care about: minutes saved."_ - Abhi Aiyer, Co-founder & CTO at Mastra (YC W25)
* [**Better Auth**](https://starsling.dev/customers/better-auth) got **2x faster** E2E:
  * _"StarSling agents are like a CI engineer we never had to hire. They find the slow spots, test out fixes, find the ones that work and open the PRs themselves."_ - Bereket Engida, Founder & CEO at Better Auth (P25)
* [**Partcl**](https://starsling.dev/customers/partcl) got **13x cheaper** CI, and the agents proved themselves on day one:
  * _"Within a day of migrating to StarSling Runners, their agents opened up a PR that literally made our Rust CI tests 2x faster!"_ - Vamshi Balanaga, Co-founder & CTO at Partcl (YC P25)

Full case studies: <https://starsling.dev/customers>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=104233&key=user_uploads/7866/10826f60-8e4d-41a8-a800-32026a78bfc8)


**🏋️ Team**

**Daniel** led the 12-person engineering team at Netflix that built their Internal Developer Portal ("Netflix Console"), the central hub for Netflix's 3,000+ engineers and the highest-DAU internal developer tool at the company. Before Netflix he was on Facebook's AI Camera team, building computer vision that powers camera effects for 100M+ DAUs across Instagram, Facebook, and WhatsApp.

**Yonas** built StackShare, one of the largest online developer communities (1.5M+ registered developers), with an enterprise offering used by Fortune 500s to surface tech stack data across thousands of internal codebases. StackShare was acquired by FOSSA in 2024.

We've spent our careers on developer tools, and self-driving CI is the first part of a suite of tools we always wished we had.

**🔮 Vision**

DevOps should be as agentic as coding. CI is just the start. We're building toward a world where your entire pipeline improves on its own and AI agents take on the slow, manual engineering work that’s left after your coding agents finish, across the whole SDLC, so your team ships faster.

**👇 Our ask**

* **Try it.** If your team runs CI on ubuntu-latest, you're a one line change away from faster runs: <https://starsling.dev>. YC companies get 50% off the first year.
* **Intros.** If you know a CTO or VP Eng at a company drowning in CI time or cost, we'd love an intro: 📧 [founders@starsling.dev](mailto:founders@starsling.dev)

Happy Slinging!

\- Yonas & Daniel

launches.body:
Hey everyone! 

We’re Yonas & Daniel - Co-founders of [StarSling](https://www.starsling.dev).

StarSling (https://starsling.dev) is a developer portal that turns your daily unplanned work from all your dev tools into one-click actions, powered by AI. Open your homepage, click on a GitHub, Linear, or Sentry issue and you’ll see an Autofix button that triggers an agent and opens a Pull Request with a fix, all without leaving your portal. It’s AI agents for the tasks that live outside of your code editor, across deployments, performance, incidents, and bugs.

https://youtu.be/-rbrSNyguHY 

**🌄 Our Story**

Daniel led an engineering team at Netflix that built their Internal Developer Portal (IDP), called Netflix Console. It was the central hub for Netflix's 3,000+ engineers, managers and leaders and became the highest DAU internal tool for developers at Netflix.

Yonas built StackShare, one of the largest online developer communities that had over 1.5M registered developers and an enterprise offering used by thousands of companies that integrated tech stack data into their IDPs and other internal tools.

Both of us have seen the challenges that developers at large companies face in keeping their tech stacks healthy across thousands of codebases. We’ve also seen the benefits that a high-quality single IDP brings to engineering teams. We believe that AI agents have created a unique opportunity for developers to get the benefits of an IDP with automation baked in from the start.

**🔥 The Problem**

Developers typically spend \~20% of their time on annoying eng tasks outside of their code editor:

* Fixing exceptions
* Patching flaky CI builds and tests
* Updating engineering docs and changelogs
* Investigating and remediating incidents
* Optimizing slow database queries
* Debugging preview and staging environments
* Rotating expiring credentials and keys

These tasks are spread out across many different developer tools and workflows: Sentry, GitHub, CircleCI, PagerDuty, Supabase, Vercel and many more. StarSling is unifying these tools and bringing AI agents to the rest of the software development lifecycle (SDLC).\
**🧯 Our Solution**

We're building a system of AI agents that perform engineering tasks using the deep context that only exists in an internal developer portal (IDP). One central command center that houses internal services, applications, APIs, documentation and has AI agents continuously improving them. We bring your tools into one system and give you powerful workflows by orchestrating AI agents across these tools.

Our first offering is an agentic developer homepage that shows you your aggregated task list along with actions that AIs can take on your behalf. In your homepage you’ll see: your open PRs, exceptions, tickets, notifications, and more alongside AI agents.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90469&key=user_uploads/7866/d4f9f3c3-e7b9-485b-9920-3d04e80d385f)

Soon StarSling will orchestrate agents across the more complex tasks like investigating incidents. Our immediate goal is to be the interface and “portal” to all the AI agents for the dev tools you already use.

**🔮 Our Vision**

To create a system of AI agents that allows every engineer to spend close to 0% of their time dealing with deployments, performance, incidents, and bugs.

**👇 Our Ask**

If you’re a developer working on a production system, we’d love to show you StarSling and get your feedback!

👉 Signup for the waitlist: https://starsling.dev

📧 Email us: [founders@starsling.dev](mailto:founders@starsling.dev)

launches.tagline: Program verification for superhumanly complex code
launches.body:
### **TL;DR:** **Please give us your most complicated coding problem that _needs_ to be correct. [Sign up!](https://theoremlabs.com/waitlist/)**

Hello World! We’re [Jason](https://jasongross.github.io/) and [Rajashree](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=41ZE3NwAAAAJ&hl=en&oi=ao)! We think AI code generation is going to be bigger than any of us can imagine.

### **MISSION**

Theorem is an AI and programming languages research lab. Our question: as the models get better at generating code, what is the bottleneck to safely deploying vastly more computation in the world? 

* _Code has bugs._  AI-enabled attackers will increase the volume and velocity of attacks on software infrastructure. Human code review will not scale.
* _AIs are untrusted generators._ In order to deploy AIs in critical systems without fully understanding their generalization behavior, we’ll need robust, scalable methods for overseeing their solutions.

### **OPPORTUNITY**

Programming languages and formal methods is the promise that we can bootstrap roots of trust. Even as complexity of software goes up, we can design simple interfaces for steering with leverage.

Previously, this technology was only applied to the most mission-critical infrastructure, because of the enormous labor bottleneck — requiring years of PhD level engineering work. For instance, Jason worked on the project that wrote the code generator powering trillions of secure https connections everyday, but it took fifteen man-years to complete!

With advances in AI, we’re able to speed this development cycle 10,000 times! As a [wild example](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O9nKMjjb3Hg) of what’s possible, we spent two hours finding what would have been a zero-day in https code from 2011.

### **OUR APPROACH**

We want to build workflows for trustworthy-by-default programming by pushing our best ideas till they break. The current candidate to beat is _program equivalence_ driven development. You oversee a simple reference implementation. We give you an optimized implementation, along with a proof that the programs are functionally equivalent. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90592&key=user_uploads/2206829/f5c671df-ac60-4b94-8081-36ae8c0aeda4)

We’re gradually rolling out our programming environment and models. Some use cases from our customers:

* Performance optimization: finding edge cases where hyper-optimized GPU code would fail; getting clear documentation of dependencies that modify behavior in unforeseen ways. 
* Code migration: automating legacy code refactors from Python to Rust while proving no functional change; writing custom kernels to support new services.

**If you work in public infrastructure, finance, hardware, or have other use cases that demand correctness, we’d love to help. Please reach out at [founders@theoremlabs.com](mailto:founders@theoremlabs.com)**

* **Typically, then agents hallucinate when they can't find data,** or rely on inefficient chains of function calls

* **Open-Source**
* **Simple yet powerful search interface** via REST or MCP

* **Connect to your agent to your favorite apps** like Google Drive, Gmail, Outlook, Google Calendar, HubSpot, Notion, Jira, Slack, Dropbox, Stripe, Github, etc.

* **File Handling:** Supported formats: DOCX, PDF, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, TXT, PNG, JPEG

* Legal AI assistants searching Google Drive/OneDrive to give accurate Perplexity-like answers
* Agents for engineering managers scanning GitHub, Notion, and Jira to understand codebases and draft design docs

launches.body:
**The problem**

Right now, the most sophisticated hedge funds pay over-qualified data engineers to spend hours a day on the under-levered task of data cleaning. It's crazy to anyone outside of the industry, but in finance even earnings dates (the date a company reports earnings) are considered **a known hard problem.**

https://youtu.be/V-OpzDRge3o

**Our ask**

We've solved this problem and our ask to the YC community is - **connect us with anyone you know who works in the investing world and uses data (should be all of them).** You can email us at [founders@usesieve.com](mailto:nicole@usesieve.com).

**Who we are**

After studying CS at MIT, I worked at Citadel and McKinsey, and Savannah worked at Bain. We've dealt with this problem first hand and were amazed that there weren't good solutions.

**What we've built**

sieve lets hedge funds replace manual review in their data pipelines with a simple API call, so their engineers and analysts can get back to more differentiated work. Behind the scenes, we use AI to find and retrieve the appropriate source documents and to extract the requested data. Each data point is reviewed by a team of expert reviewers before being returned to the client. This lets us achieve the level of accuracy hedge funds need, and that AI-only approaches aren't able to achieve.

We offer direct API access and access via other tools like Excel. Watch below to see how the excel integration works!

[**https://youtu.be/r6A1t_X2kZo**](https://youtu.be/r6A1t_X2kZo)

**What the early results look like**

* sieve is able to replace manual data cleaning workflows:
  * accurately (100% match to data that was hand-collected internally)
  * more scalably (weeks of full-time work to review data became a passive background task for the data scientist)
  * more cheaply (easily 60-70% cheaper than existing options, even when that existing option is BPO outsourcing)

In our first week of YC, we were told that we need to be at least one of: better, faster, or cheaper.

launches.tagline: AI-powered security tool that prevents secret leaks in source code.
launches.body:
**Vibe coding is flooding GitHub with leaked secrets.**

As writing code becomes increasingly accessible, it's easier than ever to accidentally expose API keys, database credentials, SSH private keys, and more.

**TLDR:** BitPatrol detects secret leaks in your source code that traditional scanners miss, helping you prevent costly data breaches.

🎥 **Launch Video:** [Watch here](https://youtu.be/2qu3B_bX7dw)

---

### **The Problem**

Secret leaks are happening every day, impacting companies across every industry. Traditional scanning tools attempt to catch these leaks using rigid regex patterns and keyword matching.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90617&key=user_uploads/2475147/274a7869-42fd-41fc-86f4-668846d4d01e)

However, these methods struggle with secrets that don't follow set patterns, allowing critical leaks like these to slip through undetected.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90617&key=user_uploads/2475147/e67f96a4-a636-461e-9434-93a92f23f1ff)

### **Our Solution**

Unlike legacy tools that rely on regular expressions, BitPatrol uses our proprietary machine learning model to detect secrets based on code context and developer intent – not just string patterns.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90617&key=user_uploads/2475147/243b128a-4438-4e39-bf3b-7c6c1b8e3d32)

Once our model flags a potential secret, we reference it against our dataset of billions of public commits, docker images, and open source packages. This helps us rapidly assess the secret's exposure frequency, drastically reducing false positives and solving the issue of alert fatigue.

Using our [GitHub App](https://github.com/apps/bitpatrol), you can trigger actions that occur when a secret is detected, including automated alerts and custom workflows to immediately respond and remediate when a secret is leaked.

### **The Team**

BitPatrol was founded by [Chris Lambert](https://www.linkedin.com/in/~chris), a former Stripe engineer who quickly rose to the top 2% globally on HackerOne after uncovering secret leaks at some of the world’s largest companies—many of which were actively using our competitor’s tools.

### 🙏 **Ask: How You Can Help**

* **Try BitPatrol:** Install our [GitHub App](https://github.com/apps/bitpatrol) and experience immediate, real-time secret detection.
* **Connect with Us:** If you know a technical leader concerned about protecting their company from secret leaks in code, please connect them to [founders@bitpatrol.io](mailto:founders@bitpatrol.io)

### 🔥 **The Deal**

To celebrate our launch, we’re offering:

* **Free 2024 Company Secret Leak Audit**
  * External-only scan — requires no internal data access
  * Deep, high-coverage audit of your public code surface (commits, mobile apps, etc.)
  * Request an [audit here](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfBwBwk9-tizbOo1y3Aj9aK6jXeX8QNKJIhwEFTp0OuvhcNAg/viewform?usp=header)
* **Exclusive early-adopter pricing**
  * Just $20/dev/month for real-time secret scanning with our [GitHub App](https://github.com/apps/bitpatrol)

Don’t let vibe coding turn into your next major breach—secure your code with BitPatrol today.

👉 [Get started at BitPatrol.io](https://bitpatrol.io/) or reach out directly: [founders@bitpatrol.io](mailto:founders@bitpatrol.io)

launches.body:
Sureform connects workplaces like hotels, warehouses, and restaurants with robotics labs to collect task-specific training data for world models and robot foundation models.

**Problem**

To create a future where robots can reliably perform specialized tasks, like restocking inventory in a pharmacy or repairing downed power lines, robotics teams need massive amounts of task-specific human and robot data. Data that’s crafted in simulation or in controlled environments doesn’t reflect the natural variation and complexity of the world, and as a result, we need significantly more real-world action data across each of the millions of highly-specialized physical tasks that need to be automated.

**Solution**

To solve this problem, Sureform’s platform enable robotics teams to get task-specific data from workplaces like hotels, construction sites, laundromats, and warehouses, where employees are equipped with head-mounted RGB cameras, stereo depth rigs, and handheld grippers that capture time-synced video, audio, pose, depth, and tactile data as they work. Every session of data captured through our platform is structured, synchronized, and delivered training-ready.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JNt7ev_ClxM>

\

If you’re working on robot foundation models or world models (or know anyone who is), reach out to [ananth@sureformhq.com](mailto:ananth@sureformhq.com) or schedule a meeting here:[ https://calendly.com/sureform-us/30min](https://calendly.com/sureform-us/30min)

E2E tests are a _pain_ to write — and an even bigger pain to maintain.

* Even no-code tools require manually defining flows or relying on flaky CSS selectors

Docket lets you:

* Write tests in plain English ("Log in, Search for Y Combinator t shirt, Add 2 shirts to cart")

* Automatically keep tests up to date with real user session data

name: Prox
long_description:
Prox turns product expertise into revenue for equipment manufacturers.

Equipment buyers rarely begin with a model number. They begin with a job, an installed system, a constraint, or a problem. The knowledge needed to qualify, recommend, configure, quote, repair, replace, or upgrade the product is scattered across manuals, catalogs, spreadsheets, calculators, product managers, applications engineers, dealer processes, support teams, and legacy systems. The result is abandoned demand, slow qualification, wrong-fit recommendations, quote delays, weak dealer follow-up, missed parts and service revenue, and dependence on a few experienced people.

Prox builds AI product specialists for equipment manufacturers. A product specialist uses the manufacturer's approved product knowledge, expert rules, calculators, and connected systems to move customers and frontline teams from a complex product question to the right purchase, quote, dealer, parts, service, replacement, or upgrade path.

How it works:

1. Understand what the person is trying to accomplish.
2. Resolve the product, application, and operating context already available.
3. Ask only for the missing information that changes the result.
4. Apply approved sources, expert rules, and deterministic tools (calculators, selectors, configurators, comparisons).
5. Produce a supported, cited recommendation, configuration, procedure, or decision artifact.
6. Move the person into the correct cart, quote, RFQ, BOM, dealer, sales, parts, service, replacement, upgrade, or expert action with the context preserved.

One product specialist, many governed skills: product discovery and comparison, sizing and configuration, competitive defense, quote preparation, dealer enablement, installation and commissioning, troubleshooting, parts identification, and approved service, replacement, and upgrade paths. Manufacturers deploy those skills to customers, dealers, sales teams, applications engineers, support teams, or field service. Existing CRM, CPQ, commerce, and support systems stay in place.

Support and service are revenue-bearing surfaces. The specialist resolves the customer's problem first, then surfaces the approved part, service, replacement, or upgrade path only when the evidence supports it.

launches.body:
Greg and Dima here - childhood friends, grew up in our families’ warehouses - now YC founders building Prox.

**launch video:** https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9Ywl-K7ncj0

---

**tldr:**

[**Prox**](https://www.prox.inc/) builds digital workforce for third-party logistics and fulfillment providers. We deployed our first agents at [**ShipBob**](https://www.linkedin.com/company/shipbob) (unicorn 3PL handling 100+ million packages per year) to automate carrier claims for lost-in-transit packages. **They're now live in production, processing hundreds of claims in parallel and on track to recover millions in carrier refunds annually.**

**what is 3PL?**

third-party logistics companies (3PLs) are the invisible infrastructure behind e-commerce brands: they warehouse inventory, fulfill orders, manage returns, and negotiate with carriers so brands don't have to.

**the problem:**

40,000+ 3PLs in the US all do the same thing: throw people at operational bottlenecks.

❌ Claims processing done manually, one by one \
❌ Invoice reconciliation eating hours of labor \
❌ Compliance paperwork blocking growth \
❌ Every increase in package volume = more back-office hires

That's the margin trap. Logistics companies stuck at 3-5% margins because headcount scales linearly with volume of packages. You can't compound when labor costs are linear.

**what we built:**

We developed an n8n-inspired agent building platform - native to logistics infrastructure. It integrates with Salesforce, warehouse & transportation management systems, carrier portals, Microsoft Teams, and email → then executes SOPs end-to-end.

With this platform, we can deploy agents in production in a matter of days.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95414&key=user_uploads/3066807/dc3e69b6-c3f6-476d-94c5-578b3a02d9de)

**use case: ShipBob Carrier Claims Automation**

Here’s an example of how our agents handle lost package claims for [ShipBob](https://shipbob.com/), one of the biggest 3PLs in the US.

> first demo at ShipBob HQ in Chicago
>
> ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95414&key=user_uploads/3066807/cd110709-17ec-410e-90c8-e3c0d7db72f5)


When a package goes missing - our agent orchestrates resolution: pull order data, calculates refund amounts, files with carriers, monitors responses, parses updates, syncs internal systems, escalates exceptions - hundreds running in parallel.

Our agents do not stop at task execution - we designed them to own outcomes. If a carrier doesn't respond, the agent follows up. If documentation is missing, it fetches it. Each agent has one objective: get the claim resolved.

**about us:**

[**Gregory Makodzeba:**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/gregory-makodzeba/)

* Founded Rektoff: built blockchain security infrastructure protecting $100B+ in crypto assets (clients: Solana Foundation)
* Led Developer Relations at Runtime Verification, working with NASA, Boeing, and Ethereum Foundation on formal verification for mission-critical systems
* Grew up implementing ERP and WMS systems in the family distribution business

[**Dima Yanovsky:**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yanovsk/)

* MIT grad: Computer Science + Electrical Engineering
* Robotics research at MIT CSAIL under Prof. Pulkit Agrawal on manipulation policies;
* Built internal and customer-facing AI agents at Pulley (YC W20) during early GPT era
* Spent childhood automating warehouse operations and business processes

We both grew up in our parents' warehouses. When we weren't moving boxes around, we were doing the mundane back-office work every warehouse has (filing claims, reconciling invoices, chasing carriers). This was the pre-LLM era, so we had no choice but to grind through manual workflows. We saw firsthand how coordination became the biggest constraint on growth - and how no software could actually handle it end-to-end.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95414&key=user_uploads/3066807/68380300-ee0e-4379-98de-de1b551b269e)

We deeply understand the ontology of logistics operations. That's why we can ship integrations in days, not months. We're building the digital workforce we wish existed back then.

If you're running logistics operations at a 3PL, fulfillment center, or freight forwarder, or know someone who is - reach out: [founders@prox.inc](mailto:founders@prox.inc)

**Hey everyone** [👋](https://emojipedia.org/waving-hand)

We’re [Raghav](https://www.linkedin.com/in/raghav-arora-516b1826b/) (17 y/o) and [Krishna](https://www.linkedin.com/in/pranavkrishnasuresh/) (19 y/o), the co-founders of [GETASAP ASIA](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/30598).

### **TL;DR**

**We are a tech-enabled distributor for retailers in Southeast Asia.** We use software to offer the lowest prices and 8 hour same day delivery to corner stores, restaurants and supermarkets.

**Today** **we supply** 40,000 outlets including 18 supermarket chains and hundreds of corner stores and restaurants. We stock 20,000+ SKUs from 270+ brands and operate several fulfillment centers across SEA.

**Ask:**

Can you intro us to CPG brands that could benefit from exposure to SEA market?

Can you intro us to US retail tech executives?

https://youtu.be/dPhL1k2n1Y8

# **❌ The Problem**

Legacy distributors _don’t believe in tech_.

• Systems don’t talk to each other, so information is stuck in separate tools.

• Lead times are long and freight isn’t optimized.

• Forecasting is guesswork, which causes stockouts during peak season and costs stores significant revenue.

• Labor costs are high, much of the work is manual, and prices are managed by hand, so margins shrink.

# [**👷**](https://emojipedia.org/construction-worker)**The Solution**

GETASAP ASIA is a tech-enabled distributor for retailers in Southeast Asia, operating a network of optimized fulfillment centers that restock stores in under 8 hours at the lowest landed price.

Our enterprise-grade demand intelligence powers our 8-hour fulfillment model and enables real time stock tracking, automated reordering for stores, and forecasting that positions inventory close to demand—so orders move from purchase to shelf within hours and stockouts approach zero.

launches.tagline: Build and deploy complex AI agents with any model and any tool in just 5 lines of code. No Docker files. No YAMLs. No wasted weeks.
launches.body:
# [**TL;DR:**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E0FR4LBTSZo)

_We’re excited to launch [Dedalus Labs](https://www.dedaluslabs.ai/), an AI-native cloud platform for developers to build agentic AI applications. Our [SDKs](https://github.com/dedalus-labs/dedalus-sdk-python) allows you to connect any LLM to any MCP servers – local or remotely hosted by us. No Docker files or YAML configs required._

* **Blog:** https://dedaluslabs.ai/blog/dedalus-seed-round
* **Product Demos:**
  * https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s2khf1Monho
  * https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4B1xuRCgLgA

# **The Problem: Building Agents Is Hard**

Building tool-using agents ≠ calling **_v1/chat/completions._**

Today, developers are still stuck with:

* Running their MCP servers locally.
* If deploying remotely, wiring up AWS and config hell.
* Juggling model quirks, streaming issues, and auth across GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, Sonnet, Flash, etc. (♾️ API keys).
* Rebuilding everything just to add a new tool.

We were **_tired_** of writing hundreds of lines of code and battling Docker files and infra—all for a spaghetti agent that breaks under stress.

**So, we built the tool we wished existed.**

# **What We Offer: Complex Agents in 5 Lines of Code**

Dedalus invented the simplest way to build and deploy agents—a drop-in infrastructure layer that unifies models, tools, and orchestration.

Our open-source SDK supports:

* Vendor-agnostic model handoffs
* Chaining both local tools and hosted MCPs
* Real-time streaming across any provider

—all in 5 lines of code.

And our managed infra lets you **deploy an MCP server in 3 clicks**, so anyone can equip their agent with tools. No Docker files, no setup.

# **Why MCP: Tools Made for Agents**

[MCP (Model Context Protocol)](https://spec.modelcontextprotocol.io/) is becoming the standard for how models talk to tools. Think of it as an API that AI models already know how to call—reliable, predictable, and language-agnostic.

As more companies adopt MCP, exposing your product as an MCP server means you’re not just serving humans anymore—you’re serving _agents._

We’re building the infrastructure that powers that shift.

# **Our Story: Two Princeton CS Students with High Standards**

We’re **Cathy** (ex-Voyage AI / Salesforce) and **Windsor** (ex-DeepMind / Sentient AGI).

We first ran into this problem while working with MCP during Windsor’s time at Sentient AGI. Every solution felt wrong: drag-and-drop GUIs, brittle configs, frameworks that broke under real workloads. Nothing met our standards for what good developer infrastructure should be.

So we built what we always wanted—a developer-first platform that makes agentic workflows composable, scalable, and effortless to ship.

**If no one else is going to build it right, we will.**

# **Get Started + Early YC Deal**

* **Quick install:** **_pip install dedalus-labs_**
* **Docs:** [docs.dedaluslabs.ai](http://docs.dedaluslabs.ai)
* **YC Deal:** we’re giving $200 free credits to every YC company. Email [founders@dedaluslabs.ai](mailto:founders@dedaluslabs.ai) to claim your deal!

launches.tagline: We help labs and enterprises train frontier computer/browser use agents
launches.body:
# **Tldr**

AI workers must learn how to use our computers, browsers, and software interfaces to deliver real-world value. Today, computer use agents are unreliable and inaccurate. Halluminate is building realistic sandboxes and datasets to train better computer/browser use AI. 

# **Ask**

Looking to chat with researchers or founders training computer/browser use agents! 

# **❌ Problem**

OpenAI’s Operator and Claude’s Computer Use give us a glimpse into the future where AI can take control of digital interfaces and do real work. 

Performance today is inaccurate/unreliable. There are two bottlenecks to performance improvements.

**First, reliance on real-world testing:** researchers today train/test their browser- and computer-use agents on real-world sites. This is

* **Unsafe** - agent actions have real consequences and data impact
* **Slow** - challenging to parallelize
* **Difficult to reproduce** - the real world is dynamic; the starting conditions cannot be “reset” easily, and data changes
* **Lots of noise -** proxy, captcha, auth/login, ads, etc,. make it difficult to do clean testing/training

**Second, lack of high-quality data:** High-quality data provides the basis for evaluations and benchmarking. Producing this at scale is expensive, time-consuming, and logistically exhausting. 

# **💡 Our Solution**

[Launch YC - Halluminate](https://www.loom.com/share/9085ae5542b54fa491c9a59115f1885b)

At Halluminate, we’re building a suite of products and services to address both these issues. 

* **Realistic sandboxes** – Fully managed, parallelizable environments modeled after popular systems (e.g., Salesforce, Slack, Ticketing Software, websites) for safe and accurate computer/browser use training and testing.
* **Datasets** – proprietary benchmarks and datasets
* **Evaluations -** high-quality error analysis powered by expert annotators to identify and prioritize the biggest failure modes for our customers

Our customers see

* Improved browser- and computer-use agent performance
* New and emergent frontier agent capabilities
* Data-driven prioritization leading to exponentially faster development speed
* Increased revenue/sales via marketing from public benchmarks

# **🌐 Our Mission**

Unlock significant advancements in browser and computer use AI capabilities. We believe this is necessary to usher in a new generation of use cases, startups, and productive AI workers. 

# **📜 Backstory**

Wyatt and I met while studying CS at Cornell and have been living and working together for over 7 years.

I previously led product/research at Capital One Labs, where I launched one of the first AI agents in banking. Wyatt previously was a Cornell Milstein scholar and did large-scale data engineering for 2 early-stage startups in NYC. 

We faced these problems first-hand while building evals for browser/computer use agent companies. We didn’t see any good solutions, so we’re building one ourselves. 

We’re in SF for the foreseeable future. Contact us if you wanna grab a coffee, go for a walk, or play pick-up basketball!

# TL;DR

TraceRoot is an open-source debugging platform that helps engineers fix production issues faster by using AI agents that intelligently leverage structured context - including traces, logs, metrics, source code, GitHub PRs, issues, and Slack threads to analyze and resolve bugs efficiently.

Our SDK just crossed 10,000 downloads and engineering teams are using our product to monitor, debug, and improve visibility for their production systems.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I9fjV_9dM-4

# Our Story

We’re Stanford-trained engineers and ex-builders from [Kumo.AI](http://Kumo.AI) (Forbes AI 50), Meta Platforms, and AWS, where we fixed 300+ production bugs and experienced firsthand how painful debugging can be in distributed systems. It was so painful that we quit our jobs to solve this problem and [open-sourced](https://github.com/traceroot-ai/traceroot) it!

# The Problem

Debugging production issues today is a mess. Here's what happens:

* You spot an error during release or in production. You open Grafana, check logs, jump to GitHub, scroll Slack, and try to piece things together.
* Sharing findings? It’s a chain of screenshots, links, and DMs - super painful.
* It takes engineers hours even days to fix a production bug.
* Meanwhile, you're drowning in 10+ P0 bugs across multiple releases, and customers won’t stop pinging you on Slack.

# Our Solution

We built TraceRoot, an agentic debugging platform that ties all your context together and helps your team get to the root cause.

* AI agents automatically summarize the issue and trace logs, spans, and GitHub context into a single execution tree. Ask the agent any question you want to debug.
* Once the issue is understood, generate GitHub issues or draft PRs directly from the platform.
* Visual trace explorer that lets you zoom into log clusters, suspicious spans, and trace paths. You can guide the agent by selecting spans or contexts to focus on.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92809&key=user_uploads/2543076/7af84b17-1836-4743-9590-dcdd3e862b8e)

# The Ask

Give our product a try! Schedule a meeting at https://cal.com/traceroot/30min or email us at [founders@traceroot.ai](mailto:founders@traceroot.ai)

launches.body:
# TLDR

AgentMail is the first email provider for AI agents. Use our API to give your agents their own email inboxes.

# Why?

We started building email agents because they can live within users’s inboxes in their inboxes and authenticate themselves with third-party applications. But building on top of legacy providers such as Gmail is a struggle. They

* Lack API support for creating new inboxes
* Charge monthly subscriptions per inbox
* Impose restrictive rate and sending limits
* Offer poor developer experience

These providers don’t scale with both inbox creation or volumes of emails sent/received that AI agents often face, so we’re rebuilding email infrastructure from scratch to enable this.

# Solution

AgentMail is an API-first email provider that gives agents their own inboxes to send, receive, and act upon emails. Think of it like Gmail, but with

 1. Programmatic inbox creation and management
 2. Usage-based pricing scaling with emails sent/received
 3. No restrictive rate/sending limits
 4. Real-time events over webhooks and websockets
 5. Simple API key auth – no OAuth headaches
 6. Built-in API permissions and agent guardrails
 7. Semantic search across every inbox in organization
 8. Automatic labeling with user-defined prompts
 9. Structured data extraction
10. And more on the way!

# Demo

In this demo, we show how easy it is to build an email agent with AgentMail: https://youtu.be/1V7BISeFUTM

In this demo, we show an example of a voice + email agent built with AgentMail: [https://youtu.be/eG2fCsRK4RY](https://youtu.be/eG2fCsRK4RY?feature=shared)

launches.title: truthsystems: AI Governance Agent for Regulated Industries
launches.tagline: Building the Chief Compliance Officer at every single AI Interactions
launches.body:
![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdVRq9G6zxM14SvFxiMBUF0pK8ArLuZpJJePm0rkpzFPHtEaCYoGI4uz_9DnEJ7YYY4QM5FsGVm5DOO3Ja05maM1DW0_2TQHPom4vPTWbbpDuMg3qZNbtmYD9hOeyZZnu8OFh2muQ?key=RHZIlJDEf1i3HROkoIzKug)

## **💬 TL;DR: GenAI introduces compliance & governance nightmares to all firms in regulated industries. We solve this by building an AI governance agent that monitors AI use and flags potential policy violations to end users.**

## **💬 The Problem**

Law firms, banks, and other firms in regulated industries want to use more AI, but doing so without robust governance tools risks compliance breaches and client trust loss.

The problem is most acute in law firms, which we observed firsthand as AI researchers at Stanford Law School. **It stems from three primary challenges:**

* **Unmanaged Liability:** There is no room for mistakes at law firms. Simple actions, such as uploading confidential files to AI tools or relying on AI-generated citations, can result in millions of dollars' worth of breaches and, more importantly, erode client trust.
* **No Operational Control:** Firms can't see or control how employees use different AI tools, and they have no way to enforce the policies they write. 
* **Conflicting Client Mandates:** One client may require prior written approval for all AI tools, another might forbid their data on a specific matter from leaving the country, and a third bans AI entirely. Manually enforcing these unique rules for every client and their respective matter is impossible.

**The result:** Firms hesitate to fully embrace AI, fearing reputational damage and costly mistakes; many ban AI or have already paid millions for errors discovered too late.

**🏆 The Solution**

Truth Systems provides firms with a compliance AI agent that reads firm policies and client guidelines, then converts them into dynamic guardrails that can be enforced on top of all AI usage

Here’s an example of how it works:

[Truth Systems - August 2025 Demo](https://www.loom.com/share/7cb045b4d9134727936f25dec2083c0f)

## **🖖 Why We Build Truth Systems**

We are a team of AI nerds, researchers, and product builders who believe that responsible deployment of technology is the key to unlocking meaningful innovation in regulated industries.

Our co-founders, [Alex Mac](mailto:alex@truthsystems.ai) and [Nam Nguyen](mailto:nam.nguyen@truthsystems.ai), were childhood best friends and AI researchers at Stanford Law under Dr. Megan Ma, collaborating with top law firms to address their concerns about this technology. Our founding engineer, Mikolaj Bochenski, was the 2nd hire at Legora, one of the largest Legal AI companies in the world, and understands intrinsically how legal AI is built and deployed. 

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdbC9GGtu-LK9MRGBCZ221JfsrfUvbLH0mwzGkSbLxxc6uVoBNvQrpedx3mIwvKClEP_K388qiV0_BoOYrYv29ysqqYI375twgSmROoTYp5Dd36Q33W5Fl0wQkgge5OTfn3TihV0g?key=RHZIlJDEf1i3HROkoIzKug)

We’re already working with two law firms with $2 billion in revenue combined, and helping nearly 1,500 attorneys use generative AI safely and responsibly. 

## **📈 The Opportunity**

Our vision is to continue being the leading software that governs all AI use in regulated industries. Law firms are only the first steps for us. They are trusted advisors on governance and an important customer that helps us expand into other regulated industries. We envision a future where every knowledge professional can confidently and safely adopt the latest AI capabilities.

## **⭐ Our Ask**

We are live and are onboarding law firms daily. If you know any:

* Lawyers, Innovation folks, or Governance/ Info Sec Teams at Big Law, we should talk to
* Front-end Devs who are passionate about cracking the hardest security problems in regulated industries

 

Please drop us a note at [nam.nguyen@truthsystems.ai](mailto:nam.nguyen@truthsystems.ai)

Many thanks for your support! ❤️

launches.title: ZeroEval - Build self-improving agents
launches.tagline: A tool to evaluate and optimize AI agents using human feedback.
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93136&key=user_uploads/208921/328fd273-24d5-4307-9322-075a26467fe9)

Hey everyone, we're Sebastian and Jonathan - founders of ZeroEval.

### **TL;DR**

ZeroEval is a tool that helps you build reliable AI agents through evaluations that learn from their mistakes and get better over time.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hSkpdHE7mCs

### **The problem**

Evaluating complex AI systems is hard and time consuming. The more complex your agents get, the harder this issue becomes. This is especially the case when building:

1. Long-running, multi-turn agents with dozens of intermediate tool calls 
2. Agents where you want to measure the quality of images, video, generated UI, audio, personality, taste, etc

**Current offline eval methods are high-friction**, a lot of work is needed to continuously curate labeled data and write experiments and evaluators. 

On the other hand, **current LLM judges are static and often have terrible performance**, they lack context on how they fail and the nuances of the task at hand. 

Your AI agents are as good as your evals. Without them, surpassing the quality threshold your product needs will feel like a never-ending task.

### **What we’re building**

A way to create **calibrated LLM judges** that get better over time the more production data they see and the more incorrect samples are labeled. The more you teach it on where it's failing, the more reliable it becomes.

Once you have a judge that matches the human preference baseline, you can continue using it on production data or in offline experiments.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93136&key=user_uploads/208921/f815b7cf-a84e-4285-974d-1ffc943889ad)

We’re also introducing **Autotune**, a way to do automatic evaluation on dozens of models and prompt optimization based on a few human samples.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93136&key=user_uploads/208921/954461b0-5b4a-42b9-b464-0a698c3f6fd0)

We envision a future where AI software improves based on human feedback, where developers define the evaluation criteria as a starting point and errors back propagate to find the optimal implementation.

### **The team**

We met during their first year of college in Mexico over 7 years ago. During that time they worked on side projects together, joined a leading fintech startup as first engineers and most recently built [llm-stats.com](http://llm-stats.com), a leading LLM leaderboard website that reached 60k MAU and  ⅓  million unique users since its launch a few months ago.

* **Sebastian** was founding engineer at Micro building the future of email (backed by a16z), as well as founding engineer at Atrato (YC W21).
* **Jonathan** was an early employee on the LLM observability team at Datadog. He did undergrad research on vision transformers for particle physics and RL for robotics.

Foundational models have transformed the world. We’re building the second line of offense to fill their capability gaps and create AI products that actually work. We are determined to build the engine behind self-improving software for the following decades. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93136&key=user_uploads/208921/b912b213-762c-42ba-8fe5-dd39de8dd748)

### **Our ask**

If you have AI agents in production and are struggling to measure their quality and/or achieve the reliability needed for your product's success, we’d love to chat!

We don't just deliver a tool, but will sit with you to understand your pain points and help you build high quality evals.

Feel free to reach out at [founders@zeroeval.com](mailto:founders@zeroeval.com) or [book a demo](https://cal.com/team/zeroeval/demo).
