launches.body:
# Sazabi - Datadog for the AI Era

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102391&key=user_uploads/282099/bc8014f4-5e17-4c76-be1c-3bd2b6ba26ec)

Sazabi is a next-generation observability platform designed for fast-moving, AI-native engineering teams. If you're using Datadog, Sentry, Grafana, or Axiom today, you could be moving ten times faster with Sazabi. **Book a demo [here](https://calendly.com/d/cyn6-s9f-tfq/meet-sazabi).**

### Rethinking Observability

Right now, every engineering team in the world is coming to the same conclusion: it doesn't matter how fast you can ship if your app is constantly going down. The antidote to production instability is observability, but not the flavor we have today. 

Legacy observability platforms can’t keep up with the pace of modern AI-driven software development. They take hours or days to set up. They are complex and clunky to use. The alerts they give you are noisy and confusing. They aren't built to be used with agents.

Sazabi is what Datadog would look like if it were built in 2026 instead of 2010:

* A simple chat-based user experience instead of endless dashboards. 
* Effortless agent-driven instrumentation that requires zero code or config changes. 
* Autonomous alerts that can contain all the relevant context and never misfire. 
*  A powerful CLI that gives your coding agent complete visibility into your observability data. 
*  Slack has the primary application entry point. 
* An AI agent that memorizes your codebase, architecture, traffic patterns, and past incidents.
* Native integrations with every major cloud provider and hosting service.
* A storage layer that uses AI for compression and is optimized specifically for agentic query patterns.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102391&key=user_uploads/282099/3e5d80bd-59bd-43b3-bc72-ae9edc68a2ed)

### How It Works

You can get started with Sazabi in less than 15 minutes. There are just three steps:

1. Connect your GitHub repository 
2. Install the Slack app 
3. Start sending logs

For legacy platforms, instrumentation is a headache. With Sazabi, it's effortless. We've got integrations with over 35 of the leading cloud hosting services, including Vercel, AWS, GCP, Temporal, Cloudflare, Neon, Supabase, and more. If we don't have a native integration, Sazabi can open a pull request with the necessary instrumentation changes. Our log intake is OpenTelemetry compatible.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102391&key=user_uploads/282099/563095d8-89fc-47cd-a4cf-94746d7540ff)

After setup, a few things happen automatically: 

* Sazabi scans your logs and codebase to learn more about the system, registering all key services, components, and product features to a live status page that gives you an overall view of system health.
* Sazabi's background agents begin monitoring your logs, codebase, and infrastructure for anomalies - everything from unfamiliar errors to traffic spikes to crash pods and failed deployments. 
* When an issue is detected, Sazabi sends you a rich Slack alert with all the relevant context, including the root cause.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102391&key=user_uploads/282099/f676f9dc-0af4-4c31-873f-abc1172484fe)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102391&key=user_uploads/282099/c81d2281-add8-4645-b873-524affd0d0ee)

You and anyone from your team can send Sazabi a follow-up message via Slack, CLI, Web, or MCP. Sazabi is great for ad hoc questions and queries too. Sazabi automations allow you to generate detailed reports at any cadence.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102391&key=user_uploads/282099/b8ab228d-23a7-40d2-960d-c469c6d25f19)

After receiving an alert, you can fix it directly with just a click of a button. Sazabi will open the pull request against your repo. If you prefer to use a different coding agent, it’s easy to hand off context -  Sazabi has integrations with Cursor, Codex, and Claude Code.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102391&key=user_uploads/282099/a95e8ecc-befb-4e31-a7a9-5523adea2548)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102391&key=user_uploads/282099/be62eeb2-a73f-431a-b99a-64823dc8fdc2)

Teams that use Sazabi are detecting issues they didn’t know they had and resolving incidents in minutes instead of hours.

### Logs Are All You Need

Sazabi is based on a few big ideas. The most important one: “logs are all you need”. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102391&key=user_uploads/282099/135568da-6b42-4f54-8e27-2e9d9d349f46)

What this means is that Sazabi doesn't require users to send metrics or traces. You only need to send us logs (stdout and stderr). Sazabi is able to answer complex queries, perform aggregations, profile endpoints, and trace requests through your entire system using just log data. The result is a much simpler instrumentation experience for you and your team, with all the power of a traditional observability platform.

### What Makes Us Different

A lot of companies are building in observability right now. How is Sazabi different?  Here’s how we think about the landscape:

*  **AI SRE startups like Traversal and Resolve.** These sit on top of third-party systems like Datadog. It's an approach that makes sense for enterprises that rely on legacy tools, but not the best solution. Sazabi has its own storage layer.
* **DIY solutions like Ramp’s “On-Call Assistant”.** It’s great to see so many companies building internal AI SREs. It proves demand, but it doesn't make sense for each company to build their own - especially when Sazabi is offering a better agent off-the-shelf.
* **Legacy players like Datadog, Grafana, Sentry, and Axiom.** You can try to use Claude Code with the Datadog MCP, and it will work OK, but not great.  importantly, this approach isn't stateful. Each investigation is completely new. Sazabi, on the other hand, accumulates memory and constantly gets better. More fundamentally, all of these companies predate AI agents and are structurally misaligned with AI.
* **LLM observability companies like Arize, Braintrust, LangChain, and Raindrop.** These are a narrow point solution for building and observing agents. Sazabi can do this too, but its scope is much broader than that. It's a general solution for observing any workload. We think that in the long-term there is no meaningful difference between observing agents and other types of software.

Sazabi's most important differentiator is our vertical integration. We're building every piece of the AI observability stack:

* The interfaces
* The agent
* The storage layer

The allows us to do things our competitors fundamentally can't, like analyze and memorize every historical incident, or optimize our DB for the specific query patterns of our agent. It's an Apple-style approach to observability. 

### Where We Are Today

Sazabi is currently in closed alpha, but we’re growing fast. In the past month we’ve onboarded 35 new teams, run 8,000 background investigations, detected 2,000 issues, ingested 2 TB of logs, and opened 200 PRs.  

Sazabi is founded by Sherwood Callaway, a two-time YC founder who previously started the infrastructure and observability teams at Brex. We’re a team of nine engineers in total, including three early members of the Brex team and two former observability founders. 

Our investors include angels from top AI dev tools and infrastructure startups. To name a few:

launches.body:
## **TL;DR**

Constellation is an AI-powered operating system for satellite constellation management. We predict link failures before they happen (90%+ accuracy) and autonomously reroute traffic in under 2 seconds—zero data loss, zero human intervention.

<https://youtu.be/QCmIZzADXzI>

---

## **The Problem**

There are 10,000 satellites in orbit today. There will be 70,000 by 2030.

Network failures already cost the industry **$2.5 billion per year**—and the old model of managing these networks manually doesn't scale to thousands of satellites.

Today's satellite operators are stuck in reactive mode: something breaks, engineers scramble, data gets lost, SLAs get violated. The tools were built for a world with dozens of satellites, not thousands.

As constellations grow, the complexity compounds. Weather events, atmospheric interference, traffic spikes, hardware degradation—all happening across a global network, 24/7. No human team can monitor and respond fast enough.

---

## **The Solution**

ConstellationOS is an AI-driven operating system that makes satellite networks autonomous and resilient.

**What it does:**

* **Ingests telemetry** from satellites, ground stations, and weather systems—over 100,000 messages per second
* **Predicts failures** using advanced ML models (atmospheric, signal quality, network topology, traffic patterns)
* **Autonomously acts** to reroute traffic, execute handoffs, and rebalance load—all in under 2 seconds

Think of it as autopilot for your satellite network. We give you a 5-minute early warning window before failures happen, then handle the response automatically.

**The result:** Zero data loss. Zero human intervention. Massive cost savings.

Our team has worked on this exact problem for years at **SpaceX**, **Blue Origin**, and **NASA**. We've seen firsthand how current tools break down at scale—and we've built the systems that need to replace them.

We're not theorizing about satellite operations. We've lived it.

launches.body:
> **TLDR:** Create an API sandbox with the environments your CI, tests, and evals need. Your coding agent can start the API sandboxes (e.g Linear, Slack, Datadog), run tests, and inspect state changes. Ask your agent about archal.ai!

Hi everyone, I'm Aidan, the founder of Archal. I previously built agent environments at Scale AI and I've been an avid developer for most of my life, which led me to the problem Archal poses to solve.

[https:/youtu.be/pUfu1RFDYVk](https://youtu.be/pUfu1RFDYVk)

**What we found**

Coding agents are getting much better at writing integrations, but testing those integrations is still painful. Many providers do not offer a usable sandbox, so developers fall back to throwaway accounts, shared test workspaces, or thin mocks. Those options are difficult to reset and make it hard to know whether an agent actually completed a task or only returned a plausible response.

As Adam Bender at Google put it, “But with 10x more code and 10x more services, integration tests are going to become the most important part of your quality strategy.” (Google, Software engineering is at the tipping point)

**How Archal works**

With all of this in mind, I built Archal for a starting point of how the next generation of devs will do QA. It's a tool focused on giving agent developers and integration engineers API sandboxes of the SaaS platforms they use in prod pipelines. With Archal, a developer or their coding agent can start a sandbox, run the task, inspect what changed, and reset everything for the next test. We eliminate the need of separate test accounts, thin mocks and stubs, as well as overburdening rate limits on provider-owned sandboxes.

**Our ask**

We're giving out $20 in Archal credits to each new developer that signs up and starts a sandbox. We’d love for you to give it a try and give us feedback, cheers to making testing easier in the era of coding agents!

launches.tagline: Simulation environments to train & evaluate long-horizon AI agents
launches.body:
## Problem

We’re at the very beginning of the agent era. The demand for AI is shifting from models that simply answer questions to agents that can operate autonomously over days and weeks. Models have become incredibly proficient at short tasks, but fail when asked to perform **long-horizon work** that requires proficiency with a **diverse set of tools**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98237&key=user_uploads/2471616/0489f25a-b235-4d6f-ade3-86a0a5b4897c)

(source: <https://metr.org/blog/2025-03-19-measuring-ai-ability-to-complete-long-tasks/>) 

Static datasets are no longer sufficient. To improve the performance of autonomous agents, they must be trained inside environments that reflect the real world.

Today, most RL environments are narrow in scope, test isolated workflows, deal with static data, and produce rollouts that take on the order of minutes to complete. Innovation in environment technology is needed in order to train agents that can perform reliably over extended durations without human guidance.

## Solution

Polymath builds **simulated worlds where AI agents learn to operate autonomously over long horizons**. Our environments combine running applications, real tools, and multi-step tasks that reflect the complexity of real work. Instead of solving small, isolated problems, agents learn by completing end-to-end work inside living systems that evolve over time. We train agents on tasks that could take humans days of effort to complete. To perform these tasks effectively, agents need to exercise good judgement under ambiguous circumstances, and respond to changes in the environment.

## Horizon-SWE

We recently launched Horizon-SWE, a benchmark that drops frontier models into a simulated software company.

It consists of a **running application, real tools, and long-horizon tasks** covering the entire software development lifecycle (planning, coding, testing, deployment, monitoring). The benchmark measures the ability of AI agents to perform **end-to-end SWE tasks**, as opposed to code generation alone. Leading models score around 25% on the benchmark.

Read more about our methodology here: <https://www.polymathlabs.ai/blog/horizon-swe>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98237&key=user_uploads/2471616/a86c29a4-fcff-4ae9-a7fe-53bdf6234300)

## Team

Polymath is a team of researchers and engineers from UC Berkeley, Hume AI, Plaid, and Amazon. We have years of experience post-training frontier models in industry, and building large-scale data systems.

Dylan previously led post-training research and data at Hume AI. He launched the first generative AI features at AWS model inference, and received the Amazon Inventor Award. Dylan studied Computer Science at UC Berkeley, and conducted research in reinforcement learning at Berkeley Artificial Intelligence Research (BAIR), and ML systems at the RISE Lab. He is a recipient of the National Science Foundation (NSF) Fellowship.

Naren led the development of Plaid’s credit monitoring system from the ground up, building infrastructure that now supports millions of business-critical transactions daily. At Amazon, he was a core contributor to large-scale ML systems powering critical logistics workflows. Naren studied Electrical Engineering & Computer Science at UC Berkeley, and conducted research in ML systems at Berkeley Artificial Intelligence Research (BAIR).

If you work at a frontier lab and are interested in acquiring environments, or know someone who is, we’d love to chat! ([founders@polymathlabs.ai](mailto:founders@polymathlabs.ai))

Traditional mid-market companies lack technical capacity to use the data they are sitting on.

They can’t hire an army of Data / Software Engineers so they loose precious margin points.

**II - What we do**

We are building Netter to bring data excellence into their operations.

Netter is a full stack data platform based on data scientists agents. 

We connect to data sources, build pipelines and deploy use cases (operational apps, ML models, AI workflows). 

Companies get a plug and play solution to pilot their activities with high precision.

**III - Concrete examples**

Here are three use cases we deployed at the 1st and 4th European Nursing Homes.

**Receivables collection**: Payments and invoices lived in separate tools that didn't talk to each other. We first reconciled the two, then deployed a matching algorithm to automate the collection process through an intelligent workflow, one that follows business rules and triggers actions once its confidence threshold is reached.

**HR anomaly detection**: Certain patterns were going completely unnoticed: recurring absenteeism, fixed-term contracts renewed on loop, abnormal overtime. We plugged a detection engine into their existing HR data, surfacing these weak signals continuously and suggesting action plans, before they turned into real hidden costs.

**Occupancy rate prediction**: Nursing homes struggle to anticipate pressure on their beds, often because occupancy data isn't aggregated in real time. We deployed a forecasting model that consolidates occupancy by unit, predicts the next 24 hours, and gives teams early visibility to adjust resources before things get critical.

name: Datoric
long_description:
Datoric develops custom datasets for voice models, robotics, and world models, treating research, collection, verification, and production as one continuous process. We work closely with frontier model teams to turn emerging limitations and model failures into testable data hypotheses, while running our own experiments ahead of customer demand. This allows us to operationalize validated methods into repeatable collection systems at scale.

Data is collected through private invite-only applications separated by modality, customer, and trust level. Every submission remains linked to the contributor, device, task, session, consent, rights, and processing history that produced it, giving our internal QA and fraud models the context to detect problems that may appear legitimate in the finished file. Each collection reveals new failure cases and quality signals that improve the systems behind the next dataset.

Once a collection method is validated, we scale it up as a solution to the model failure and it also becomes a reusable data recipe for future custom projects or independently collected, rights-cleared data products.
one_liner: The secure training data R&D engine for physical AI

launches.title: Datoric | Trustworthy data for the next generation of models
launches.tagline: Collecting the human experience AI needs, securely.
launches.body:
Datoric provides custom, security-first training data for voice models, robotics, and world models. Our private, project-specific contributor systems have led to a dramatic improvement in quality for customers and helped us generate nearly seven figures in revenue over the last 30 days.

## **Our background**

In 2023, we built large-scale automations that completed paid LLM training tasks across major crowd-work platforms by bypassing QA testers. We earned six figures in three months, and even helped fix some of the vulnerabilities that we found. From this experience, we learned just how easily training data can be compromised, and how it can lead to unsafe model behavior.

<https://youtu.be/GXuyd2PfsAY>

## **The problem**

Labs are searching for the high-quality, authentic human data their models need, but quality and provenance become harder to control at scale, especially when relying on outside data providers. Poor-quality or compromised data can distort model behavior, while unqualified contributors, automated submissions, unclear instructions, and weak consent records can still slip through QA. At the same time, data providers hold concentrated stores of customer data, contributor identities, and payments that attract fraud and security threats.

## **What we built**

Datoric manages the full collection process for multilingual speech, egocentric video, and action-conditioned data. We collect this data through more than 300,000 active contributors who record conversations, everyday tasks, and other project-specific activities through our private apps. Because Datoric has no public marketplace or open upload system, every collection can run inside its own isolated environment, keeping customer projects separate and limiting unauthorized access. Each recording also remains linked to the verified contributor who created it and the consent they provided. This blocks automated or manipulated submissions and protects quality throughout the collection process rather than leaving it to final QA.

## **Traction**

We’ve seen a major uptick in quality compared to other providers, and in the last 30 days, Datoric has generated nearly seven figures in revenue.

## **Our ask**

We would love introductions to teams building voice models, robots, or world models that need difficult, custom human-generated data.

Send us your hardest collection specification at [**founders@datoric.com**](mailto:founders@datoric.com), or visit [**datoric.com**](http://datoric.com).

Hey YC - We’re [Aryah Oztanir](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aryah-oztanir/) and [Ajay Misra](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ajay-misra/), the co-founders of [o11.ai](http://o11.ai).

\
TL;DR - AI in legacy tools (e.g. Copilot, Gemini in Workspace, etc…) sucks. We built o11 to make automation directly inside legacy tools easy.

# See us in action (demo vid):

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0nlcwZ6bw_c>

# The Problem:

62% of all companies still rely on legacy software and systems. Many of these systems are manual, outdated, and inefficient. In the age of AI, the legacy giants that create this software aim to “duct tape” AI onto their tools – but what they end up with is a **mangled mess that can’t actually do anything useful (Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, the generic useless “AI” sidebar in every application).** Enterprises and consumers need a way to automate work directly inside of the tools they are familiar with – \*\*their solution is o11.\*\*\
\
Starting with **the entire Google & Microsoft Suite,** we’ve enabled hundreds of companies to automate presentation / spreadsheet / document generation directly within their workflow. Teams that use us no longer need to move from app to app or deal with agents that merely “provide insights.” Now they can actually do things in these tools, and do them **fast.**

# Start today:

Try o11 for Free in Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 at <https://o11.ai>. Book a demo at <https://o11.ai/book-demo>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98341&key=user_uploads/1788479/2a4f8871-f9de-4f49-9758-39a582173ea4)

# 

# How did we come up with this?

Before we dropped out of UNC we were surrounded by finance students who all faced similar problems at their internships over the summer: Legacy software, no AI, and tons of grunt work. Most existing finance solutions thought the best way to provide workflow value was to build an external dashboard. But after speaking to hundreds of finance professionals we realized that teams don’t want an external solution, they require something that is directly within their workflow. So, we started by building a Microsoft PowerPoint plugin. Soon, financial teams started asking us for more, and we then introduced o11 For Excel and o11 For Word. But, why confine ourselves to Microsoft only? Teams that we worked with and spoke to all wanted integrations with the full G Workspace suite, and soon we built it for them in Google Slides, Docs, and Sheets. **We’re not stopping there though – while these productivity suites are a large part of our user’s workflows, their workflows aren’t just confined to these tools.**

# Where does this go?

Our users use thousands of enterprise legacy apps that need automation, not duct-taped AI. That’s why, the product we’re soon going to release will enable you to use o11 in any app — **it’s going to enable you** **to automate directly inside any workflow.**

name: Chasi
long_description:
Chasi deploys AI agents that help equipment dealers sell more, respond faster, and maximize fleet utilization - 24/7.

One-third of the cost to build and maintain the physical world goes to equipment, yet fleet utilization across the industry often sits below 60%. Billions in assets sit idle while dealers drown in phone calls, emails, and manual data entry. Missed quotes, slow follow-ups, and disconnected systems mean lost revenue every day.

Chasi plugs into a dealer's existing stack to deploy AI agents that handle sales, rentals, and service requests around the clock. The result: faster response times, higher utilization, and stronger margins, without adding headcount. We automate the busywork so teams can focus on what actually grows the business: customer relationships.

Akash Pavan and Sarman Aulakh have built tractors, race cars, and robots, and previously led AI deployments at Tesla, Boeing, and Cummins, where they saw firsthand how much operational value gets left on the table in equipment-heavy industries. Chasi is live across equipment businesses in the US and Europe.
one_liner: AI Revenue Engine for the Equipment Industry

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer:
If we truly succeed, Chasi becomes the infrastructure layer for industrial commerce. AI agents, with human oversight, coordinate equipment, effectively match demand with supply, parts, payments, credit, and insurance across the industrial value chain. Chasi will be the clearing and coordination layer across OEMs, distributors, and marketplaces (Similar to Amadeus in the Travel Industry and Plaid in Financial Services)

History shows that when you remove friction and improve the flow of goods and information (roads, railways, the internet, etc.), everything gets cheaper and more productive. By giving businesses broader, easier access to equipment, with higher utilization, less downtime, and faster access to the latest machines across agriculture, construction, energy, logistics, and more, we can expand global productive capacity and further lower the real cost of everyday essentials: food, housing, transportation, and energy.

launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Chasi deploys AI agents that work 24/7 to help equipment dealers respond faster, sell more, and maximize fleet utilization.

Hey all! We're[ @Akash Pavan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/akashpavan/) and[ @Sarman Aulakh](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sarmanaulakh/) from Chasi.

We have built race cars, robots, tractors, and led AI deployments at F500 manufacturers like Tesla, Cummins, and Boeing. Now we're bringing AI to the $1T+ equipment distribution industry.

<https://youtu.be/Kmc5Y_nSRe4?si=Y8dBQHuYvb0imw2P>

**Ask**: If you work or know anyone in the equipment industry, introduce us! [founders@chasi.co](mailto:founders@chasi.co)

**⚙️Problem**

One-third of the cost to build, move, and maintain the physical world goes to equipment (forklifts, cranes, excavators, etc), with trillions of dollars flowing through 100K+ dealers, distributors, and rental companies in the US alone. And that share is growing every year as machines get more capable and autonomous.

There are three core problems in the industry  

* **$300B value lost in idle equipment** - Fleet utilization sits below 60%. One missed request or scheduling breakdown can leave a $200K asset earning nothing for weeks, wiping out months of margin.
* **Software that creates work instead of eliminating it** - Dealers spend millions on DMS, ERP, and CRM systems that don't talk to each other. 50% of staff spend 2+ hours every day on phone calls, emails, and data entry. 
* **Tribal knowledge is the operating system** - Customer history, availability, who to call - it all lives in a few people's heads or offline notes. When they're off the clock, on vacation, or retired, the business stalls. New hires take months to ramp up, and after-hours demand goes unanswered.

**🤖 Solution**

Chasi plugs AI agents into a dealer's existing stack to work around the clock, maximizing revenue and margins:

* **24/7 AI Workforce** - Chasi handles requests across sales, rentals, and service around the clock. Checks availability, generates quotes, and automates renewals, service follow-ups, and dispatch, so teams can focus on relationships, not busywork.
* **Revenue Intelligence** - Chasi pulls context from existing systems to build a complete picture of every asset, customer, and branch. Recommends what to add, remove, or reposition across locations to maximize utilization and profitability.
* **Proactive Market Intelligence** - Chasi also tracks which customers are spending more vs. less, scans permits and public filings, and pulls in hundreds of public data sources to surface opportunities before competitors do.

**Our Mission**  

The true promise of AI is to create abundance. In the physical world, abundance translates to the capacity to build, move, and maintain the civilization around us. At the core of this capacity is **equipment**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97881&key=user_uploads/553457/976d6301-05bf-4fdf-90f2-7dfccdbaccd5)

Chasi's mission is to build the agentic infrastructure layer for industrial commerce. History shows that when you remove friction and improve the flow of goods and information (roads, railways, the internet), everything gets cheaper and more productive. Chasi will enable the next AI leap for global abundance.

**Introduce them to us,** or contact: [founders@getbalance.ai](mailto:founders@getbalance.ai) / book a demo [here](https://cal.com/balance-mathias).

[**https://youtu.be/oWFYg1jBcrU**](https://youtu.be/oWFYg1jBcrU)

# 

# **❌** The Problem

The finance & accounting industry is broken - so **we’re building Balance to fix it.**

Companies spend over $680B each year on accounting services. Yet +80% of firms still rely on manual, spreadsheet-based reconciliation processes, and small business owners spend 20+ hours every week managing their books, from invoicing and expenses to reporting and taxes.

**As former CFOs and business owners, we’ve lived the problem for years:**

* Paying thousands per month for late, inaccurate books
* Scrambling to fix errors before board meetings
* Waiting weeks for sloppy month-end closes
* Chasing receipts to stay compliant

\
**Why hasn’t this been solved?**

Because bookkeeping isn’t just rules - it’s judgment. And traditional firms aren’t built to solve this with AI. But companies needed this _yesterday;_ Despite only incorporating in January, we are already active across multiple industries helping some of the most forward-looking and modern companies in everything from tech, ecommerce, florists, to digital consultants, close their books **faster**, **cheaper** and more **accurately**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97794&key=user_uploads/2342832/6a4d536d-9b7c-413f-8a3a-c909d22c5a13)

# [**👷**](https://emojipedia.org/construction-worker) Our Solution

We’re building the accounting firm we always wished existed; combining AI systems with human experts to deliver **clean books, real-time insights, and instant answers.**

**Our AI agents ingest your business context — revenue, payroll, banking, expenses, ledger, and automate the full back-office finance stack.**

Our agents categorize transactions, reconcile accounts, and surface anomalies in real time, with a human in the loop for review and accuracy.

Once the books are clean, Balance becomes the easiest way to actually _understand_ them.

Founders can dive into costs, audit subscriptions, break down revenue, and validate taxes; all from where they work (Slack, WhatsApp, email), without waiting on PDFs or parsing spreadsheets. It’s your outsourced finance function. Accurate books, responsive, and always up-to-date.

We’re[ Ryan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ryanwalkerdata/),[ Javed](https://www.linkedin.com/in/javed-qadrud-din/), and[ JP](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jp-mohler/), and we’re building [General Legal](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/general-legal). Previously, we built AI products for lawyers at[ Casetext](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/542) where Ryan was CTO and Javed led AI. Javed and JP went to Harvard Law and practiced at **Fenwick** and **Cooley**. 

General Legal is an **AI-native law firm** solving commercial contracting for founders. We save founders $100s–$1000s per contract, turn around contracts in hours instead of days, and our clients love the practical, real-time guidance they get from our experienced attorneys.

<https://youtu.be/lqSrp8fNJqs>

**The scenario:** 

Congratulations! your B2B startup has its first customer ready to buy! What happens next? Your customer sends you a Cloud Services Agreement. This 30-page document is dense with complex legal terms.

You might be tempted to just sign this deal and get the revenue now. The problem is that there are often very harmful, and sometimes even company-ending, terms buried in the first turn of an enterprise contract. Some of these terms are so aggressive that VCs won’t even count the contract toward your ARR. You need a lawyer to find and negotiate those out.

At this point, most founders ask the same law firms that did their incorporation for help. These firms will charge $500–$2000 per hour, won’t estimate how many hours they’ll need to do the job, and will take days or even weeks to turn around your agreement.

What your lawyers are doing behind the scenes is a shockingly inefficient process of passing work between partners and associates over email, unassisted by AI or technology generally. It’s a highly manual process where “data-driven” means “whatever the partner thinks they saw on the last five deals.” If you look closely at the work product, you’re quite likely to [find embarrassing errors](https://general.legal/blog/your-lawyer-is-worse-than-you-think).

In short, you’re paying a lot for a poor result, delivered slowly. In the age of LLMs, this is inexcusable.

**The solution:**

General Legal is rebuilding the law firm for the AI era like Tesla rebuilt the car for the EV era. We hire top-tier attorneys and equip them with proprietary AI workflows that enable them to operate at **10× the efficiency of traditional attorneys**. This tech advantage allows allows us to offer our clients:

* **Flat, all-inclusive pricing**
  * **$500 per contract** for review services and negotiation on existing paper
* **Turnarounds in hours not days or weeks**
  * Guaranteed contract turns within **3 hours**, with typical turns delivered in **1 hour**

   
* **Highest-quality legal work**
  * Our AI workflows eliminate common contracting errors
  * Our expert attorneys spend time focused on substantive risk and providing tailored advice

**Our Ask:**

Since announcing our private preview last month, _we’ve had over 20 growth stage companies move commercial contracting to our firm._  We want more founders to run commercial legal through us. Don’t let your founder friends pay traditional law firms for routine contract review! Send them to us. We’ll _do any company’s first contract review for free_ until demo day.

Visit our [website](https://general.legal/), [email us](mailto:founders@general.legal), or [book a demo](https://calendly.com/ryan-general/general-legal-info-call).

launches.title: Corelayer: AI on-call engineer for regulated industries
launches.tagline: Detect and fix production issues 15x faster
launches.body:
Hey everyone! 👋

We’re [Mitch](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mitchellradhuber/) and [Shipra](https://www.linkedin.com/in/shipra-jha-9b021859/) - before Corelayer, we built data infrastructure at Goldman Sachs where we spent many late nights and weekends debugging systems that processed 100s of billions of rows a day.

**TL;DR**

When you’re on call in data-heavy, regulated industries like fintech, healthcare, or insurance, you need to inspect underlying data to debug production issues. We built a platform that monitors both infrastructure and data for anomalies and uses AI agents to debug and suggest fixes in minutes.

[Corelayer Launch Video](https://youtu.be/yFZKJ9QRrr4)

**On-call support is painful and expensive**

All engineers hate being on call. Production issues kill velocity, erode user trust, and become more and more costly as companies scale.

Fortune 100s spend **$100M+/year** on first-line-of-defense production support.

Smaller companies can’t afford to burn **scarce engineering resources** on time-consuming support and maintenance.

**The (sensitive) data problem**

If you’re a backend engineer at a fintech, you probably own a service that queries data, applies some business logic, and stores the result somewhere (i.e., a data pipeline).

When this service is running in production, you’ll see two failure modes:

1. Exceptions in logs and/or failing jobs
2. Bad data produced by your service

“Bad data” can mean anything from incorrect values to entirely missing or duplicated rows.

**This is really common** in certain products and industries, but you’re totally blind to these errors without monitoring data for anomalies and querying data while debugging.

In regulated environments where this problem is prevalent, **production data is sensitive**, which is another constraint we have to solve for.

**Corelayer solves this**

We continuously monitor logs, metrics, **and data** for anomalies and use AI agents to debug, root-cause, and suggest fixes for issues.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96772&key=user_uploads/2897480/fce0b569-7a89-41f5-8225-625e86092a04)

We also filter out false positives and group related issues to reduce alert noise.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96772&key=user_uploads/2897480/6b91dd40-c7c7-4ca9-97a4-f80eaaff537d)

Every team is different. We take feedback from human engineers so our agents learn your systems and improve over time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96772&key=user_uploads/2897480/f5384b34-039b-40f5-ba00-4c1ede356893)

Data is especially sensitive in regulated industries. We’re SOC 2 compliant, offer **BYOC and** **on-prem deployments**, flexible LLM inference options, and expose an audit trail of each step performed by the agent with citations.

**Our Asks**

Does your team deal with data or integrations and spend more time on production support than you’d like? [Let’s chat](https://cal.com/mitchrad/30min). 

Can you connect us with an engineering leader at a finserv, fintech, healthcare, or insurance company? Reach out at [founders@corelayer.com](mailto:founders@corelayer.com).

Thank you!

**TLDR: Booko is a pricing engine for businesses that sell time slots that uses dynamic pricing to fill more appointments during slow times (similar to how airlines and Uber price unused capacity).**

We’d love to speak with decision makers at any time-slot-based businesses that want to maximize their revenue! Booko is a great fit for any high fixed-cost business that’s selling their time. Some examples include: class-fitness studios, med-spas, tutoring centers, consultants, personal trainers, movie theaters and event venues, hair salons, accounting firms, and other appointment-based businesses with uneven demand.

Feel free to email us: [arjun@bookoapp.com](mailto:arjun@bookoapp.com) & [will@bookoapp.com](mailto:will@bookoapp.com), or find a time to chat [here](https://calendly.com/will-bookoapp/15min?month=2026-01). 

**Product Video:**

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hpmFz1jo2WI>

\*\*Problem/Solution:\*\*\
Time-slot based businesses all face the same issue: **every unsold hour is $0 revenue**. Demand is often uneven, and existing tools give customers no incentive to choose those slower times.

Booko integrates with existing booking systems to automatically adjust prices and incentives based on historical utilization, real-time availability, and demand. Like airlines or Uber, we price unused capacity while staying inside the business’s existing workflows. **Early customers see around a 20% revenue lift by filling time that would have otherwise gone unsold.**

Booko works anywhere people sell their time, from fitness-studios and med-spas to tutors, consultants, and professional services.

launches.body:
# **TL;DR**

[**Crow**](https://www.usecrow.ai/) **lets users control your app through chat. Connect Crow's AI agent to your product, and users can type what they want instead of clicking through menus.**

Unlike chatbots that just answer questions, Crow connects to your APIs and data, navigates your UI, and executes actions. Deploy in under a week.

<https://youtu.be/WavAzjR0SCg?si=4mlnykEGLCGPT7S8>

**Ask**: Know VPs or founders at software companies exploring chat-based interfaces? We'd love an intro! Contact us at [aryan@usecrow.ai](mailto:aryan@usecrow.ai)

# **🌊 The Shift**

Remember when Blockbuster thought people would always drive to stores to rent movies? Then Netflix let you just click what you wanted to watch.

**The same shift is happening with software right now.**

It started with ChatGPT. Then Claude. Then every AI assistant that followed.

Users learned they could just ask for what they want, and it would happen. Write emails, search for information, generate code — all through conversation.

**Now they carry this sentiment everywhere - including your product.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96954&key=user_uploads/1919824/a48c7936-a7d8-4d97-abf5-20d2688c9191)

## **❌ The Problem**

**Your product could be the next Blockbuster.**

Not because your features aren't good. But because, your users:

* Get lost in multi-step workflows buried in nested menus
* Stare at dashboards with 47 buttons they don't understand
* Give up on features they don't even know exist

You know an AI assistant would help. Your competitors are already shipping them. Your users are asking for them.

**But building one yourself? That's where it gets hard.**

Your team estimates 6+ months to build a reliable AI assistant:

* Integrate LLMs and connect to every API endpoint in your product
* Build context pipelines and connect to numerous data sources so it understands your app
* Add guardrails so it doesn't break things
* Build observability so you can debug when it fails
* Make it secure and reliable enough for production

And even after you ship, it needs constant maintenance. Every product update means updating the AI integration.

**Getting a demo working is easy. Getting to production-ready? That's the nightmare.**

# **🔨 Our Solution**

Crow isn't just a chatbot you slap on top of your product.

Crow is AI infrastructure that plugs directly into your app — so your users can chat with your product instead of clicking through it.

### Example

Below you can see an implementation of Crow on a sample ERP application. The user is able to easily create a Customer, open their Profit and Loss page, and go back to the Customer page - without ever having to navigate the User Interface themselves.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96954&key=user_uploads/1919824/8a396d0c-0821-45df-b7ed-c753cb393437)

Most AI chatbots just answer questions. Crow takes actions — it hits your backend endpoints, clicks buttons, navigates your UI, and executes workflows.

### **Here's how it works:**

**Connect your context** 📚

Connect your data sources — files, docs, websites, or custom integrations. Crow ingests it all and understands your product.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96954&key=user_uploads/1919824/42a5bd77-f274-43f2-aed7-57914c6e4f80)

**Wire in your functionalities** 🔌 Connect via OpenAPI spec or MCP server. Crow can now call your APIs and take client-side actions.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96954&key=user_uploads/1919824/c7648181-4ace-4d47-8f11-8d13623925db)

**Define Journeys** 🛤️ Build workflows for specific scenarios.

* E.g. User asks to cancel? Crow offers alternative options to avoid cancellation, then handles cancellation if they still want out. You set the path.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96954&key=user_uploads/1919824/e381dd18-acd6-4b5f-b0d9-9747474954e5)

**Track everything** 📊 See every conversation, tool call, and action. Know what users ask for and where things break.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96954&key=user_uploads/1919824/6725a92a-6440-475e-9630-19325b310a3c)

**Deploy** ⚡ One script tag. Simple wiring in your codebase. Go live.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96954&key=user_uploads/1919824/9ceb77d1-4f5d-47d8-87b1-55f716a56d1b)

Our customers go live in **under a week** — getting an AI Assistant on their app that is faster and more reliable than what they tried building in-house.

# **🙏 Our Ask**

If you answer "yes" to any of these, we'd love your help:

* **Are you a VP / executive / founder at a software company?** We are working with companies that have 5k to 200k DAU. Let's chat about how Crow can help → [aryan@usecrow.ai](mailto:aryan@usecrow.ai) .
* **Know someone at companies like Notion, PostHog, or Shopify?** We'd love to learn from teams already building great chat interfaces
* **Are you a developer with a side project?** Try Crow for free. Connect to our MCP docs and use Claude Code or Cursor to drop Crow into your app

👉 Learn more at [**usecrow.ai**](http://usecrow.ai) or email us at [**aryan@usecrow.ai**](mailto:aryan@usecrow.ai)

Follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/110243701/) and [X](https://x.com/usecrow_ai) and share this post. Your intro could help us reach the next company that needs AI in their product!

# **👥 The Team**

Aryan and Jai met on the first day of college at UC Berkeley, bonding over college football before ever writing a line of code together.

We've both worked at top AI startups building the infrastructure that powers conversational interfaces. At these companies, we transformed workflow-heavy SaaS products into chat-first experiences—wiring integrations, solving production challenges, and seeing firsthand the massive value it brought when users could chat with products instead of navigating clunky UIs.

We built Crow because we've done this transformation before and know exactly how hard it is. Now we're making it easy for everyone else.

name: BeeSafe AI
long_description:
BeeSafe AI is building the frontier model layer for social engineering defense. Cyberattacks have moved from code to conversation: attackers now use AI to carry out long-term, trust-based manipulation across SMS, voice, email, and social platforms, often inside encrypted channels where defenders cannot see, detect, or stop them.

BeeSafe changes that by deploying undercover AI agents that engage attackers directly, expose hidden infrastructure, and convert live adversarial conversations into actionable intelligence. Each engagement adds to BeeSafe's proprietary dataset of real attacker behavior and trains foundational models that continually learn about counter-persuasion, deception, and manipulation in the wild.

BeeSafe is starting in financial crime, where banks already value our data against Authorized Push Payment (APP) fraud and money laundering, but the opportunity is far broader. The same data and models that uncover mule networks today can protect consumers, secure enterprises, and strengthen governments against the next generation of AI-powered social engineering attacks tomorrow.
one_liner: Frontier AI Defenses for Social Engineering Attacks

launches.title: BeeSafe AI — Fraud Prevention Platform for Trust-Based Scams
launches.tagline: Stopping scams before they reach your customers
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97562&key=user_uploads/3268572/9d3f5b62-fcc6-4c25-9f79-3c11e7a60a40)

**TL;DR:** BeeSafe stops scams at the source by engaging with scammers to identify and shut down the fraudulent accounts they use for their operations. We are [Ariana Mirian](https://www.linkedin.com/in/arianamirian), [Nikolai Vogler](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nikolai-vogler), and [Daniel Spokoyny](https://www.linkedin.com/in/spokoyny), three PhD AI & security experts, and we pioneered the first AI system for engaging sophisticated, trust-based scammers—now we’re scaling it into a product that helps:

* **Financial Services & Crypto** detect mule accounts for AML compliance
* **Telecommunications** block suspicious inbound messages
* **Government Agencies** take down cybercriminal operations

**The Problem: The $12B Visibility Gap for Financial Institutions**

Have you ever received a text like this?

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97562&key=user_uploads/3268572/33ca436a-5f83-4652-ba59-bdba6898fb52)

This seemingly harmless message is the start of a sophisticated social engineering scam, sometimes referred to as “pig butchering”. Scammers strike up a conversation to build trust with their victims over time, eventually convincing them to authorize real-time, irreversible payments via P2P apps, crypto, or wire transfers:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97562&key=user_uploads/3268572/1e5c6c13-4a22-4cb0-840f-8bc24ec3fdc8)

$12B was reported stolen in trust-based scams like this in the US last year, according to the FTC. With multilingual LLMs, deepfakes, and voice cloning, trust-based scam losses are skyrocketing.

Financial Services, Telcos, and Government Agencies have little visibility into trust-based scams because attackers bypass traditional fraud prevention systems (e.g. behavior-based anomaly detection):

* **Off-Platform Trust Building:** Conversations are held across multiple, end-to-end encrypted platforms, leaving any one platform blind
* **Authorized Transactions:** Victims are manipulated over time into trusting the attackers so they authorize transactions
* **Reactive Investigations:** Enterprises only know about the scams after a victim reports lost money (if they report it at all)

**The Solution: AI-Powered Scam Disruption**

Instead of blocking scammers, our system intercepts and engages with them to extract intelligence, including financial mule accounts, fraudulent assets, malicious domains, crypto drainers, and other related infrastructure.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97562&key=user_uploads/3268572/59fdda02-ba50-4593-817a-68e8b7d5bca8)

Our intel’s edge:

* **Full Campaign Context:** we map the entire fraud operations, from initial message to financial exfiltration, allowing us to map patterns of attacks.
* **Verified Data:** Our intelligence represents ground truth, and is not based on a probabilistic risk score. We minimize false positives by capturing details directly from the attackers.
* **Real Time-Discovery:** all attacker infrastructure is discovered in real-time, preventing real-victim losses.

We provide instant access to high-fidelity fraud signals for B2B and deliver this to our customers in a way that does not add any friction to everyday users.

We have already enabled financial services and government agencies to identify and intercept scammers pre-transaction to prevent victim losses, with 10,000s of real scammer conversations across communication channels, and 1,000s of mule accounts + linked infrastructure already.

**Our asks:**

If your organization and customers are facing trust-based fraud, we want to meet and see how BeeSafe can help.

Please reach out if you work in

* anti-fraud, anti-money laundering, or compliance organization
* consumer-facing fintechs, crypto exchanges, or telcos

by sending us a message at [founders@beesafe.ai](mailto:founders@beesafe.ai) or visiting [beesafe.ai](http://beesafe.ai) to learn more.

**About Us:** We are [Ariana Mirian](https://www.linkedin.com/in/arianamirian), [Nikolai Vogler](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nikolai-vogler), and [Daniel Spokoyny](https://www.linkedin.com/in/spokoyny) a team of three PhD founders from Carnegie Mellon and UC San Diego. We wrote the paper that introduced the first AI system for sophisticated, trust-based scams. We bring expertise in building AI systems for security—grounded in core machine learning research and real-world cybercrime defense—with industry research experience from Google, Microsoft, Censys, and major DoD-funded programs.

question_answers.answer: I didn’t apply for the winter batch, but after the YC partners reached out and spoke with me, it seemed like the obvious choice. The batch has been awesome so far, and I’ve learned so much. Can’t wait for what’s to come :)

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
Context bloat and inefficient LLM inputs. We preprocess inputs to remove useless tokens from the context, which results in faster, cheaper, and more accurate LLM answers.

Currently, this is not being done practically anywhere, which means billions of dollars and quadrillions of tokens are being wasted.

I decided to work on this because it is something much more fundamental than ordinary application layer companies, since it affects each one. And I like hard problems ;)

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer:
The vision is to optimize every LLM request in the world at the token level before it reaches a model.

Even if model labs dominate, there will still be multiple competing providers. We sit above them as a neutral efficiency layer, optimizing inputs across all models. Labs are incentivized to build bigger models and sell more tokens, not reduce usage across the ecosystem. As long as more than one lab exists, a cross-model optimization layer remains structurally defensible.

launches.title: The Token Company: Intelligent compression for LLM context bloat
launches.tagline: Intelligent compression for LLM context bloat
launches.body:
Hey everyone,I’m Otso Veisterä, founder of The Token Company (YC W26).

**TL;DR**\
We build LLM input compression using a fast machine learning model (not a generative LLM). It removes useless tokens from prompts via a drop-in API—cutting token counts, latency, and costs while improving model performance. It compresses 100k tokens in under 100ms.

<https://youtu.be/65ScMCGNPss>

**The Problem**\
Prompts bloat with redundant tokens from chat history, RAG docs, or large inputs. This wastes context windows, drives up costs, slows inference, and weakens model outputs. Heavy users face high bills and must limit context to stay affordable.

**The Solution**\
Our API compresses prompts intelligently, preserving semantic intent while stripping noise. Integration takes minutes.\
Benchmarks show accuracy gains (e.g., +2.7 percentage points on financial QA with up to 20% fewer tokens) and up to 37% faster end-to-end latency.

**My Ask**\
If you're running production LLMs and fighting context bloat, high costs, or latency, email me: [otso@thetokencompany.com](mailto:otso@thetokencompany.com)\
<https://thetokencompany.com>

launches.tagline: Turn production agent traces into validated improvements for your agent harness.
launches.body:
We’re Mohammad and Pranav (Moda, W26). **We built monitoring & reliability for AI agents.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98435&key=user_uploads/2168306/84330bae-242e-447d-a656-800061f4b1ac)

**In production, AI agents fail silently all the time:** tool calls that error or time out, agents that claim they “did it” without actually doing it, prompt injections that cause data leakage, and long customer chats that hide the real issue. Most teams only find out after users complain, churn, or something breaks.

<https://youtu.be/aKPDhL_AE4E>

### **The problem:**

When an agent fails, the “bug” is rarely one line of code. It might be a flaky tool, a prompt regression, a bad retrieval result, or a jailbreak attempt.

But most teams still debug agents by skimming transcripts, grepping logs, and hoping they notice the real issue. Previous tools were built for clicks, not for long, messy conversations with skills, MCP’s and tools.

As agents get more autonomous, this gets worse. Small changes in prompts, tools, or integrations can cause big reliability and security problems at scale.

### **What we built:**

Moda is monitoring & reliability for AI agents. It turns conversations and tool traces into low-noise, actionable signals.

**Trace-first drilldowns:** click from a metric or alert straight into the exact messages and tool calls that caused it.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98435&key=user_uploads/2168306/6e062a13-340e-452f-9676-2bdd790d94e4)

**Conversation segmentation:** automatically splits long chats into topic segments so you can debug the right unit of work.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98435&key=user_uploads/2168306/90151d61-e51b-45da-ac29-72af5c8a31d6)

**Failure detection:** flags tool-call errors, timeouts, and “claimed it worked” runs.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98435&key=user_uploads/2168306/335d8a83-6301-4d0e-af31-a75778cbbb0e)

**Quality & safety signals:** highlights hallucinations, user frustration, and prompt injection attempts.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98435&key=user_uploads/2168306/7ee4b5f6-ddc0-47a3-9e9c-3538f6764acc)

\
**Regression tracking:** measure the impact of prompt and harness changes, and catch regressions before customers do.\
\
Want to see Moda on your agent in production? Book a quick call: [https://moda.dev](https://moda.dev)

### **About Us:**

**Mohammad** built AI agents and infrastructure at **Shopify, Notion, and Clio**, shipping systems that scaled agents to real users.

**Pranav** built data infrastructure at banks and insurance firms before diving into building AI agents at **Shopify** and **Cerebral Valley**

We both dropped out of University of Waterloo to solve what we believe to be the biggest problem in the next 10 years, AI systems are unreliable, Moda is going to solve that.

Visit us at [https://moda.dev](https://moda.dev) | [pranav@modaflows.com](mailto:pranav@modaflows.com)

launches.body:
Hey everyone, we're the founding team behind Canary, ex-Windsurf and Google engineers.

# **TL;DR**

[Canary](https://www.runcanary.ai) is the first AI QA engineer that understands your codebase. Built by a team of ex-Windsurf and Google engineers, Canary reads your source code to understand what your app is supposed to do, then tests it like a real user would. Teams using Canary have caught broken auth flows, slow page loads, and drifts in AI responses before users hit them. Chat with us [here](https://cal.com/runcanary/founders-canary)

<https://youtu.be/IeP7H_E8yCM>

# **The Problem**

AI coding tools have made every engineering team 5–10x faster. Code generation is a solved problem. Code validation is not.

Customer-facing incidents are up 43% year over year. PRs are bigger, code reviews still happen in file diffs, and nobody is testing real user journeys before merge. Changes that look clean in review break checkout, auth, and billing in production.

QA teams are either non-existent or underwater. Manual testing can't keep up with AI-generated code volume. E2E test suites don't scale. The gap between shipping speed and validation is widening every sprint.

# **How Canary Works**

Canary connects to your codebase to understand how your app is built — routes, controllers, validation logic, API schemas. When it runs tests, it uses your code as the reference point to verify and understand how to execute them.

**PR Testing**

Push a PR. Canary reads the diff to know what changed, uses your codebase to understand the intent behind your application and the changes, then generates and runs tests against your preview app, checking real user flows end to end.

**_Step 1: Canary analyzes your PR and comments what it found_**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97890&key=user_uploads/1465952/5a5754e8-e0f2-4c5b-bd10-fc1ab314ed3b)

**_Step 2: Canary runs tests and reports results directly on the PR_**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97890&key=user_uploads/1465952/001bd6ff-fd2b-4344-b272-e3fd630ea3d8)

**_Step 3: Click into any failed test to see exactly what broke_**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97890&key=user_uploads/1465952/d0ca3915-0fb2-4226-9f78-05647886bb46)

**_Step 4: Want a specific user flow tested? Trigger it through a PR comment_**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97890&key=user_uploads/1465952/cf303da1-9272-461e-83e6-206f45569cfb)

**Regression Testing**

Move any PR test into a regression suite for ongoing use. Or describe what you want to test in plain English on our platform.

Canary generates a full test suite from your codebase, schedules it, and runs it continuously. Regression suites also run on every PR, catching bugs from new code changes before they ship.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97890&key=user_uploads/1465952/a070c92d-dda3-47d8-8b92-a1ae26b05f3b)

# **Run Canary**

Teams using Canary have caught broken auth flows, slow page loads, and drifts in AI responses as well.

We're now working directly with engineering and product teams to customize Canary to their codebase and workflows. If your team is shipping with AI coding tools and quality feels like it's falling behind, we'd love to work with you.

Reach out at [founders@runcanary.ai](mailto:founders@runcanary.ai) or chat with us directly [here](https://cal.com/runcanary/founders-canary)

# **The Team**

The founding team comes from Windsurf and Google, with deep experience building AI coding tools, AI inference systems, and enterprise-scale infrastructure.

We've built the AI tools engineers use to ship faster. We've built the enterprise systems those tools ship into. We've built both sides, Canary sits at the intersection.

launches.title: Dream - Pocket-sized AI cameras that catch asset damage
launches.tagline: Dream makes pocket-sized, battery-powered AI cameras that catch damage teams miss.
launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋, we are Ryland and Alexander, co-founders of Dream.

**TL;DR: Dream automatically photographs every vehicle or machine that passes through your gate, builds a 3D condition record, and uses AI to catch new damage the moment an asset passes through.**

**Launch Video: [https://youtu.be/uMP12lCb12E](https://youtu.be/uMP12lCb12E)**

**The problem**

Damage is an expensive leak for anyone who moves large, expensive assets in and out all day. It shows up two different ways:

**Car dealership service departments**

* As a car pulls into the service entrance, damage that could be identified and fixed goes unnoticed, which is lost revenue.
* Without a record of the car's condition on arrival, disputes come down to the customer's word against the dealership's, and the dealership gets blamed for pre-existing damage.

**High-value asset rentals (heavy equipment, trucks, boats, planes, trailers)**

* Teams are inconsistent about photographing assets as they go out and come back, so new damage gets missed before the customer is billed.
* When damage is missed, there's no evidence to charge the customer, so the company eats the repair cost out of pocket.

**What Dream does**

Dream cameras sit at your gate, lane, or service drive and turn every pass into evidence, automatically:

* **Continuous capture:** every vehicle or machine that moves through is photographed from every angle. No one has to remember to do it.
* **Asset identification:** Dream knows exactly what you need to look at.
* **3D reconstruction:** every pass becomes a complete 3D condition record for that asset.
* **AI damage detection:** on return or intake, Dream compares against the last record and flags new dents, scrapes, and visible changes right away.

The result is one clear source of truth for every asset's condition over time: rental companies catch damage before they bill so they stop eating repair costs, and dealership service departments find more fixable damage and resolve customer disputes with evidence.

Works across cars, vans, trucks, heavy equipment, and more.

**Why us**

We have spent years training models for aerial imaging and edge computer vision devices. Ryland has worked on the exact problem of detecting damage to assets from aerial imaging, such as degraded paint. Alexander has trained models that run on edge cameras deployed in the wild in Africa and India to detect poachers.

**Our ask**

We're onboarding partners now. **We'd love intros to:**

* **Car dealerships**
* **High-value asset rental companies** (heavy equipment, trucks, boats, planes, trailers)

If you run one of these, or know someone who does, please message us on LinkedIn!

launches.body:
## Hey everyone - we’re Gobhanu and Saatvik, founders of @Vela

\
**TL;DR**\
The first scheduling agent that handles the messy reality of coordination - negotiating times, coordinating interviews, prioritizing VIPs, and managing your calendar exactly like a human EA wherever you communicate (email, messages, phone calls, etc).\
\
<https://youtu.be/j5uLJQl1iAU>

**🧩 The Problem** \
Most scheduling tools assume the world is perfect. They expect rigid time slots and instant replies. But that is not how real business happens. Real business is "Let's do early next week." Real business is a VIP client needing a slot over an internal catch-up. Real business is someone ghosting you for a week. Currently, we have three bad options:

* **The Manual Way:** Personal but a massive time-sink that distracts from deep work.
* **The "Calendly" Way:** Efficient but impersonal. It signals "my time is more important than yours" and breaks the moment you have complex constraints.
* **The Human EA:** Great, but costs $80k/year and isn't available 24/7.

**💡 The Solution** \
Now there's Vela. It is an autonomous agent built for the messy reality of coordination. It doesn't just book slots; it **negotiates** on your behalf with the white-glove service of a human executive assistant.

**How it works:**

* **The "Just CC" Workflow:** Write your message naturally: _"Looping in Vela to find a time for us next week."_ Vela parses the conversation, checks your calendar, and reaches out to the other person directly to negotiate a slot. 
* **It Knows What’s Important To You:** Vela understands social hierarchy. It knows to prioritize a client over a coffee chat without you setting specific rules.
* **It Handles Ambiguity:** You don't need to give it rigid parameters. Tell Vela "Friday evenings are free," and it understands exactly what that means.

**🔧 Traction & Story** \
We built Vela because we saw high-performing teams drowning in admin work. Today, Vela is already used by the most demanding schedulers in the world - from **Enterprise Recruiters** scheduling thousands of multi-party interviews a week to **Startup CEOs** who need white-glove coordination at scale.

**Our Team**\
We are brothers who have been building together for years. Our last startup SWIFTmfi impacted millions across 77 countries! Together we combine experience from AWS ML & Supercompute, Perplexity, BCG AI, E&Y, Wharton (Huntsman), CMU, Georgia Tech, & UChicago - Booth.

**🙌 The Ask** \
If you are or know any high-volume schedulers with complicated needs (recruiting/staffing firms, sales teams, law firms, founders etc.), we’d love to hear from you and for you to try Vela.

**MochaCare** ([mochacare.com](http://mochacare.com)) unlocks home care agency growth with human virtual assistants supercharged by AI. We take hiring, scheduling, or both off agencies' plates so they can spend less time drowning in ops and more time building relationships in their communities. \

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98296&key=user_uploads/570409/6292e9a2-6ebc-4f33-9cf0-1e60f6c1ca3f)

\* Note: a home care agency is a company that hires and manages caregivers on behalf of people seeking care. These caregivers typically work with clients in their homes or in facilities.

We personally embed into the agencies we work with. Our AI hiring and scheduling agents handle most tasks for us, but we are always monitoring the feed and jumping in if emergencies arise.

Nick goes to bed at 3:30am and Pranav wakes up at 3:30am to guarantee 24/7 coverage.

**What problem are you solving?**

1. **Home care agency operators** want to deliver quality care to their communities, not to stay glued to their phones 24/7 handling hiring and scheduling. They’re burning out and are unable to grow their businesses.
2. **Families** want reliable care. They need to know that the best caregivers are going to show up for their loved ones at the right time and need home care agencies to be energized so they can deliver their best care. Scheduling and hiring mishaps erode the quality of care and cause service failures for these families.
3. **Caregivers** want work quickly and don’t want to deal with manual data entry. They needed their next paycheck yesterday. Our hiring agents (including AI interviewers and interview coordinators) get them through the process swiftly. Once hired, they need to know about the best shifts for them. Our scheduling agents alert them to these and help them focus more on care and less on manual tasks like shift note entry.

**Why are you working on this?**\
We were both raised by our grandparents who gave the world to us. We want to live in a world where they receive the same quality care and attention that they gave us growing up. Currently, there’s a gap between that world and where we are today.

We’ve seen this first-hand. Home care operations can fall short—Nick’s grandma recently started receiving home care and had no caregiver show up on day one. We don’t want this to happen again.

On the other side of the equation, we’ve seen agency owners with the largest hearts feel hopeless about their work. We want to uplift these people and allow them to reclaim their time, get back to delivering care, and start growing their agencies.

By helping agencies deliver care more effectively, we protect the superheroes who care for our communities and the people who they care for, like our grandmas!

VOYGR is the most accurate API for companies to validate and enrich their place records at scale. We deliver comprehensive, up-to-date information about places and local businesses for AI apps, agents, and analytics. We also offer far richer place attributes than standard mapping APIs (for example, which sauna Justin Bieber frequents).

<https://youtu.be/Q8-SY24490o>

👥 **Team**\
Vlad knows this space inside and out – he worked on the Google Maps APIs GTM, plus firsthand customer experience from building in ridesharing and travel. Yarik has spent over a decade leading ML/search teams at Apple, Google, and Meta.

❌ **The problem**\
Real-world interactions rely on mapping data: 15M+ websites, 40% of search queries, and up to 20% of LLM prompts need local context. Yet even a simple restaurant recommendation often fails: the place may no longer exist, there’s no menu-level search, or – god forbid – you need to ask something nuanced (“what’s available that’s gluten free?”).

The gap is place data – it goes stale, and the attributes are shallow. Google Maps API comes with strict terms, but companies need flexible access, plus analytics and the ability to match against proprietary data.

✅ **Our solution**\
VOYGR keeps place data accurate and current at scale. We confirm what’s live, resolve inconsistencies, and combine rich, fresh web context like news, articles, and events. 

1. **Place validation & operating status** – Confirm a place exists and is currently operating. We detect discrepancies, rebrands, and closures.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97389&key=user_uploads/325375/d5166513-44d4-48ab-9110-038e33ccf735)

2. **Place data enrichment** – Populate and continuously enrich place records using web, social, and authoritative data sources, from foundational attributes (address, category, contacts, web presence) to operating data (hours, features, amenities, etc.).

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97389&key=user_uploads/325375/a03fce95-2f7b-4999-8781-b792590f5a6b)


🎯 **Who it’s for**\
Teams with large-scale place data and real-world ops: mapping, geospatial analytics, transportation & logistics, search/discovery apps. We support a broad range of industry workflows: transaction enrichment for banks and issuers, property indexing for real estate, site selection for retail, sales territory planning, ads measurement, and more.

We’re looking for customers and design partners who have place datasets and high freshness requirements. If you’re building anything where “local” matters, we’d love to talk!

launches.title: Ask Poth—ask anything about your customers
launches.tagline: The internal voice of the customer
launches.body:
# \*\*\*\*

**TL;DR: Your customer data is fragmented across Pylon, Granola, Posthog, Hubspot, Slack, and Notion. Poth connects that information into a living model of your customers, mapping analytics from Posthog and transcripts from Granola to the same customer, so you can finally answer the questions that live across multiple tools: churn, adoption or what to build next, with cited evidence. pothlabs.com**

<https://youtu.be/k9gsdaxXdtM>

**The problem:**

Companies have customer information scattered across support tickets, sales calls, CRM notes, surveys, interviews, product analytics and more. 

But answering a new question about customers still usually means manually searching across those systems or beginning another research project.

**The (soft) pivot:**

We originally built Poth to generate hypotheses and launch adaptive interviews and surveys to test them. To determine what questions to ask and which customers to ask, Poth first had to understand all of the customer information a company already had.

Under the hood, we built a customer knowledge graph: Poth identifies the important objects in a company’s data: customers, accounts, users, products, features, conversations, behaviors, and feedback, and connects them through their relationships.

As we integrated with more teams, we noticed that several were using this underlying model as much as, or more than, the survey functionality itself. They wanted to ask questions across everything their customers had already said and done so we made that a core part of the product!

**Customer knowledge graph example:**

For a company like Slack, Poth might model five objects:

* **Account**  (a company paying for Slack)
* **User**
* **Workspace**
* **Feature** (Slack Connect, Huddles, Canvas, or workflows)
* **Customer signal** (A support ticket, call transcript, survey response, or product event)

It then connects them through relationships such as:

User —BELONGS_TO→ Account Account —OWNS→ Workspace User —USED→ Feature Customer Signal —CREATED_BY→ User Customer Signal —REFERENCES→ Feature

Slack could then ask:

“Why are enterprise accounts trying Slack Connect but not adopting it broadly?”

And Poth could connect low Slack Connect usage in PostHog, permission-related support tickets in Pylon, security concerns mentioned in Granola transcripts, and renewal context from HubSpot, all through the same accounts, users, workspaces, and features.

Instead of returning a generic summary, Poth can show the supporting and contradicting evidence, cite the underlying sources, and explain what information is still missing.

In practice, the model contains many more objects and relationships based on each company’s business and data.

**Ask Poth:**

Connect your customer data sources and internal documentation. Poth automatically builds the living model, and your team can ask questions naturally across everything customers have said and done.

When the existing evidence is not enough, you can also use Poth to launch adaptive interviews and surveys to collect what is missing.

Some use cases we’ve seen:

* **Discovery:** “Across our discovery calls, what do users want most that we haven’t built?”
* **Adoption and growth:** What is preventing activated customers from adopting more of the product and expanding?”
* **Churn and risk:** “Identify the top three reasons customers have churned, then flag the five active accounts showing similar warning signs.”
* **Win-loss analysis:** “What are the most common reasons we lose enterprise deals, and which product gaps are actually affecting revenue?”
* **Account intelligence:** “Give me everything relevant to this account before my next customer call.”

**Our ask:**

We’re already working with several teams in the YC batch, and we’re looking for more companies whose customer context is spread across several systems.

I’d especially appreciate introductions to:

* Founders and product leaders at growing startups with significant customer data across three or more tools
* Heads of Customer Insights, Voice of the Customer, Customer Experience, User Research, or Customer Success at larger companies

And if your team has important customer questions it still cannot answer confidently, email me at [matthew@pothlabs.com](mailto:matthew@pothlabs.com)! We’ll work closely with early teams to connect their core systems and get them live.

pothlabs.com

launches.body:
Hi YC! 👋 

I’m Pragya, co-founder of Rubric AI. 

**Tl;dr:**

Rubric AI is building the human and computational layer that turns expert judgment into training signals for frontier models and agents. We believe that shaping the world's most consequential AI systems requires both purpose-built training environments and exceptional judgment.

**Launch Video:**

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_9EzHGu5y5E>

**The Problem** 

There are now over 10,000 vertical AI companies deploying in specialized domains. They all face the same problem: generalist models can't reliably handle high-stakes, judgment-heavy work. While AI agents look impressive in demos, they frequently fail at runtime by selecting the wrong tools, failing to verify steps, or lacking the ability to recover from errors. These companies need their agents to reason and execute like domain experts, but the infrastructure to make that happen doesn't exist.

**The Solution** 

Rubric builds runtime reasoning infrastructure that turns expert judgment into training signals for frontier models and agents. We build purpose-built reasoning environments, curate expert-verified reasoning traces, and plug in at test time to guide agents on how to reason, when they select tools, how they verify intermediate steps, and when they must escalate to a human, turning generalist agents into domain specialists.

**The Team** 

Our co-founder Pragya has spent the last decade building complex products from scratch and scaling them. She was a product lead at Oscar Health through their IPO, built computer vision software for operating rooms at Apella, grew a women's health startup to profitability, and drove new product lines at Asana.

Our founding team brings deep domain expertise across healthcare, coding, and finance, along with years of experience building large-scale infrastructure. We've shipped in high-stakes domains and know how to build for the scale this problem demands.

**Ask**

1. If you're deploying AI agents in a specialized domain and need them to reason like experts, we'd love to talk. Reach out at [team@therubric.ai](mailto:team@therubric.ai).
2. If you're a domain expert in healthcare, finance, life sciences, legal, coding, or other high-stakes fields and want to shape how the next generation of AI systems learn to reason, we'd love to hear from you. Reach out at [team@therubric.ai](mailto:team@therubric.ai).
